## 2. श्वसन सुरक्षा आदेश (N95/FFP2)
कणिकाओं से प्रेरित वासोकॉन्स्ट्रिक्शन (रक्तवाहिकाओं का संकुचन) और हाइपोक्सिया को रोकने के लिए, सभी निर्दिष्ट बाहरी कार्यकर्ताओं के लिए श्वसन सुरक्षा अनिवार्य है।
*   **मानक:** BIS-प्रमाणित (IS 9473:2002) या NIOSH-अनुमोदित N95/FFP2 रेस्पिरेटर का उपयोग करें। AQI >150 के लिए कपड़े के मास्क अपर्याप्त हैं।
*   **फिट टेस्टिंग:** कार्यकर्ताओं को हर शिफ्ट से पहले यूजर सील चेक करना चाहिए। सील सुनिश्चित करने के लिए चेहरे के बालों को छोटा किया जाना चाहिए।
*   **प्रतिस्थापन अनुसूची:** AQI 150–300 के लिए उपयोग के हर 40–48 घंटे बाद और AQI 300–500+ के लिए हर 8–24 घंटे बाद बदलें (या तुरंत बदलें यदि सांस लेने में प्रतिरोध बढ़े, क्योंकि कणिका संतृप्ति हृदय पर दबाव डालती है)।
*   **उच्च जोखिम वाले यात्री:** गर्भवती महिलाओं को हीट स्ट्रेस कम करने के लिए वेंट वाले N95 का उपयोग करना चाहिए। दमा से पीड़ित बच्चों को घर के अंदर रहना चाहिए; यदि आवागमन महत्वपूर्ण है, तो वयस्क की निगरानी में बच्चों के अनुकूल N95 का उपयोग करें (7 वर्ष से कम उम्र के बच्चों को टाइट-सीलिंग N95 नहीं पहनना चाहिए)।

## 3. बायोमैकेनिकल और परिसंचरण सहायता
हाइपोक्सिक स्थितियों में शारीरिक श्रम कार्डियक आउटपुट की मांग को बढ़ाता है, जबकि स्मॉग से प्रेरित वासोकॉन्स्ट्रिक्शन ऑक्सीजन वितरण को कम करता है।

### A. अनिवार्य जलयोजन
निर्जलीकरण रक्त को गाढ़ा करता है (चिपचिपाहट बढ़ाता है), जिससे स्मॉग घटनाओं के दौरान थ्रोम्बोसिस और मायोकार्डियल इन्फार्क्शन का खतरा बढ़ जाता है।
*   **सेवन दर:** सक्रिय श्रम के दौरान हर 20–30 मिनट में कम से कम 250 मिलीलीटर पानी या ओरल रिहाइड्रेशन सॉल्यूशन (ORS)।
*   **इलेक्ट्रोलाइट्स:** निर्माण श्रमिकों, गिग राइडर्स और ट्रैफिक पुलिस को हाइपोनेट्रेमिया को रोकने के लिए इलेक्ट्रोलाइट-समृद्ध तरल पदार्थों का सेवन करना चाहिए।
*   **निगरानी:** हर 2 घंटे में मूत्र के रंग की जांच करें। गहरा रंग तुरंत जलयोजन की कमी का संकेत है, जिसके लिए 30 मिनट का विश्राम आवश्यक है।

### B. शिरापरक वापसी (Venous Return) के लिए अनिवार्य विश्राम विराम
लंबे समय तक खड़े रहने या सवारी करने से निचले अंगों में रक्त जमा हो जाता है, जिससे कार्डियक प्रीलोड कम होता है और थक्के बनने का खतरा बढ़ता है।
*   **आवृत्ति:** निरंतर परिश्रम के हर 1 घंटे के लिए 15 मिनट का बैठकर विश्राम। AQI >300 के लिए, कार्य चक्रों को 40–45 मिनट के कार्य के बाद 15–20 मिनट के विश्राम तक कम किया जाना चाहिए।
*   **स्थिति:** विश्राम के दौरान, कार्यकर्ताओं को निचले अंगों से शिरापरक वापसी में सुविधा प्रदान करने के लिए पैरों को थोड़ा ऊंचा करना चाहिए या घुटनों को बिना交叉 किए बैठना चाहिए।
*   **वातावरण:** विश्राम छायादार, कम धूल वाले, या इनडोर फिल्टर्ड-एयर जोन (यदि संभव हो तो AQI <150) में लिया जाना चाहिए ताकि संचयी कणिका भार कम हो सके।

## 4. आबादी-विशिष्ट समायोजन
*   **डिलीवरी गिग राइडर्स और ट्रैफिक पुलिस:** श्वसन दर को कम करने के लिए औसत गति को सीमित करें। स्थिर खड़े रहने से बचने के लिए हर 2 घंटे में स्थिति बदलें। पिंडली में दर्द या सूजन (DVT के संकेत) की निगरानी करें।
*   **निर्माण श्रमिक:** AQI >300 के दौरान मैनुअल लिफ्टिंग को 15–20 किग्रा से कम भार तक सीमित करें। भारी लिफ्टिंग को सुबह जल्दी (सुबह 6 बजे–9 बजे) के लिए निर्धारित करें जब इन्वर्जन लेयर कम हो सकती है। पर्यवेक्षकों को पानी के विराम का सख्ती से पालन करवाना चाहिए।
*   **स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स:** थर्मल लोड को कम करने के लिए छाते/छाया का उपयोग करें, जो परिसंचरण तनाव को बढ़ाता है।
*   **गर्भवती महिलाएं:** AQI >300 के दौरान पूर्ण बाहरी कार्य छूट। आवागमन केवल बंद, एयर-कंडीशनिंग वाले वाहनों तक सीमित रखें जिसमें रीसर्कुलेशन मोड चालू हो। भ्रूण की संवेदनशीलता के कारण SpO2 <95% तत्काल प्रसूति चिकित्सा परामर्श की मांग करता है।
*   **दमा से पीड़ित बच्चे और वरिष्ठ नागरिक:** AQI >300 के दौरान "घर के अंदर ही रहें" (Shelter-in-Place) आदेश। स्कूलों को बाहरी सभा/खेल रद्द करने चाहिए। हमेशा रेस्क्यू इनहेलर (सल्ब्यूटामोल) साथ रखें। वरिष्ठ नागरिकों को साइलेंट हाइपोक्सिया (बिना सांस फूले भ्रम, थकान) की निगरानी करनी चाहिए और यदि गतिशीलता सीमित है तो कंप्रेशन स्टॉकिंग्स का उपयोग करना चाहिए।

## 5. नैदानिक आपातकालीन और SpO2 ट्राइज सीमाएं
परिसंचरण विफलता से पहले हाइपोक्सेमिया का पता लगाने के लिए पल्स ऑक्सीमेट्री अस्पताल ट्राइज के लिए प्राथमिक ट्रिगर है। रीडिंग 5 मिनट के विश्राम के बाद ली जानी चाहिए।

| SpO2 रीडिंग | नैदानिक स्थिति | कार्य प्रोटोकॉल |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | सामान्य | अनिवार्य विराम और N95 उपयोग के साथ कार्य जारी रखें। लक्षणों की निगरानी करें। |
| **92% – 94%** | हल्का हाइपोक्सिया | **तत्काल कार्य बंदी।** साफ हवा में ले जाएं। मौखिक जलयोजन दें। 30 मिनट तक निगरानी करें। यदि बना रहता है, तो उस दिन के लिए कार्य बंद करें। |
| **90% – 91%** | मध्यम हाइपोक्सिया | **तत्काल नैदानिक मूल्यांकन।** कार्य तुरंत बंद करें। यदि उपलब्ध हो तो पूरक ऑक्सीजन (2-4L/min) दें। निकटतम PHC ले जाएं। |
| **< 90%** | गंभीर हाइपोक्सिया | **आपातकालीन ट्राइज।** 112 पर कॉल करें। तत्काल अस्पताल में भर्ती। उच्च-प्रवाह ऑक्सीजन थेरेपी। परिसंचरण विफलता/अंग इस्किमिया का उच्च जोखिम। |

*नोट: उच्च-परिश्रम वाले समूहों (निर्माण कार्यकर्ता, राइडर्स) के लिए, शारीरिक श्रम के दौरान SpO2 का 92% तक गिरना एक आपातकालीन संकेत है। कम बेसलाइन वाले वरिष्ठ/COPD रोगियों के लिए, बेसलाइन से >3-4% की गिरावट तत्काल चिकित्सा मूल्यांकन को ट्रिगर करती है।*

## 6. आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया वर्कफ़्लो
1.  **लक्षण पहचान:** छाती में दर्द, गंभीर सांस की तकलीफ, चक्कर आना, भ्रम, या सायनोसिस (होठ/नाखून नीले पड़ना)।
2.  **तत्काल बंदी:** सभी शारीरिक श्रम तुरंत बंद करें। बेहतर वेंटिलेशन या फिल्टर्ड हवा वाले क्षेत्र में जाएं। यदि हाइपरवेंटिलेटिंग हो रहे हैं तो CO2 रीब्रीदिंग को रोकने के लिए केवल साफ हवा वाले क्षेत्र में ही N95 हटाएं।
3.  **स्थिति:** फेफड़ों के विस्तार को अधिकतम करने के लिए सीधे बैठें (ट्राइपॉड स्थिति)। सीधा न लेटें।
4.  **एस्केलेशन:** यदि SpO2 < 94% है या 10 मिनट के विश्राम के बाद भी लक्षण बने रहते हैं, तो निकटतम आपातकालीन विभाग में ले जाएं। ट्राइज स्टाफ को "स्मॉग-प्रेरित हाइपोक्सिया" के बारे में सूचित करें। जहां लागू हो, वहां ESI योजना के तहत मुआवजा दावों के लिए इसे एक व्यावसायिक स्वास्थ्य चोट के रूप में दर्ज करें।

## 7. कार्यान्वयन जिम्मेदारी
*   **नियोक्ता (गिग प्लेटफॉर्म, निर्माण फर्में):** BIS/NIOSH-प्रमाणित N95 मास्क, ORS प्रदान करना और विराम के समय को लागू करना अनिवार्य है।

# Comprehensive Community Health Protocol: Outdoor Workers & High-Risk Commuters During Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Context:** Tailored for Indian urban environments (e.g., Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Kolkata) utilizing CPCB AQI standards.
**Target Populations:** Street vendors, delivery gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers, pregnant women, asthmatic children, and geriatric citizens.

---

## 1. Pathophysiological Synergy: Glycemic Control & Smog-Induced Inflammation
Street vendors with diabetes and chronic respiratory issues face compounded risks during AQI 200–400 events. PM2.5, NO₂, and O₃ act as systemic catalysts for metabolic and respiratory instability:
*   **Inflammatory Cascade & Insulin Resistance:** Inhaled particulate matter triggers systemic oxidative stress, releasing pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α). This inflammation interferes with insulin signaling pathways, causing acute hyperglycemia even if diet remains unchanged.
*   **Respiratory Compromise:** Hyperglycemia impairs alveolar macrophage and neutrophil function, weakening pulmonary surfactant and reducing the lungs' ability to clear pollutants. This increases susceptibility to smog-induced oxidative stress and exacerbates COPD/Asthma.
*   **The Vicious Cycle:** Poor glycemic control increases pulmonary inflammation, which lowers SpO₂. The resulting hypoxia and respiratory distress trigger a stress response (cortisol release), further elevating blood glucose levels and increasing the risk of acute cardiac events.

### Vendor-Specific Management Protocol
*   **Glucose Monitoring:** Increase frequency to 4 times daily during AQI > 200 events.
*   **Dietary Adjustment:** Shift to low-glycemic index meals and avoid heavy carbohydrate loads that increase metabolic oxygen demand. Prevent hypoglycemic crashes with small, frequent meals.
*   **Medication Adherence:** Ensure uninterrupted supply of inhalers and insulin/oral hypoglycemics. Store insulin away from direct sunlight at the stall. Temporary adjustment of medications may be required under physician guidance if stress hyperglycemia persists.
*   **Stall Placement:** Position stalls upwind of major traffic intersections where possible.

---

## 2. AQI Tiered Action Matrix

| AQI Range | Category | Occupational Status | Commuter Status |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Moderate/Unhealthy | **N95 Mandatory.** Hydration every 45 mins. | Vulnerable groups limit outdoor exposure to <1 hour. |
| **201–300** | Poor/Very Unhealthy | **Mandatory Rest Breaks** (15 mins every 2 hours). Rotate shifts. | Avoid outdoor activities. Essential travel only with N95. |
| **301–400** | Very Poor | **Work Suspension** recommended for high-exertion roles (construction). Vendors to use barriers. | Strict stay indoors. Emergency supplies delivered to home. |
| **401–500+** | Severe/Hazardous | **Complete Work Halt** for outdoor labor unless essential emergency service. | Complete lockdown. Tele-consultation active. Air purifiers mandatory indoors. |

---

## 3. Occupational Health Mandates (All Outdoor Workers)
To mitigate acute respiratory distress and heat stress compounded by pollution, the following mandates apply to delivery gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers, and street vendors:

### A. N95 Respirator Mandate
*   **Requirement:** BIS-certified N95/FFP2 masks (without exhalation valves) must be worn continuously during outdoor shifts when AQI > 150. Surgical and cloth masks are insufficient for PM2.5.
*   **Fit Check:** Perform a seal check before shift start and every 4 hours. Facial hair must be trimmed for traffic police and laborers to ensure seal integrity.
*   **Replacement:** Discard after 8 hours, every 2 days, or immediately if damp/soiled.
*   **Heat Mitigation:** Implement a "mask-off" protocol only in designated clean-air zones (e.g., inside delivery hubs or shaded rest areas with AQI <100).

### B. Mandatory Hydration Protocol
*   **Intake:** Minimum 250ml of water every hour, totaling at least 3 liters per shift during AQI >200, to maintain mucociliary clearance.
*   **Electrolytes:** Sugar-free Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) or coconut water required every 4 hours. 
*   **Diabetic Consideration:** Vendors and workers with diabetes must strictly avoid sugary street drinks (like sugarcane juice) to prevent glycemic spikes. Caffeine and sugary sodas are also prohibited as they exacerbate dehydration.
*   **Monitoring:** Supervisors or peer buddies must check urine color (pale yellow target) during rest breaks.

### C. Mandatory Rest Breaks
*   **Frequency:** 15-minute break in a shaded or indoor, low-traffic environment every 2 hours (AQI 200–300), every hour (AQI 300–400), or every 45 minutes (AQI 400+).
*   **Activity:** Rest must be sedentary to reduce oxygen demand. Perform pursed-lip breathing to clear airways.

---

## 4. High-Risk Commuter Protections
*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid peak traffic hours (8–10 AM, 5–8 PM). Use private transport with recirculated air. Monitor fetal movement if exposed to AQI > 300. If SpO₂ drops below 94% during transit, seek immediate medical evaluation.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Schools must shift to online classes during AQI > 300. Pre-emptive use of bronchodilators 30 minutes before essential commuting. Rescue inhalers carried at all times. Use "Safe Routes" avoiding arterial roads.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Morning walks prohibited during AQI > 150. Complete avoidance of outdoor activity when AQI > 300. Community centers (RWAs) and Anganwadi centers should provide indoor, HEPA air-purified spaces.

---

## 5. Clinical Emergency Triage & Hospital Thresholds
Community health workers (ASHA), family members, and site supervisors must use the following thresholds to triage patients for hospital admission during smog events.

### A. SpO₂ (Oxygen Saturation) Thresholds
*Measured via Pulse Oximeter after 5 minutes of rest on room air.*

| SpO₂ Reading | Action Level | Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **≥ 95%** | Normal (Green) | Continue monitoring twice daily. Maintain hydration. |
| **90% – 94%** | Warning (Yellow) | Administer oxygen if available. Rest immediately. Consult physician within 2 hours. *Note for Geriatric/COPD: Baseline may be 88%, but a drop of >4% from baseline triggers Yellow triage.* |
| **< 90%** | **Hospital Triage (Red)** | **Immediate transport to Emergency Department.** Do not wait. Requires supplemental O₂ and ABG analysis. |

### B. Respiratory Rate (RR) Thresholds
*Count breaths per minute while at rest.*

| Group | Normal Range | **Hospital Triage Threshold** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Adults (Workers/Vendors)** | 12–20 bpm | **> 25 bpm** (Tachypnea) or use of accessory muscles/nasal flaring. |
| **Geriatric Citizens** | 12–20 bpm | **> 22 bpm** (lower threshold due to reduced reserve). |
| **Children (Asthmatic)** | 20–30 bpm | **> 40 bpm** (ages 1-5), **> 30 bpm** (ages 6-12), or visible chest retractions. |

### C. Diabetic & Additional Emergency Red Flags
*   **Blood Glucose:** > 300 mg/dL with ketones or < 70 mg/dL unresponsive to oral carbs.
*   **Cyanosis:** Blue discoloration of lips or nail beds.
*   **Confusion:** Altered mental status or drowsiness (indicates hypoxia).
*   **Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA) Signs:** Fruity breath, excessive vomiting, extreme thirst combined with high glucose (>250 mg/dL) during smog events.
*   **Peak Flow Meter:** For asthmatics, if Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR) drops below 50% of personal best.

---

## 6. Implementation & Community Support
*   **Mohalla Clinics & U-PHCs:** Must stock BIS-certified N95 masks, pulse oximeters, and oxygen concentrators for distribution to registered diabetic vendors and geriatric citizens during winter smog seasons.
*   **Gig Platforms:** Apps must integrate AQI alerts. If AQI > 300, delivery windows must be extended automatically to reduce rider speed/stress. Provide insurance covering pollution-related respiratory hospitalization.
*   **Traffic Police Departments:** Rotation of personnel every 2 hours during AQI > 300. Booths must be sealed with positive air pressure systems and air purifiers.
*   **Construction Sites:** Mandatory stop-work order for excavation and demolition during AQI > 400. Water sprinkling increased to suppress dust.
*   **Emergency Contacts:** Helpline 108 (Emergency) / 104 (Health Helpline) / 112. All hypoxia events among outdoor workers must be logged for occupational health compensation claims.

# Clinical Emergency and Occupational Health Protocols for Hazardous Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Authority:** Senior Pulmonology & Emergency Medicine Division, Mumbai
**Target Demographics:** Outdoor Workers (Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction, Vendors) and High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens)

## 1. Respiratory Protection Mandate: N95 Protocols
For all AQI levels exceeding 150, standard surgical masks are insufficient. Strict adherence to N95/FFP2 respirator usage is mandatory.

*   **Fit Testing:** All occupational workers must undergo a quick fit-check before shift start. No gaps around the nose or chin are permissible.
*   **Replacement Schedule:** 
    *   **AQI 150–300:** Replace every 8 hours or if visibly soiled/damp.
    *   **AQI 300–500+:** Replace every 4 hours. Continuous use beyond 4 hours in 'Very Poor' to 'Severe' categories compromises filtration efficiency.
*   **High-Risk Commuters:** Pregnant women and geriatric citizens must wear N95 masks whenever stepping outdoors, regardless of activity level. Asthmatic children must wear child-sized N95s; if breathing resistance is too high, they must remain indoors with air purifiers.

## 2. Mandatory Hydration and Rest Break Cycles
Dehydration exacerbates mucosal dryness and reduces the respiratory tract's ability to clear particulate matter.

### Occupational Workers (Active Duty)
*   **Hydration Quota:** Minimum 250ml of water every hour. Electrolyte solutions are recommended for construction laborers and traffic police to prevent heat stress compounded by mask usage.
*   **Rest Break Intervals:**
    *   **AQI 150–300:** 10-minute break in a shaded/indoor area every 2 hours.
    *   **AQI 300–500+:** 15-minute break in a clean-air zone (indoor with filtration) every hour. 
    *   **Stop-Work Authority:** At AQI >450, non-essential outdoor construction and street vending must cease between 10:00 AM and 4:00 PM. Delivery gig riders must switch to "contactless drop-off" at building lobbies to avoid climbing stairs while masked.

### High-Risk Commuters
*   **Travel Restrictions:** Geriatric citizens and pregnant women should avoid non-essential travel when AQI >300. 
*   **Transit Breaks:** If travel is unavoidable, stop in air-conditioned, filtered environments (malls, metro stations) every 20 minutes to remove the mask briefly and hydrate, provided the immediate environment is safe.

## 3. Clinical Triage: SpO2 Thresholds and Emergency Action
Immediate medical intervention is required based on peripheral capillary oxygen saturation (SpO2) readings and symptom presentation.

### Triage Thresholds
| SpO2 Reading | Risk Category | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 93%** | **Monitor** | Increase rest frequency. Ensure strict N95 compliance. Re-check in 30 mins. If dropping, proceed to next level. |
| **92% – 90%** | **Urgent Care** | **Immediate cessation of outdoor activity.** Administer rescue inhaler (for asthmatics) or oxygen support if available. Transport to nearest clinic for nebulization and assessment. |
| **< 90%** | **Medical Emergency** | **Call Emergency Services (108) immediately.** Do not attempt private transport if the patient is struggling to breathe. Initiate high-flow oxygen if equipped. Prioritize for ICU admission upon arrival. |

### Specific Population Alerts
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Any drop below 94% accompanied by wheezing or retractions (skin pulling in around ribs) requires immediate emergency care, regardless of the exact number.
*   **Pregnant Women:** SpO2 < 93% poses a risk to fetal oxygenation. Immediate hospital evaluation is mandated even without severe dyspnea.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Watch for confusion or lethargy as signs of hypoxia, which may present before significant SpO2 drops in chronic lung disease patients.

## 4. Implementation Enforcement
*   **Employers:** Delivery platforms and construction firms must log break times and provide N95 stockpiles. Failure to comply during AQI >300 events will result in occupational health violations.
*   **Public Health Units:** Mobile triage vans to be deployed at major traffic intersections and construction hubs to monitor SpO2 levels of workers on-site.

## 3. డిజిటల్-హెల్త్ ఏకీకరణ: మానసిక భారాన్ని తగ్గించడం
సాంకేతికత అతివినియోగం మరియు దృష్టి విచ్ఛిన్నాన్ని పరిష్కరించడానికి, డిజిటల్ సాధనాలు **ఆమ్బియంట్ ఇంటెలిజెన్స్** మరియు **మినిమలిస్ట్ సేఫ్టీ డిజైన్‌కు** ప్రాధాన్యత ఇవ్వాలి.

*   **పాసివ్ మానిటరింగ్ వర్సెస్ యాక్టివ్ ఇన్‌పుట్:** జియో-ఫెన్స్డ్ AQI అలర్ట్‌లు స్థానం మరియు గాలి నాణ్యతను స్వయంచాలకంగా గుర్తిస్తాయి. కార్మికులు AQIని మాన్యువల్‌గా తనిఖీ చేయాల్సిన అవసరం లేదు. వేరేబుల్స్ హృదయ స్పందన వైవిధ్యం (HRV) మరియు SpO2ని పాసివ్‌గా మానిటర్ చేస్తాయి.
*   **హాప్టిక్ మరియు వాయిస్-ఫస్ట్ ఇంటర్‌ఫేస్‌లు:** హైడ్రేషన్ మరియు విశ్రాంతికి సంబంధించిన రిమైండర్‌లు చదవడానికి లేదా టైప్ చేయడానికి అవసరమైన ఇంట్రూసివ్ పాప్-అప్ టెక్స్ట్‌ల కంటే హాప్టిక్ ఫీడ్‌బ్యాక్ (వైబ్రేషన్) మరియు ప్రాంతీయ భాష వాయిస్ నోట్‌ల (ఉదా., "ఇప్పుడు నీళ్లు తాగండి") ద్వారా అందించబడతాయి.
*   **ట్రాఫిక్ లైట్ UI:** యాప్‌లు ఒకే ఒక ప్రముఖ రంగును ప్రదర్శిస్తాయి: గ్రీన్ (సురక్షితం/సాధారణం), ఆంబర్ (విశ్రాంతి/మాస్క్ తనిఖీ అవసరం), రెడ్ (పని ఆపండి/వైద్య సహాయం తీసుకోండి).
*   **ఆటోమేటెడ్ షెడ్యూలింగ్:** AQI 500+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో, డెలివరీ యాప్‌లు మొత్తం 4 గంటల డ్రైవ్ సమయం తర్వాత స్వయంచాలకంగా అందుబాటును నిలిపివేస్తాయి. సిస్టమ్ విశ్రాంతిని అమలు చేస్తుంది, వినియోగదారుపై నిర్ణయం తీసుకోవడానికి భారాన్ని తొలగిస్తుంది.
*   **అత్యవసర ప్రయాణికుల మద్దతు:** అధిక ప్రమాదంలో ఉన్న ప్రయాణికుల యాప్‌లలో ఫిజికల్ వాల్యూమ్ బటన్-ట్రిగర్డ్ SOS ఉంటుంది, ఇది ఫోన్‌ను అన్‌లాక్ చేయకుండానే స్థానం మరియు SpO2 డేటాను సమీపంలోని ఎమ్‌పానెల్డ్ ఆసుపత్రులకు పంపుతుంది. నావిగేషన్ యాప్‌లు వినియోగదారులను తక్కువ ట్రాఫిక్ కారిడార్ల ద్వారా ఆటోమేటిక్‌గా మార్గనిర్దేశం చేస్తాయి.

## 4. క్లినికల్ అత్యవసర మరియు SpO2 ఆసుపత్రి ట్రైయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లు
SpO2 (రక్త ఆక్సిజన్ సంతృప్తత) నిర్వచించబడిన థ్రెషోల్డ్‌ల కంటే తక్కువగా ఉంటే వెంటనే వైద్య జోక్యం అవసరం. కనెక్ట్ చేయబడిన పల్స్ ఆక్సిమీటర్లు థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లు మీరినప్పుడు డేటాను కుటుంబ సభ్యులు లేదా టెలీహెల్త్ ప్రొవైడర్‌లతో స్వయంచాలకంగా పంచుకోవాలి.

### A. సాధారణ బహిరంగ కార్మికులు
*   **సాధారణం:** 95% – 100%
*   **హెచ్చరిక జోన్ (93% – 94%):** శుభ్రమైన గాలిలో వెంటనే విశ్రాంతి తీసుకోండి. 15 నిమిషాల తర్వాత మళ్లీ తనిఖీ చేయండి. కొనసాగితే, షిఫ్ట్ ముగించండి.
*   **ఆసుపత్రి ట్రైయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్ (<93%):** **అత్యవసరం.** దగ్గరస్తున్న O2-ఎనేబుల్డ్ సౌకర్యానికి వెళ్లండి. ఊపిరి తీసుకోవడంలో ఇబ్బంది లేదా ఛాతీ బిగుతుగా ఉండటం గురించి నివేదించండి.

### B. అధిక ప్రమాదంలో ఉన్న ప్రయాణికులు

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు** | 95–100% | < 95% | **< 92%** | వెంటనే O2 సపోర్ట్; కొనసాగితే ERలో చేర్చుకోవాలి. భ్రూణ కదలికలను పర్యవేక్షించాలి. |
| **ఆస్తమాతో బాధపడుతున్న పిల్లలు** | 95–100% | < 94% | **< 90%** | రెస్క్యూ ఇన్‌హేలర్ ఇవ్వాలి; 15 నిమిషాల్లో మెరుగుదల లేకపోతే ERలో చేర్చుకోవాలి. |
| **వృద్ధులు** | 94–98% | < 93% | **< 90%** | కార్డియోరెస్పిరేటరీ అసెస్‌మెంట్; హైపోక్సియా నిర్వహణ కోసం ERలో చేర్చుకోవాలి. |

### C. అత్యవసర లక్షణ చెక్‌లిస్ట్ (ఏదైనా AQI >200)
క్రింది లక్షణాలు ఏవైనా సంభవించినట్లయితే, SpO2 తనిఖీని దాటి వెంటనే అత్యవసర సంరక్షణ కోసం వెళ్లాలి:
* సైనోసిస్ (పెదవులు/గోళ్లకు నీలం రంగు మచ్చ).
* పూర్తి వాక్యాలలో మాట్లాడలేకపోవడం.
* గందరగోళం, తలతిరగడం లేదా నిరంతర దగ్గు.
* వ్యక్తిగత ఉత్తమ కంటే పీక్ ఎక్స్‌పైరేటరీ ఫ్లో రేట్ (PEFR) >20% తగ్గడం (ఆస్తమా రోగులకు).

## 5. అధిక ప్రమాదంలో ఉన్న ప్రయాణికుల మార్గదర్శకాలు
*   **గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు:** AQI 300+ సమయంలో బహిరంగ ఎక్స్‌పోజర్‌ను పూర్తిగా నివారించాలి. ప్రయాణం అనివార్యమైతే N95 మాస్క్‌లు ఉపయోగించాలి.
*   **ఆస్తమాతో బాధపడుతున్న పిల్లలు:** AQI 200+ వద్ద పాఠశాల బహిరంగ కార్యకలాపాలు రద్దు చేయాలి. పాఠశాల సమయాల్లో AQI పెరిగితే డిజిటల్ పాఠశాల అలర్ట్‌లు తల్లిదండ్రులకు తెలియజేయాలి.
*   **వృద్ధులు:** స్మోగ్ సీజన్లలో ఉదయం/సాయంత్రం నడకలు మానుకోవాలి. AQI 400+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో ప్రతి 48 గంటలకు టెలీమెడిసిన్ చెక్-ఇన్‌లు తప్పనిసరి.

## 6. అమలు మరియు కంప్లయన్స్ అమలు
*   **యజమాని బాధ్యత:** అత్యవసర మినహాయింపు లేకుండా AQI 500+ స్టాపేజీల సమయంలో కార్మికులు లాగిన్ అయితే గిగ్ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్‌లు మరియు నిర్మాణ కాంట్రాక్టర్లు జరిమానాలకు బాధ్యులు. కంప్లయన్స్‌ను ప్రోత్సాహక బోనస్‌లతో ముడిపెట్టాలి; పునరావృత ఉల్లంఘనలు సస్పెన్షన్‌కు దారితీస్తాయి.
*   **ప్రజా మౌలిక సదుపాయాలు:** తప్పనిసరి విశ్రాంతి విరామాల కోసం ట్రాఫిక్ పోలీసు బూత్‌లు మరియు వీధి వ్యాపార ప్రాంతాలలో "క్లీన్ ఎయిర్ షెల్టర్‌లు" (పాజిటివ్ ప్రెజర్ కంటైనర్లు) ఏర్పాటు చేయాలి.
*   **డేటా గోప్యత:** ఆరోగ్య డేటా (SpO2, స్థానం) ఎన్‌క్రిప్ట్ చేయబడింది మరియు పనితీరు మూల్యాంకనానికి కాకుండా అత్యవసర ట్రైయేజ్ కోసం మాత్రమే ఉపయోగించబడుతుంది.

# खतरनाक स्मॉग (AQI 150–500+) के लिए आपातकालीन व्यावसायिक स्वास्थ्य रूपरेखा

**क्षेत्र:** यह रूपरेखा खतरनाक स्मॉग की घटनाओं के दौरान भारतीय बाहरी कर्मियों (सफाई कर्मचारी, डिलीवरी गिग राइडर्स, ट्रैफिक पुलिस, निर्माण मजदूर, स्ट्रीट वेंडर) और उच्च जोखिम वाले यात्रियों (गर्भवती महिलाएं, दमा के रोगी बच्चे, वरिष्ठ नागरिक) के लिए नैदानिक आपातकालीन और व्यावसायिक स्वास्थ्य प्रोटोकॉल स्थापित करती है।

**प्राधिकार:** केंद्रीय प्रदूषण नियंत्रण बोर्ड (CPCB) AQI श्रेणियों और स्वास्थ्य और परिवार कल्याण मंत्रालय के व्यावसायिक सुरक्षा मानकों के अनुरूप।

---

## 1. सार्वभौमिक सुरक्षा अनिवार्यताएं (AQI 150 से 500+)

### A. N95 रेस्पिरेटर अनिवार्यता
*   **AQI 150–300 (मध्यम से खराब):** लंबे समय तक संपर्क (>30 मिनट) वाले सभी बाहरी कर्मियों के लिए BIS/NIOSH-प्रमाणित N95 या FFP2 मास्क **अनिवार्य** हैं। कपड़े के और सर्जिकल मास्क सख्ती से वर्जित हैं।
*   **AQI 300–500+ (बहुत खराब से गंभीर):** बाहर मौजूद सभी व्यक्तियों के लिए N95 रेस्पिरेटर **अनिवार्य** हैं। नियोक्ताओं को पाली शुरू होने से पहले उचित सील चेक सुनिश्चित करना होगा; यदि दाढ़ी सील में बाधा डालती है तो उसे ट्रिम करना होगा।
*   **प्रतिस्थापन:** मास्क को हर 4–8 घंटे में या तुरंत बदलना होगा यदि वे गंदे, गीले या क्षतिग्रस्त हो जाएं।

### B. अनिवार्य हाइड्रेशन और विश्राम विराम
*   **हाइड्रेशन:** कर्मियों को हर घंटे 250ml पानी पीना अनिवार्य है। तनाव से होने वाले निर्जलीकरण से निपटने और श्लेष्म झिल्ली की नमी बनाए रखने के लिए AQI 200+ की घटनाओं के दौरान ओरल रिहाइड्रेशन सॉल्यूशन (ORS) अनिवार्य है।
*   **विश्राम विराम:**
    *   **AQI 150–300:** छायादार या इनडोर "क्लीन एयर जोन" में हर 2 घंटे में 10 मिनट का विराम।
    *   **AQI 300–500+:** वायु शोधित स्थान में 40/20 कार्य-विश्राम चक्र लागू करें (40 मिनट श्रम, 20 मिनट विश्राम)। यदि AQI 500 से अधिक हो जाता है तो कार्य बंद कर दिया जाना चाहिए, जब तक कि आवश्यक आपातकालीन सेवाएं प्रदान न की जा रही हों।

---

## 2. सफाई कर्मचारी विशिष्ट प्रोटोकॉल (AQI 300+)
*रासायनिक और कणों के संयुक्त संपर्क को संबोधित करना।*

सफाई कर्मियों को कण पदार्थ (PM2.5/PM10) के साथ-साथ अपशिष्ट अपघटन और सफाई एजेंटों से निकलने वाले खतरनाक रासायनिक वाष्पों (अमोनिया, मीथेन, हाइड्रोजन सल्फाइड) से सहकारी जोखिम का सामना करना पड़ता है।

### A. बढ़ी हुई श्वसन और त्वचीय सुरक्षा
*   **श्वसन मानक:** N95 न्यूनतम आधार रेखा है। रासायनिक गंध वाले उच्च जोखिम वाले क्षेत्रों (लैंडफिल/नालियां) में, विषाक्त गैसों को बेअसर करने के लिए N95 को **सक्रिय कार्बन फिल्टर वाले हाफ-फेस रेस्पिरेटर** (P100 + ऑर्गेनिक वेपर कार्ट्रिज) में अपग्रेड किया जाना चाहिए।
*   **त्वचीय सुरक्षा:** स्मॉग से प्रेरित त्वचा की अम्लता द्वारा बढ़ाए गए रासायनिक अवशोषण को रोकने के लिए भारी दस्ताने और वाटरप्रूफ एप्रन पहनना आवश्यक है।

### B. पाली बदलाव SpO2 निगरानी प्रोटोकॉल
"साइलेंट हाइपोक्सिया" का पता लगाने के लिए क्लॉक-इन से ठीक पहले और क्लॉक-आउट के तुरंत बाद ऑक्सीजन संतृप्ति निगरानी आवश्यक है।
1.  **पूर्व-पाली आधार रेखा:** यदि SpO2 < 95% है, तो कर्मचारी को कम जोखिम वाले कर्तव्यों पर पुनः नियुक्त किया जाएगा।
2.  **पोस्ट-पाली स्क्रीन:** बेस पर लौटने पर तुरंत माप।
3.  **कार्यवाही मैट्रिक्स:**
    *   **SpO2 95–100%:** ड्यूटी के लिए फिट।
    *   **SpO2 91–94%:** संपर्क से तुरंत हटाना। स्वच्छ हवा वाले वातावरण में अनिवार्य 1-घंटे का अवलोकन। यदि स्तर 95% तक नहीं बढ़ते हैं, तो प्राथमिक स्वास्थ्य केंद्र (PHC) को तत्काल रेफरल।
    *   **SpO2 ≤ 90%:** **आपातकालीन अस्पताल ट्रायज।** पूरक ऑक्सीजन और फेफड़ों के मूल्यांकन के लिए तुरंत परिवहन।

### C. विषहरण (Decontamination)
*   विराम लेने या घर लौटने से पहले रासायनिक कणों को हटाने के लिए pH-न्यूट्रल साबुन से चेहरे, हाथों और खुली त्वचा की अनिवार्य धुलाई। यूनिफॉर्म को घरेलू कपड़ों से अलग धोया जाना चाहिए।

---

## 3. अन्य भारतीय बाहरी कर्मियों के लिए प्रोटोकॉल

| कर्मचारी समूह | जोखिम प्रोफ़ाइल | विशिष्ट प्रोटोकॉल |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **डिलीवरी गिग राइडर्स** | उच्च परिश्रम, यातायात के निकट | **कम उत्सर्जन रूटिंग:** AQI 300+ के दौरान ऐप्स को उच्च भीड़ वाले क्षेत्रों से दूर रूट करना चाहिए। हाइपरवेंटिलेशन को रोकने के लिए AQI 400+ पर डिलीवरी समय के लक्ष्य निलंबित करें। |
| **ट्रैफिक पुलिस** | स्थिर, उच्च निकास संपर्क | **रोटेशन नीति:** AQI 300+ के दौरान कोई भी अधिकारी 45 मिनट से अधिक समय तक जंक्शन पर तैनात न रहे। बूथों में सकारात्मक दबाव वाले HEPA वायु प्रणालियां होनी चाहिए। |
| **निर्माण मजदूर** | धूल उत्पादन + स्मॉग | **कार्य रोक:** AQI 300+ पर यांत्रिक ग्राइंडिंग/कटिंग बंद। **पानी का छिड़काव:** धूल को दबाने के लिए हर 30 मिनट में अनिवार्य। |
| **स्ट्रीट वेंडर** | लंबे समय तक स्थिर संपर्क | **आश्रय अनिवार्यता:** AQI 400+ के दौरान नगरपालिका "स्मॉग आश्रयों" (स्वच्छ हवा क्षेत्र) या पोर्टेबल एयर शील्ड तक पहुंच। |

---

## 4. उच्च जोखिम वाले यात्री प्रोटोकॉल

### A. गर्भवती महिलाएं
*   **जोखिम:** PM2.5 प्लेसेंटल बैरियर को पार करता है, जिससे भ्रूण के विकास और प्री-एक्लेम्पसिया का जोखिम होता है।
*   **प्रोटोकॉल:** विशेष रूप से पीक ट्रैफिक (सुबह 8–10 बजे, शाम 6–8 बजे) के दौरान AQI 200+ पर बाहरी संपर्क से बचें। रीसर्कुलेटेड AC हवा वाले बंद वाहन का उपयोग करें। यदि बाहर हैं तो N95 अनिवार्य है। सांस लेने में तकलीफ होने पर तुरंत ट्रायज करें।

### B. दमा के रोगी बच्चे
*   **जोखिम:** तीव्र ब्रोंकोस्पाज्म और फेफड़ों के कार्य में कमी।
*   **प्रोटोकॉल:** AQI 150+ पर बाहरी खेल/खेल रद्द। स्कूलों को एयर प्यूरीफायर के साथ इनडोर गतिविधियों में बदलाव करना चाहिए। रेस्क्यू इंहेलर्स (सल्बुटामोल) हर समय साथ रखने चाहिए। यदि घुघुट होती है तो तुरंत चिकित्सा ध्यान दें।

### C. वरिष्ठ नागरिक (65+)
*   **जोखिम:** COPD का बढ़ना, हृदय तनाव और हाइपोक्सिया।
*   **प्रोटोकॉल:** AQI 150+ पर सुबह/शाम की सैर से बचें। दिन में दो बार रक्तचाप और SpO2 की निगरानी करें। AQI 400+ रेड अलर्ट के दौरान टेलीमेडिसिन परामर्श और आशा कार्यकर्ताओं द्वारा घर-घर जांच की सलाह दी जाती है।

---

## 5. नैदानिक आपातकालीन और अस्पताल ट्रायज थ्रेसहोल्ड

### A. SpO2 ट्रायज थ्रेसहोल्ड
| SpO2 रीडिंग | नैदानिक स्थिति | ट्रायज कार्रवाई |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | सामान्य | घर पर निगरानी। N95 का उपयोग जारी रखें। |
| **91% – 94%** | चेतावनी | तत्काल देखभाल। यदि लक्षण हैं तो ऑक्सीजन दें। बाहरी कार्य बंद करें। |
| **≤ 90%** | गंभीर/आपातकालीन | तुरंत एंबुलेंस द्वारा आपातकालीन विभाग में भेजें। उच्च-प्रवाह ऑक्सीजन चिकित्सा आवश्यक। ARDS को बाहर करें। |

### B. लक्षण-आधारित आपातकालीन प्रोटोकॉल
SpO2 की परवाह किए बिना, यदि निम्नलिखित में से कोई भी प्रस्तुत होता है तो तुरंत अस्पताल रेफरल आवश्यक है:
*   आराम पर गंभीर डिस्पनिया (सांस लेने में कठिनाई)।
*   सायनोसिस (होंठ/नाखूनों का नीलापन)।
*   भ्रम, मानसिक स्थिति में बदलाव, या छाती में दर्द।
*   अस्पतालों को AQI 300+ की घटनाओं के दौरान ब्रोंकोडाइलेटर्स, कॉर्टिकोस्टेरॉइड्स और ऑक्सीजन सिलेंडर का स्टॉक बनाए रखना चाहिए।

### C. रिपोर्टिंग तंत्र
*   स्मॉग के संपर्क से संबंधित सभी व्यावसायिक स्वास्थ्य घटनाओं को **राष्ट्रीय व्यावसायिक स्वास्थ्य रजिस्ट्री** में लॉग किया जाना चाहिए।
*   पाली बदलाव के दौरान SpO2 में गिरावट दिखा रहे सफाई कर्मचारियों की दीर्घकालिक ट्रैकिंग के लिए नगरपालिका स्वास्थ्य अधिकारी को रिपोर्ट किया जाना चाहिए।

**कार्यान्वयन नोट:** यह रूपरेखा कारखाना अधिनियम और नगर निगम के उपविधियों के तहत लागू करने योग्य है। नियोक्ता और नगर निगम N95 मास्क, ORS प्रदान करने और विश्राम विराम सुनिश्चित करने के लिए सख्ती से उत्तरदायी हैं। घोषित स्मॉग आपातकाल के दौरान गैर-अनुपालन पर दंडात्मक कार्रवाई होगी।

# Pediatric Occupational Health Protocol: Children in Family Street-Vending (AQI 150–500+)

**Region:** India | **Context:** Outdoor Work & High-Risk Commuting | **Status:** Emergency Health Advisory

## 1. Legal & Ethical Advisory: Minors in Street Vending
**Critical Notice:** Under the *Child Labour (Prohibition and Regulation) Act, 1986 (Amended 2016)*, employment of children below 14 years is prohibited. Adolescents (14–18 years) are prohibited from hazardous occupations. Street vending during high pollution events is classified as hazardous due to respiratory risk.
*   **Primary Protocol:** Immediate removal of children (<18 years) from vending zones during AQI >300.
*   **Secondary Protocol (If Presence is Unavoidable):** If children are present due to lack of childcare (not engaged in labor), they must be treated as **High-Risk Commuters** rather than workers, with strict exposure limits.

## 2. AQI Action Matrix & Work Restrictions
This matrix applies to **Street Vendors, Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, and Construction Laborers**.

| AQI Range | Category | Operational Protocol | Mandatory Breaks |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | Unhealthy | N95 mandatory for all outdoor workers. Reduce heavy lifting. | 10 mins every 2 hours |
| **201 – 300** | Very Unhealthy | **High Risk.** Rotate shifts. No outdoor work for >4 hours continuous. | 15 mins every 1 hour |
| **301 – 400** | Very Poor | **Emergency.** Suspend non-essential outdoor work. Gig riders limit deliveries. | 20 mins every 45 mins |
| **401 – 500+** | Hazardous | **Stop Work.** Traffic police to use enclosed booths where possible. Construction halted. | **Indoor Shelter Only** |

## 3. Respiratory Protection: N95 Respirator Mandates & Fitment
**Standard:** BIS IS 9473 certified or NIOSH N95 equivalent. Cloth masks are ineffective for AQI >150.

### A. Adult Workers (Vendors, Police, Gig Riders, Construction)
*   **Fit Check:** Perform user seal check every shift. No facial hair allowed under the seal.
*   **Replacement:** Discard after 8 hours of use or immediately if breathing resistance increases.
*   **Mandate:** Must be worn continuously while outdoors in AQI >150.

### B. Pediatric Fitment (Children Present in Vending Zones)
*   **Constraint:** Standard adult N95s do not seal on children's faces, rendering them ineffective.
*   **Protocol:** 
    *   Use **Child-Sized N95/FFP2** (if available and certified). 
    *   **Fit Test:** Press mask firmly; if air leaks around eyes/nose during inhalation, the mask is unsafe.
    *   **Alternative:** If proper fit cannot be achieved, the child must be relocated indoors. Mask usage without seal creates false security.

## 4. Mandatory Occupational Health Measures
To mitigate the physiological stress of smog exposure, the following must be implemented:

*   **Mandatory Hydration:** 
    *   **Workers:** Minimum 3 liters of water per shift. Electrolyte solutions recommended for construction laborers and gig riders.
    *   **High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Geriatric Citizens, Children):** 150ml of water every 45 minutes. Hydration maintains the mucosal lining of the respiratory tract, which is the first line of defense against particulate matter.
*   **Scheduled Rest Breaks:** 
    *   Must be taken in **low-exposure zones** (indoor spaces or upwind areas), not merely sitting by the roadside.
    *   **Vending Context:** Children assisting families must be rotated indoors or to a clean-air shelter every 60 minutes during AQI 150–300. During AQI 300+, children must not remain at the stall.

## 5. High-Risk Commuter & Vulnerable Population Guidelines
**Target Groups:** Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens (>60 years).

*   **Travel Advisory:** Avoid outdoor travel during AQI >200. Use public transport with air filtration or enclosed vehicles.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** 
    *   Carry rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) at all times.
    *   School outdoor activities cancelled at AQI >200.
    *   If present in vending zones: Immediate evacuation at AQI 200+.
*   **Pregnant Women:** 
    *   Limit exposure to <30 mins/day during AQI 150-300.
    *   Monitor for signs of hypoxia (dizziness, shortness of breath).
    *   SpO2 threshold for triage lowered to 94%.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** 
    *   Avoid morning walks (peak pollution hours 8 AM – 11 AM).
    *   Keep windows sealed; use air purifiers indoors.
    *   Caregivers must ensure N95 compliance during necessary travel.

## 6. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Triage Thresholds
**Applicability:** All workers and high-risk commuters presenting with respiratory distress.

### A. Pulse Oximetry (SpO2) Monitoring
*   **Baseline:** Record normal SpO2 for workers during healthy AQI days (<50).
*   **Monitoring Frequency:** Every 4 hours for workers during AQI >300.

### B. Hospital Triage Thresholds
| SpO2 Reading | Symptom Profile | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Asymptomatic | Continue work with strict N95 use and hydration. |
| **93% – 94%** | Mild Dyspnea, Cough | **Immediate Rest.** Remove from outdoor zone. Monitor for 1 hour. If no improvement, seek clinic. |
| **90% – 92%** | Moderate Distress, Wheezing | **Medical Emergency.** Transport to nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC). Administer Oxygen if available. |
| **< 90%** | Severe Distress, Cyanosis | **Critical Care.** Immediate ambulance referral to District Hospital. High-flow oxygen required. |

*Note: For asthmatic children and geriatric citizens, a drop of >3% from baseline triggers Caution protocol regardless of absolute value.*

### C. Specific Pediatric Triage (Asthmatic/Children in Vending Zones)

# Integrated Clinical and Occupational Health Protocol for Hazardous Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

This protocol establishes emergency standards for high-risk populations and outdoor workers in India during severe air pollution events, with a specialized clinical focus on geriatric patients with heart failure.

---

## I. Geriatric Heart Failure Protocol (AQI 200–500+)

Elderly patients with heart failure (HF) are at extreme risk during smog events. Particulate matter (PM2.5) triggers systemic inflammation, oxidative stress, and sympathetic nervous system activation, increasing afterload and exacerbating fluid overload.

### 1. Risk of Pulmonary Edema
High AQI levels can precipitate **Acute Decompensated Heart Failure (ADHF)** and **Flash Pulmonary Edema**. Smog-induced hypoxia causes pulmonary vasoconstriction, increasing the workload on the left ventricle and leading to fluid backup in the lungs.
*   **Warning Signs:** Paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea (PND), orthopnea (inability to lie flat), sudden weight gain (>2 kg in 3 days indicating fluid retention), pink frothy sputum, and sudden onset of tachypnea.

### 2. N95 Respirator Precautions for HF Patients
While N95 masks are mandated to filter PM2.5, they increase the **work of breathing (WOB)**, which may exacerbate respiratory distress in severe HF patients.
*   **AQI 200-300:** N95 mandated for all outdoor excursions. Patients should trial the mask indoors for 10 minutes to assess tolerance. If SpO2 drops by >3% or dyspnea increases, discontinue use and strictly remain indoors.
*   **AQI 300-500+:** Absolute indoor confinement. If movement is necessary, the patient must be monitored for "mask-induced dyspnea." If respiratory rate exceeds 24 breaths/min while wearing the mask, transition to a high-flow oxygen environment immediately. Use high-efficiency air purifiers indoors instead of masking if masking is not tolerated.

### 3. SpO2 Thresholds and Diuretic Administration
Hospital triage for geriatric HF patients during smog events follows these SpO2 and clinical thresholds. *(Note: Diuretics are prescription medications; thresholds indicate when hospital evaluation for IV diuretics is critical.)*
*   **SpO2 ≥ 94% (Safe):** Continue home management. Monitor weight and symptoms twice daily.
*   **SpO2 92%–93% (Urgent Clinic):** Contact cardiologist for potential oral diuretic adjustment (e.g., Furosemide/Torsemide). Do not self-medicate.
*   **SpO2 < 92% (Hospital Triage):** **Immediate transport to Emergency Department.** Requires urgent administration of intravenous (IV) loop diuretics and oxygen therapy to maintain SpO2 > 92%. Check blood pressure and renal function prior to aggressive diuresis.
*   **SpO2 < 90% (Critical Emergency):** Call 112. High risk of respiratory failure. Immediate aggressive IV diuresis and evaluation for Non-Invasive Positive Pressure Ventilation (NiPPV/CPAP) to push fluid out of alveoli.

---

## II. Occupational Health Protocol for Indian Outdoor Workers
*Applicable to: Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, and Street Vendors.*

### 1. Mandatory Health Requirements
*   **N95 Respirator Mandate:** All workers must be provided with certified N95/FFP2 masks free of cost when AQI > 150. Cloth masks are prohibited. Ensure no gaps around the nose or chin; facial hair must be trimmed for a proper seal. Masks must be replaced every 8 hours or immediately if soiled/wet.
*   **Mandatory Hydration:** Minimum 250ml of water every hour to prevent mucus plugging and maintain systemic perfusion. Oral Rehydration Solutions (ORS) recommended during AQI 300+ to maintain electrolyte balance.
*   **Rest Breaks:** Mandatory "Air-Purified Breaks" in indoor, air-conditioned, or HEPA-filtered environments to allow pulmonary clearance.

### 2. AQI-Based Operational Mandates
| AQI Range | Status | Mandates & Restrictions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Unhealthy | N95 mandated; 10-minute break every 2 hours in a shaded area. |
| **201–300** | Very Unhealthy | N95 mandated; Mandatory 15-min break every 2 hours in "clean air" zones. |
| **301–500+** | Hazardous | Cessation of non-essential outdoor work; Mandatory 15-min break every hour indoors. Shifts not to exceed 4 continuous hours outdoors. |

### 3. Sector-Specific Guidelines
*   **Delivery Gig Riders:** App algorithms must pause delivery timers during AQI 500+ to allow for slower travel and mask breaks.
*   **Traffic Police:** Booths must be equipped with HEPA air purifiers. Duty rotation increased to limit continuous exposure to >2 hours.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Dust suppression (water sprinkling) mandatory. Work halt mandated if AQI exceeds 450 for non-essential activities.
*   **Street Vendors:** Provision of temporary enclosed stalls with positive air pressure or air curtains during severe smog days.

---

## III. High-Risk Commuter Protocol
*Applicable to: Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, and Geriatric Citizens.*

### 1. Exposure Mitigation
*   **Pregnant Women:** Smog increases the risk of preeclampsia, low birth weight, and preterm birth. Avoid commuting during peak traffic hours (08:00–11:00 and 17:00–20:00). N95 masks are mandatory. Use private vehicles with recirculation mode ON and regularly changed cabin filters.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** High risk of status asthmaticus. Schools must cancel outdoor sports/assemblies at AQI 200+. Mandatory carry of rescue inhalers (Salbutamol). N95 masks must be appropriately sized for the child's face to ensure a seal.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Morning walks prohibited between 5 AM – 9 AM (peak pollution hours). Shift exercise to indoor settings with air purifiers.

### 2. Hospital Triage Thresholds (SpO2)
For high-risk commuters presenting at emergency departments during smog events:

| Population | Triage Level: Green (Stable) | Triage Level: Yellow (Urgent) | Triage Level: Red (Emergency) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pregnant Women** | SpO2 $\ge$ 96% | SpO2 92%–95% (Monitor Fetal HR) | SpO2 < 92% (Immediate O2) |
| **Asthmatic Children** | SpO2 $\ge$ 95% | SpO2 90%–94% (Nebulization) | SpO2 < 90% (ICU/Ventilation) |
| **Geriatric (HF)** | SpO2 $\ge$ 94% | SpO2 88%–93% (Diuretics) | SpO2 < 88% (CPAP/Oxygen) |

**Implementation Note:** Municipal health centers and Mohalla Clinics must establish "Clean Air Shelters" equipped with oxygen concentrators and nebulizers in high-traffic zones for workers and commuters experiencing acute distress.

# Clinical Emergency & Occupational Health Protocol for Hazardous Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Objective:** To mitigate acute respiratory distress and neuroendocrine dysregulation among Indian outdoor workers and high-risk commuters during hazardous air quality events.
**Scope:** Delivery gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers, street vendors, pregnant women, asthmatic children, and geriatric citizens.

---

## 1. Pathophysiological Basis: Neuroendocrine Integration & HPA Axis Disruption
Toxic air pollutants (PM2.5, PM10, NOx, SOx) act as systemic stressors that dysregulate the Hypothalamic-Pituitary-Adrenal (HPA) axis. Inhaled particulates trigger pulmonary inflammation, releasing pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-6, TNF-α) that stimulate the hypothalamus to release Corticotropin-Releasing Hormone (CRH). This prompts the pituitary to secrete Adrenocorticotropic Hormone (ACTH), culminating in adrenal cortisol production. 

*   **Pregnant Women:** Elevated maternal cortisol can cross the placental barrier and alter placental 11β-HSD2 enzyme activity. Chronic exposure during smog events disrupts fetal hypothalamic programming, significantly raising risks for preterm birth, low birth weight, and gestational hypertension.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Age-related "adrenal senescence" and reduced glucocorticoid receptor sensitivity blunt cortisol recovery. Toxic air-induced cortisol spikes exacerbate hypertension, suppress immune function, and induce vasoconstriction, accelerating cognitive decline and increasing the risk of stroke and myocardial infarction.

**Protocol Rationale:** Mandatory rest breaks and hydration are clinical interventions designed to lower sympathetic nervous system activation, regulate cortisol cascades, and prevent chronic stress pathology.

---

## 2. AQI Stratification & Action Matrix

| AQI Range | Category | Occupational Mandate | High-Risk Commuter Mandate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Moderate/Poor | N95 mandatory for prolonged exposure. Hydration every 60 mins. | Limit outdoor exposure. Carry rescue inhalers. Monitor SpO2. |
| **201–300** | Very Poor | N95 mandatory. Hydration every 45 mins. 15-min rest break every 2 hours. Shift rotation required. | N95 mandatory if outside. Limit exposure to <30 mins. Cancel outdoor sports for children. |
| **301–400** | Severe | N95 mandatory. Hydration every 30 mins. 15-min rest break every 1 hour. Max 4 hours continuous exposure. | Stay indoors. Essential travel only with N95. Tele-health consults advised. |
| **401–500+** | Severe+ | Work stoppage for high-exertion/non-essential tasks. Essential workers only with supervised breaks. | Complete indoor confinement. Emergency shelter protocols active. Home oxygen readiness check. |

---

## 3. Occupational Health Protocols for Indian Outdoor Workers

### A. N95 Respirator Mandate
*   **Standard:** BIS-certified N95/FFP2 respirators without exhalation valves are mandatory for all outdoor workers (gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers, street vendors) when AQI exceeds 150.
*   **Fit Check:** Workers must perform a user seal check before every shift. Facial hair must be trimmed to ensure a vacuum seal against the skin. 
*   **Replacement:** Masks must be replaced every 8–40 hours of use, or immediately if soiled or damp. Delivery platforms must integrate app-based mask compliance checks before shift start.

### B. Mandatory Hydration Protocol
*   **Physiological Goal:** Maintain mucociliary clearance to expel trapped particulates and sustain blood volume to counteract cortisol-induced vasoconstriction.
*   **Regimen:** Workers must consume 250ml of warm water or electrolyte solution (ORS) at the intervals specified in the AQI matrix. Ice-cold beverages are prohibited during shifts to prevent bronchospasm. 
*   **Antioxidant Support:** Employers should provide Vitamin C and E supplements (e.g., citrus fruits, nuts) to counteract PM2.5 oxidative stress.

### C. Mandatory Rest Breaks (Cortisol Regulation)
*   **Environment:** Breaks must be taken in "Clean Air Zones" (indoor or shaded areas with HEPA air filtration) to allow partial recovery of HPA axis function. Passive rest only—no physical exertion.
*   **Gig Riders:** Delivery platform apps must lock delivery requests during mandatory break windows to enforce compliance.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Work must cease during peak traffic hours (9 AM–11 AM, 6 PM–8 PM) when AQI spikes.

---

## 4. High-Risk Commuter Safeguards

*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid peak traffic congestion zones. Use enclosed, air-conditioned transport with air on internal recirculation mode. Zero outdoor exposure during AQI 301+. Weekly blood pressure monitoring is mandatory during AQI >200 to detect preeclampsia linked to stress hormones.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Prophylactic bronchodilator use as prescribed. Child-sized N95 masks required for transit. Preventive inhalers (ICS) dosage may be temporarily increased per pediatrician advice during AQI >300.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Morning walks suspended until AQI drops below 150 (inversion layers trap pollutants near ground). Tighter control of hypertension and diabetes is required, as smog-induced cortisol spikes destabilize metabolic control. Caregivers must enforce hydration schedules due to diminished thirst response.

---

## 5. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds
Pulse oximetry (SpO2) is the primary triage tool. Measurements must be taken after 5 minutes of rest.

| SpO2 Reading | Clinical Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Normal | Continue monitoring. Maintain hydration and N95 usage. |
| **93% – 94%** | Mild Hypoxemia | Immediate removal from smog. Move to clean air zone. Administer low-flow oxygen (2L/min) if symptomatic. Recheck in 30 mins. |
| **90% – 92%** | Moderate Hypoxemia | Urgent clinical assessment. Transport to nearest Primary Health Centre. Initiate high-flow oxygen or nebulization. |
| **< 90%** | Severe/Critical Hypoxemia | Emergency hospitalization. Call 112. High-flow nasal oxygen or non-invasive ventilation required. Intubation may be required. |

**Symptom-Based Emergency Triggers (Regardless of SpO2):**
Immediate hospitalization is required if any of the following present during AQI >300:
*   Inability to speak in full sentences (severe bronchospasm).
*   Cyanosis (bluish discoloration of lips/nails).
*   Confusion or altered mental status (hypoxic brain impact or neuroinflammation in elderly).
*   Chest pain or palpitations (cardiovascular stress from HPA axis overload).
*   *For Pregnant Patients:* Prioritize left lateral decubitus positioning during oxygen therapy to maximize uterine blood flow.

---

## 6. Implementation & Enforcement
*   **Employer Liability:** Gig platforms, construction firms, and municipal corporations are liable for providing N95 masks and ensuring break/hydration compliance. Failure constitutes an occupational health violation.
*   **Public Health:** Labor departments must conduct random inspections. Anganwadi centers and PHCs must distribute N95 masks to pregnant women and elderly citizens free of charge during Severe (AQI 300+) episodes. AQI data and health advisories must be broadcast via SMS and app notifications.

# Comprehensive Smog Health & Clinical Triage Protocol
**Context:** Hazardous AQI 150 to 500+ Smog Events in India
**Target Groups:** Traffic Police, Delivery Gig Riders, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors, Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens

*Disclaimer: This document outlines occupational health protocols and clinical triage guidelines for reference by health officers and safety managers. It is not a substitute for professional medical diagnosis. In severe emergencies, dial 108/112 immediately.*

## 1. AQI Action Matrix & Occupational Health Mandates
To mitigate acute bronchitis and hypoxia risks, the following protocols are mandatory for all outdoor workers (Traffic Police, Delivery Gig Riders, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors) during smog season.

| AQI Range | N95 Respirator Mandate | Mandatory Rest Breaks | Activity Modification |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **151 – 200** | Mandatory BIS/NIOSH-approved N95 or FFP2. | 10-min break in a shaded area every 2 hours. | Reduce prolonged outdoor exertion. |
| **201 – 300** | Mandatory fit-tested N95 with seal check. | 15-min break in an air-filtered room every 2 hours. | Rotational duty; 50% reduction in outdoor hours. |
| **301 – 500+** | Mandatory N95 + Eye Protection. | Breaks in clean-air zones; max 4 hours continuous exposure. | Non-essential outdoor work suspended; emergency services only. |

### A. Respiratory Protection
*   **Standard:** Cloth or surgical masks are prohibited during AQI >150.
*   **Replacement:** Discard N95 masks after 8-16 hours of use or immediately if soiled, wet, or breathing resistance becomes high.

### B. Mandatory Hydration
*   **Requirement:** Minimum 250ml of water or ORS every hour. Total intake of 3-4 liters per shift.
*   **Rationale:** Maintains mucosal moisture to trap particulate matter and prevents mucus viscosity.
*   **Restriction:** Avoid caffeine and alcohol during shifts as they accelerate dehydration.

### C. Rest Breaks & Clean Air Zones
*   Breaks must be taken in an **Indoor Clean Air Zone** (air-purified room or vehicle with AC recirculation) to allow mucociliary clearance recovery and reduce cumulative particulate load.

---

## 2. Clinical Triage System: Traffic Police (Acute Bronchitis Focus)
Traffic police are at exceptionally high risk due to fixed postures at intersections with concentrated vehicular emissions. This triage system manages officers presenting with cough, wheezing, chest tightness, or dyspnea.

### Triage Categories & SpO2 Thresholds

#### **Category GREEN: Home Management & Observation**
*   **SpO2 Threshold:** $\ge 95\%$ on room air.
*   **Clinical Presentation:** Mild cough, clear/white sputum, no dyspnea at rest, stable vitals, able to speak in full sentences.
*   **Management Protocol:**
    1.  Remove from outdoor duty for 48 hours.
    2.  Home rest in an air-purified environment.
    3.  Steam inhalation 2-3 times daily to mobilize secretions. Use OTC expectorants; avoid cough suppressants if productive.
    4.  Continue mandatory hydration (3L/day). Monitor SpO2 twice daily.
    5.  **Return to Duty:** Only after 2 consecutive days of SpO2 $\ge 95\%$ and symptom resolution, with strict N95 adherence.

#### **Category YELLOW: Urgent Clinic Evaluation**
*   **SpO2 Threshold:** $92\% \text{ to } 94\%$ on room air.
*   **Clinical Presentation:** Persistent productive cough, audible wheezing, tachypnea (RR 20-24 bpm), mild chest tightness, dyspnea on exertion.
*   **Management Protocol:**
    1.  **Immediate removal from outdoor duty.** Transfer to an indoor station with an air purifier.
    2.  Report to Occupational Health Center or nearest Primary Health Center for clinical assessment.
    3.  Administer short-acting beta-agonists (SABA) via nebulization or MDI (e.g., Salbutamol/Ipratropium). Consider a short course of corticosteroids.
    4.  Chest auscultation mandatory. Re-check SpO2 after 30 mins.
    5.  **Escalation:** If SpO2 does not improve to $> 94\%$ or drops below $92\%$, escalate to RED. Mandatory sick leave for 3-5 days.

#### **Category RED: Hospital Admission / Emergency**
*   **SpO2 Threshold:** $< 92\%$ on room air (or $< 90\%$ in any condition).
*   **Clinical Presentation:** Severe dyspnea at rest (RR $> 24$ bpm), use of accessory muscles, cyanosis (blue lips/nails), inability to speak full sentences, confusion, or high fever.
*   **Management Protocol:**
    1.  **Call Emergency Medical Services (Dial 108/112) immediately.**
    2.  Administer high-flow supplemental oxygen while awaiting transport to maintain SpO2 between 94% and 98% (88%-92% for COPD patients).
    3.  Transport to nearest facility with Pulmonary/ICU support for Chest X-ray, ABG analysis, and advanced care (HFNC or BiPAP if respiratory failure progresses).
    4.  Notify next of kin.

---

## 3. Protocols for Other Outdoor Workers

### Delivery Gig Riders & Street Vendors
*   **Risk:** High mobility increases the inhalation rate of pollutants.
*   **Protocol:** During AQI >200, enforce shift rotations (4 hours on, 4 hours off). Carry insulated warm water to soothe airways. If SpO2 drops below 94%, stop work immediately and seek clinic evaluation. Do not "push through" respiratory symptoms.

### Construction Laborers
*   **Risk:** Combined exposure to silica dust and smog exacerbates airway inflammation.
*   **Protocol:** Water sprinkling on sites is mandatory during AQI >150 to suppress dust. Ensure N95 compatibility with safety helmets. Shaded, enclosed rest areas with air purifiers are required. Persistent cough lasting >2 weeks requires screening for TB and occupational lung disease.

---

## 4. Protocols for High-Risk Commuters

### Pregnant Women
*   **Risk:** Maternal hypoxia affects fetal oxygenation; PM2.5 can cross the placental barrier.
*   **Protocol:** Avoid outdoor commuting entirely during AQI >300. During AQI 150-299, use enclosed AC transport with recirculation and wear an N95 for essential medical visits only. Monitor fetal movement regularly.
*   **Emergency:** Any SpO2 drop below 94-95% requires immediate obstetric consultation.

### Asthmatic Children
*   **Risk:** Smog triggers acute exacerbations and status asthmaticus, impacting lung development.
*   **Protocol:** Schools must move physical education indoors and cancel outdoor assemblies during AQI >200. Rescue inhalers must be carried at all times.
*   **Emergency:** If a rescue inhaler provides no relief within 15 minutes, or if SpO2 $< 92\%$, proceed to the Pediatric Emergency immediately.

### Geriatric Citizens (65+)
*   **Risk:** Reduced lung reserve, higher cardiac strain, and risk of silent hypoxia.
*   **Protocol:** Morning walks are prohibited during AQI >150. Keep windows closed and use indoor air purifiers. Schedule fluid intake, as the elderly often lack a strong thirst mechanism.
*   **Emergency:** Confusion or drowsiness alongside a cough is a critical sign of CO2 retention/hypoxia. Immediate hospitalization is required regardless of the SpO2 reading.

---

## 5. Emergency Action Plan & Reporting (AQI 500+)
1.  **Work Suspension:** Non-essential outdoor work is suspended. Traffic police move to enclosed booths.
2.  **Health Camps:** Mobile medical units deployed to major intersections and labor hubs to check SpO2 and distribute N95 masks.
3.  **Hospital Preparedness:** EDs must stockpile nebulizers, oxygen concentrators, and corticosteroids. Triage areas must have air purifiers.
4.  **Documentation:** All outdoor workers must log SpO2 readings at the start and end of shifts during AQI 200+ events. All RED category triage events must be reported to the Occupational Health Safety Officer within 24 hours for workplace hazard assessment and compensation claims.

*   **నిషేధం:** షిఫ్ట్‌ల సమయంలో కెఫిన్ మరియు చక్కెర సోడాలు నిషేధించబడ్డాయి, ఎందుకంటే అవి మూత్రవిసర్జన మరియు హృదయ స్పందనను పెంచుతాయి.

### C. విశ్రాంతి విరామాలు మరియు హృదయ స్పందన కోలుకోవడం (HRR)
*   **షెడ్యూల్:** 10-నిమిషాల నీడ విశ్రాంతి విరామం ప్రతి 2 గంటలకు (AQI 150–300); ప్రతి గంటకు 15-నిమిషాల విశ్రాంతి (AQI 301–500+).
*   **పనితీరు మెట్రిక్:** HRR తనిఖీ. కార్మికులు కార్యకలాపాలు ఆపిన వెంటనే నాడిని కొలవాలి, తర్వాత 1 నిమిషం విశ్రాంతి తర్వాత మళ్ళీ కొలవాలి.
*   **భద్రతా థ్రెషోల్డ్:** 1 నిమిషం విశ్రాంతి తర్వాత హృదయ స్పందన కనీసం 12 బీట్స్ పర్ మినిట్ (bpm) తగ్గకపోతే, కార్మికుడు శారీరక ఒత్తిడిని ప్రదర్శిస్తున్నాడు. వారు 30 నిమిషాల పాటు విధుల నుండి విడుదల చేయబడాలి, హైడ్రేట్ చేసుకోవాలి మరియు తనిఖీని పునరావృతం చేయాలి. HRR <12 bpmగా ఉంటే, 24 గంటల పాటు షిఫ్ట్‌ను ముగించండి.

## 3. అధిక ప్రమాదంలో ఉన్న ప్రయాణికుల రక్షణ ప్రోటోకాల్‌లు

*   **గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు:** AQI 300+ సమయంలో సున్నా బహిరంగ బహిర్గతం సిఫార్సు చేయబడింది. పార్టిక్యులేట్ మ్యాటర్ ప్లాసెంటల్ అవరోధాన్ని దాటగలదు, భ్రూణ వృద్ధి నిరోధానికి ప్రమాదం కలిగిస్తుంది. హైపోక్సియా వల్ల తీవ్రమయ్యే ప్రీ-ఎక్లాంప్సియా లక్షణాల కోసం పర్యవేక్షించండి (తలనొప్పి, దృష్టి మార్పులు). ప్రయాణం అత్యవసరమైతే తప్పనిసరిగా N95 వాడాలి.
*   **ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు:** రెస్క్యూ ఇన్‌హేలర్లు (సాల్బుటామోల్) ఎల్లప్పుడూ తీసుకెళ్లాలి. AQI > 150 ఉన్నప్పుడు పాఠశాల బహిరంగ కార్యకలాపాలు (PT, క్రీడలు) రద్దు చేయాలి. సంరక్షకులు ఇంటి నుండి బయలుదేరే ముందు పిల్లల పరిమాణంలో ఉన్న N95లపై సీల్‌ను సరిచూడాలి; శ్వాస నిరోధకం ఎక్కువగా ఉంటే, వెంటనే లోపలి ఆశ్రయం అవసరం.
*   **వృద్ధ పౌరులు:** ఉదయం నడకలు మానుకోండి (గరిష్ట కాలుష్య సమయాలు ఉదయం 6–10). AQI 500+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో ఇంట్లో HEPA ఎయిర్ ప్యూరిఫైయర్‌లను ఉపయోగించండి. రోజుకు రెండుసార్లు ఇంట్లో పల్స్ ఆక్సిమీటర్‌లను ఉపయోగించండి.

## 4. క్లినికల్ అత్యవసర మరియు SpO2 ఆసుపత్రి ట్రయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లు
*ఉద్దేశ్యం: తీవ్రమైన హృదయనాళ సంఘటనలు (స్ట్రోక్, మయోకార్డియల్ ఇన్ఫార్క్షన్), హైపోక్సిక్ గాయం మరియు శ్వాసకోశ వైఫల్యాన్ని నివారించడం.*

AQI 300+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో లేదా లక్షణాలు (ఛాతీ బిగుతు, చక్కెరలు, శ్వాస తీసుకోవడంలో ఇబ్బంది) సంభవించినప్పుడు అన్ని లక్ష్య జనాభా వర్గాలు పల్స్ ఆక్సిమీటర్‌లను ఉపయోగించి ఆక్సిజన్ సంతృప్తత (SpO2) ను పర్యవేక్షించాలి.

### A. SpO2 ట్రయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లు
| జనాభా సమూహం | **గ్రీన్ జోన్ (సురక్షితం)** | **యెల్లో జోన్ (జాగ్రత్త/సలహా)** | **రెడ్ జోన్ (అత్యవసర ట్రయేజ్)** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **బహిరంగ కార్మికులు** | 95% – 100% | 93% – 94% (వెంటనే విశ్రాంతి) | **≤ 92%** (వెంటనే ER) |
| **గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు** | 95% – 100% | 94% (క్లినిక్ సందర్శన) | **≤ 93%** (వెంటనే ER) |
| **ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు** | 95% – 100% | 93% – 94% (నెబులైజేషన్) | **≤ 92%** (వెంటనే ER) |
| **వృద్ధ పౌరులు** | 94% – 100% | 92% – 93% (ఆక్సిజన్ థెరపీ) | **≤ 91%** (వెంటనే ER) |

### B. అత్యవసర చర్య ప్రణాళిక (రెడ్ జోన్ యాక్టివేషన్)
SpO2 రెడ్ జోన్‌లోకి పడిపోతే, లేదా లక్షణాల ఆధారిత అత్యవసర ట్రిగ్గర్లు సంభవిస్తే (ఛాతీ నొప్పి/బిగుతు, ఆకస్మిక గందరగోళం/చక్కెరలు, విశ్రాంతిలో పల్స్ >120 bpm, సయానోసిస్), కింది వాటిని అమలు చేయండి:
1.  **వెంటనే ఆపివేత:** అన్ని శారీరక కార్యకలాపాలను వెంటనే ఆపండి.
2.  **ఆక్సిజన్ సపోర్ట్:** అందుబాటులో ఉంటే సప్లిమెంటరీ ఆక్సిజన్ ఇవ్వండి.
3.  **ఆసుపత్రి ట్రయేజ్:** దగ్గరలోని ఎమర్జెన్సీ డిపార్ట్‌మెంట్‌కు తరలించండి. అంబులెన్స్ సపోర్ట్ కోసం **112** (ఇండియా ఎమర్జెన్సీ రెస్పాన్స్) నంబర్‌కు డయల్ చేయండి.
    *   *హృదయ మూల్యాంకనం (ECG):* అధిక హృదయనాళ ఒత్తిడి మరియు సైలెంట్ ఇస్కెమియా ప్రమాదం కారణంగా వృద్ధ పౌరులు మరియు ట్రాఫిక్ పోలీసుకు ప్రాధాన్యత.
    *   *పల్మనరీ ఫంక్షన్ మరియు నెబులైజేషన్:* ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు మరియు డెలివరీ రైడర్లకు ప్రాధాన్యత.
    *   *భ్రూణ పర్యవేక్షణ:* గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలకు ప్రాధాన్యత.

## 5. అమలు మరియు అమలు చేయడం ఫ్రేమ్‌వర్క్
*   **గిగ్ ప్లాట్‌ఫామ్‌లు:** రైడర్ యాప్‌లలో AQI డేటాను ఏకీకృతం చేయాలి. నిర్దిష్ట జోన్లలో AQI > 450 ఉన్నప్పుడు డెలివరీలపై ఆటోమేటిక్ పాజ్ విధించాలి, N95 కంప్లైయన్స్ ఫోటో అప్‌లోడ్ ద్వారా ధృవీకరించబడకపోతే.
*   **ట్రాఫిక్ శాఖలు:** ప్రధాన కూడళ్ల వద్ద మొబైల్ ఎయిర్ క్వాలిటీ మానిటరింగ్ వ్యాన్‌లను మోహరించాలి. పోలీసు బూత్‌ల వద్ద N95 స్టాక్‌లను సరఫరా చేయాలి మరియు AQI > 300 ఉన్నప్పుడు ప్రతి 60 నిమిషాలకు సిబ్బందిని లోపలి బూత్‌లకు మార్చాలి.
*   **నిర్మాణ సైట్‌లు:** AQI > 450 ఉన్నప్పుడు బహిరంగ పనికి తప్పనిసరి సైట్ షట్‌డౌన్ (గ్రేడెడ్ రెస్పాన్స్ యాక్షన్ ప్లాన్ కంప్లైయన్స్). AQI > 250 ఉన్నప్పుడు భారీ ఎత్తున లిఫ్టింగ్ నిషేధించబడింది.
*   **వైద్య పర్యవేక్షణ:** క్రీడా వైద్య నిపుణులు శాశ్వత బహిరంగ సిబ్బంది కోసం త్రైమాసిక ఊపిరితిత్తుల పనితీరు (స్పైరోమెట్రీ) మరియు హృదయనాళ ఒత్తిడి పరీక్షలు నిర్వహించాలి.

**వైద్యుడి గమనిక:** ఈ ప్రోటోకాల్ ఉత్పాదకత కంటే జీవితానికి ప్రాధాన్యత ఇస్తుంది. AQI 500+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో, ఏకైక సురక్షితమైన పనితీరు మెట్రిక్ సున్నా బహిర్గతం. భారతీయ నగర సందర్భంలో దీర్ఘకాలిక హృదయనాళ నష్టం మరియు తీవ్రమైన మరణాలను నివారించడానికి N95 మాండేట్‌లు, హైడ్రేషన్ మరియు SpO2 థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లకు కట్టుబడి ఉండటం కీలకం.

## ১. একিউআই (AQI) ঝুঁকি অঞ্চল ও সক্রিয়করণ স্তর
*   **একিউআই ১৫০–২০০ (মাঝারি/খারাপ):** ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ গোষ্ঠী দীর্ঘক্ষণ ধরে বহিরঙ্গন শারীরিক পরিশ্রম কমাবে। উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ গোষ্ঠীর জন্য এন৯৫/এফএফপি২ (FFP2) রেসপিরেটর সুপারিশ করা হয়।
*   **একিউআই ২০০–৩০০ (খুব খারাপ):** সমস্ত বহিরঙ্গন শ্রমিক এবং উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীদের জন্য এন৯৫/এফএফপি২ মাস্ক বাধ্যতামূলক। অপ্রয়োজনীয় ভ্রমণ থেকে উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ গোষ্ঠীকে বিরত থাকতে হবে।
*   **একিউআই ৩০০–৫০০+ (মারাত্মক/বিপজ্জনক):** কঠোর এন৯৫ বাধ্যবাধকতা এবং কর্মক্ষেত্রে বিরতি জোরদার করা হবে। বহিরঙ্গন সংস্পর্শ শুধুমাত্র অপরিহার্য কার্যক্রমে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখতে হবে। গর্ভবতী নারী এবং বয়োজ্যেষ্ঠ নাগরিকদের জন্য জরুরি প্রোটোকল সক্রিয় থাকবে।

## ২. বিশেষায়িত প্রতিরোধমূলক যত্ন নির্দেশিকা: গর্ভবতী নারী (উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রী)
*ফোকাস: একিউআই ২০০+ ঘটনার সময় মাতৃ হাইপোক্সিয়া প্রতিরোধ এবং ভ্রূণের ঝুঁকি হ্রাস*

একিউআই ২০০+ ঘটনার সময়, সূক্ষ্ম কণা (PM2.5) মাতৃ অক্সিজেন সম্পৃক্ততা হ্রাস করতে পারে, যা সম্ভাব্যভাবে ভ্রূণের হাইপোক্সিয়ার দিকে নিয়ে যেতে পারে। ভ্রূণের বৃদ্ধির কারণে অক্সিজেনের চাহিদা বৃদ্ধি পাওয়ায় গর্ভবতী নারীদের উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ হিসেবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করা হয়।

### এন৯৫ রেসপিরেটর প্রোটোকল
পিএম২.৫ ব্লক করতে এন৯৫ মাস্ক অপরিহার্য (যা প্লাসেন্টাল ব্যারিয়ার অতিক্রম করে কম জন্ম ওজন বা অকাল জন্মের কারণ হতে পারে), তবে এটি শ্বাস নেওয়ার প্রচেষ্টা বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
*   **বাধ্যবাধকতা:** বাইরে থাকার সময় বা খারাপভাবে বাতাস চলাচলকারী পরিবহনে থাকাকালীন সার্টিফাইড এন৯৫/এফএফপি২ মাস্ক পরুন।
*   **ফিট চেক:** স্মগের অনুপ্রবেশ রোধ করতে শক্ত সিল নিশ্চিত করুন, তবে স্ট্র্যাপ অতিরিক্ত শক্ত করবেন না, যা উদ্বেগ বা প্যানিক-জনিত অতিশ্বাসের (হাইপারভেন্টিলেশন) কারণ হতে পারে।
*   **সময়কাল ও পরিবর্তন:** টানা পরা ৪–৬ ঘণ্টার মধ্যে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখুন। মাস্কটি আর্দ্র হয়ে গেলে তা সাথে সাথে নতুন মাস্ক দিয়ে পরিবর্তন করুন, কারণ আর্দ্রতা শ্বাস নেওয়ার প্রতিরোধ বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
*   **গতি নিয়ন্ত্রণ:** স্মগের মধ্যে এন৯৫ পরা অবস্থায় কঠোর শারীরিক কার্যকলাপ (সিঁড়ি বেয়ে ওঠা, দৌড়ানো) এড়িয়ে চলুন।

### মাতৃ হাইপোক্সিয়া এবং ভ্রূণের যন্ত্রণার লক্ষণসমূহ
ভ্রূণের যন্ত্রণা ক্লিনিক্যালি হাসপাতালে কার্ডিওটোকোগ্রাফি (CTG)-এর মাধ্যমে নিশ্চিত করা হয়, তবে মাতৃ পালস অক্সিমিটারি একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ প্রাথমিক সতর্কতা ট্রায়াজ সরঞ্জাম হিসেবে কাজ করে। গর্ভাবস্থায় শারীরবৃত্তীয় পরিবর্তনের কারণে, SpO2-এর হ্রাস সহ্য করা কঠিন হয়।

*   **SpO2 ৯৫%–১০০%:** স্বাভাবিক। পর্যবেক্ষণ চালিয়ে যান।
*   **SpO2 ৯৩%–৯৪%:** **সতর্কতা অঞ্চল।** সাথে সাথে স্মগযুক্ত পরিবেশ থেকে সরে আসুন। পরিষ্কার বাতাসযুক্ত পরিবেশে (HEPA ফিল্টারযুক্ত) বিশ্রাম নিন। আপনার গাইনি বিশেষজ্ঞকে (OB-GYN) জানান। দীর্ঘস্থায়ী মাত্রা থাকলে ভ্রূণের যন্ত্রণা বাতিল করার জন্য তাৎক্ষণিক প্রসূতি পর্যবেক্ষণের প্রয়োজন।
*   **SpO2 < ৯৩%:** **গুরুতর ট্রায়াজ থ্রেশহোল্ড।** এটি উল্লেখযোগ্য মাতৃ হাইপোক্সিয়া নির্দেশ করে, যা ভ্রূণের হাইপোক্সিয়া এবং যন্ত্রণার গুরুতর ঝুঁকি তৈরি করে। **তাৎক্ষণিক হাসপাতাল ট্রায়াজ এবং ইমার্জেন্সি রুম মূল্যায়ন প্রয়োজন।**
*   **জরুরি যত্নের প্রয়োজন এমন লক্ষণসমূহ:** ভ্রূণের নড়াচড়া কমে যাওয়া, তীব্র ডিসপনিয়া (পুরো বাক্য বলতে অক্ষমতা), ট্যাকিকার্ডিয়া (বিশ্রামে মাতৃ হৃদস্পন্দন >১০০ বিপিএম), মাথা ঘোরা, বা সায়ানোসিস (ঠোঁট/নখ নীল হয়ে যাওয়া)।

### হাইড্রেশন ও বিশ্রাম
*   **হাইড্রেশন:** মিউকোসাল ব্যারিয়ার এবং রক্ত সঞ্চালন বজায় রাখতে দৈনিক ৩–৪ লিটার পানি পান করুন।
*   **বিশ্রাম:** ইনডোর, বায়ু পরিশোধিত পরিবেশে প্রতি ২ ঘণ্টায় বাধ্যতামূলক ১৫ মিনিটের বিশ্রাম বিরতি নিন। "বাতাসের ক্ষুধা" অনুভূত হলে ডায়াফ্রাগমাটিক শ্বাস-প্রশ্বাস অনুশীলন করুন।

## ৩. কর্মসংস্থান স্বাস্থ্য প্রোটোকল: ভারতীয় বহিরঙ্গন শ্রমিক
*লক্ষ্য গোষ্ঠী: ডেলিভারি গিগ রাইডার, ট্রাফিক পুলিশ, নির্মাণ শ্রমিক, রাস্তার পাশের বিক্রেতা*

### এন৯৫ রেসপিরেটর বাধ্যবাধকতা
*   **নিয়োগকর্তা/প্ল্যাটফর্মের দায়িত্ব:** একিউআই ২০০+ ঘটনার সময় ডেলিভারি প্ল্যাটফর্ম এবং পৌরসভাগুলিকে বিনামূল্যে এন৯৫ মাস্ক প্রদান করতে হবে।
*   **প্রয়োগ:** ট্রাফিক পুলিশ এবং নির্মাণস্থলের তদারকদের মাস্ক ব্যবহার নিশ্চিত করতে হবে। অমান্য করলে বহিরঙ্গন দায়িত্ব থেকে বাধ্যতামূলকভাবে সরিয়ে দেওয়া হবে।
*   **বিশেষায়িত বিষয়:** যদি কাছাকাছি ভিড়ের সংস্পর্শে না আসেন, তবে আরামের জন্য ট্রাফিক পুলিশ এক্সহালেশন ভালভযুক্ত এন৯৫ ব্যবহার করতে পারেন। স্থানীয় ধুলোর সমন্বয়ের কারণে নির্মাণ শ্রমিকদের একিউআই ১৫০+ হলেও এন৯৫ পরতে হবে।

### বাধ্যতামূলক হাইড্রেশন ও বিশ্রাম বিরতি
*   **হাইড্রেশন স্টেশন:** পৌরসংস্থা এবং নিয়োগকর্তাদের পরিষ্কার পানি/ওআরএস (ORS) কিয়স্ক প্রদান করতে হবে। বহিরঙ্গন সংস্পর্শের সময় প্রতি ঘণ্টায় ২৫০–৩০০ মিলি পানি পান করুন।
*   **বিরতির সময়সূচি (একিউআই ২০০–৩০০):** ছায়াযুক্ত বা ইনডোর, ফিল্টারযুক্ত এলাকায় প্রতি ৯০ মিনিট থেকে ২ ঘণ্টায় ১০ থেকে ১৫ মিনিটের বিরতি।
*   **বিরতির সময়সূচি (একিউআই ৩০০+):** প্রতি ঘণ্টায় ১৫ থেকে ২০ মিনিটের বিশ্রাম। ভারী পরিশ্রম জড়িত নির্মাণ কাজ সকাল ১০টা থেকে বিকেল ৪টার মধ্যে বন্ধ রাখতে হবে এবং একিউআই ৪০০+ হলে সমস্ত অপ্রয়োজনীয় কাজ বন্ধ করতে হবে।

### শ্রমিকদের জন্য ক্লিনিক্যাল জরুরি প্রোটোকল
*   **লক্ষণ পর্যবেক্ষণ:** তদারকদের প্রতি ঘণ্টায় শ্বাসকষ্টের লক্ষণ (কাশি, হুইজিং, হাঁপানো) লক্ষ্য করতে হবে।
*   **SpO2 ট্রায়াজ:** সাইট মেডিক বা তদারকদের যাদের কাছে পালস অক্সিমিটার আছে, তাদের শ্বাসকষ্টের অভিযোগকারী শ্রমিকদের পরীক্ষা করতে হবে।
    *   **SpO2 < ৯৪%:** সাথে সাথে দায়িত্ব থেকে সরিয়ে নিন।
    *   **SpO2 < ৯০%:** নিকটতম সুবিধায় জরুরি পরিবহন।

## ৪. অন্যান্য উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীদের জন্য প্রোটোকল
*লক্ষ্য গোষ্ঠী: হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু, বয়োজ্যেষ্ঠ নাগরিক*

*   **হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু:**
    *   একিউআই ২০০+ এর সময় বহিরঙ্গন খেলাধুলা এড়িয়ে চলুন। একিউআই ৩০০+ হলে স্কুলগুলিকে বহিরঙ্গন ক্রীড়া/সমাবেশ বাতিল করতে হবে।
    *   সবসময় রেসকিউ ইনহেলার (সালবিউটামল) সাথে রাখুন। ভ্রমণ অনিবার্য হলে শিশুদের উপযোগী এন৯৫ মাস্ক ব্যবহার করুন।
    *   **ট্রায়াজ:** যদি পিক ফ্লো মিটার ব্যক্তিগত সর্বোত্তম মানের <৫০% দেখায় বা SpO2 < ৯৪% হয়, তবে জরুরি যত্নের জন্য এগিয়ে যান।
*   **বয়োজ্যেষ্ঠ নাগরিক:**
    *   স্মগের ঘটনার সময় সকালের হাঁটা এড়িয়ে চলুন (ইনভার্সন লেয়ারগুলো মাটির কাছে দূষক পদার্থ আটকে রাখে)। ব্যায়াম ইনডোর স্থানে স্থানান্তর করুন।

## ৫. সার্বজনীন SpO2 হাসপাতাল ট্রায়াজ থ্রেশহোল্ড (স্মগ জরুরি প্রসঙ্গ)

## ৬. বাস্তবায়ন ও সম্মতি
*   **সরকারের ভূমিকা:** একিউআই ৩০০ ছাড়িয়ে গেলে এসএমএস-এর মাধ্যমে রেড অ্যালার্ট জারি করুন। গ্রেডেড রেসপন্স অ্যাকশন প্ল্যান (GRAP) পর্যায় জোরদার করুন।

# OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY MANDATE: HAZARDOUS SMOG EVENTS (AQI 150–500+)

**Applicability:** Indian Outdoor Workers (Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors) & High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens).  
**Authority:** Aligned with MoHFW, CPCB, and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020.  
**Status:** Mandatory Compliance for AQI $\ge$ 400; Advisory for AQI 150–399.

---

## 1. AQI ACTION MATRIX & WORK RESTRICTIONS

| AQI Range | Category | Mandatory Protocol for Outdoor Workers | High-Risk Commuters Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Moderate/Poor | N95 recommended during peak traffic. Hydration break every 2 hours. | Limit outdoor exposure. Use N95 for essential travel. |
| **201–300** | Very Poor | **N95 Mandatory.** 10-min rest break every 2 hours. Reduce shift intensity by 25%. | **Stay Indoors.** Essential travel only with N95. |
| **301–400** | Severe | **N95 Mandatory.** 15-min rest break every 90 mins. Reduce shift intensity by 50%. | **Complete Indoor Confinement.** No outdoor exposure. |
| **400–500+** | Severe+ | **Work Suspension Recommended.** If essential: Full N95 mandate, 15-min break every 60 mins, 500ml water/hr. Reduce intensity by 75%. | **Complete Lockdown.** Air purifiers required indoors. Emergency transport only. |

---

## 2. RESPIRATORY PROTECTION MANDATE (DELIVERY PARTNERS & OUTDOOR WORKERS)

During AQI 400+ smog events, standard cloth or surgical masks are strictly prohibited. All delivery partners and outdoor workers must utilize respirators meeting the following specifications:

*   **Certification Standard:** Must meet **NIOSH 42 CFR 84** or **BIS IS 9473:2002** standards.
*   **Filtration Efficiency:** $\ge$ 95% filtration of non-oil based airborne particles $\ge$ 0.3 microns (PM2.5).
*   **Fit & Seal:** Must feature a moldable nose clip and dual head-straps (ear-loop masks are non-compliant). User seal check required before shift start; no facial hair allowed in the sealing zone.
*   **Valve Configuration:** Exhalation valves permitted to reduce heat buildup and breathing resistance during physical labor. Non-valved masks required if working in close proximity to vulnerable populations.
*   **Replacement Cycle:** Replace every 8 hours of active use or immediately if the filter becomes damp, clogged, or breathing resistance increases.

---

## 3. HYDRATION & THERMAL REGULATION MANDATE

Mask-wearing increases respiratory water loss and traps exhaled heat, compounding heat-stress risks. To counteract dehydration:

*   **Mandatory Water Intake:** 
    *   **AQI 150–300:** Minimum **250 ml per hour** of active duty.
    *   **AQI 400+ (Severe Smog):** Minimum **500 ml per hour** (approx. 1 liter every 2 hours).
*   **Electrolyte Supplementation:** One ORS (Oral Rehydration Salt) or electrolyte solution every 4 hours to prevent hyponatremia. 
*   **Mandatory Rest Breaks:** 
    *   **AQI 150–300:** 10 minutes of shaded rest every 2 hours.
    *   **AQI 400+ (Delivery/Essential):** 15 minutes of indoor/AC "Clean Air Rest" every 60 minutes. Masks may only be removed in designated clean-air zones during breaks.

---

## 4. CLINICAL SIGNS: HEAT-STRESS COMPOUNDED BY MASK-WEARING

Supervisors and workers must screen for the following clinical signs where respirator use exacerbates thermal load:

*   **Early Warning Signs:** Profuse sweating despite adequate hydration, heat rash under mask straps, increased respiratory rate (>20 breaths/min at rest), subjective "air hunger" or claustrophobia.
*   **Critical Heat Stress Symptoms (Immediate Work Stoppage):**
    *   **Cessation of Sweating:** Skin becomes hot and dry (anhydrosis), indicating impending heatstroke.
    *   **Neurological Impairment:** Confusion, slurred speech, dizziness, or fainting (syncope).
    *   **Cardiovascular Stress:** Heart rate remains >120 bpm after 5 minutes of rest.
    *   **Gastrointestinal Distress:** Nausea or vomiting, indicating inability to retain fluids.

---

## 5. SPO2 HOSPITAL TRIAGE THRESHOLDS & EMERGENCY PROTOCOLS

Pulse oximetry screening is required for any worker reporting breathlessness during AQI 300+ events. The following $\text{SpO}_2$ thresholds trigger immediate action:

| $\text{SpO}_2$ Level | Clinical Status | Action Required |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Normal | Continue monitoring; maintain hydration and N95 use. |
| **91% – 94%** | Mild Hypoxia | **Immediate Rest.** Move to clean air zone. Remove mask. Recheck in 15 mins. If persistent, end shift and consult physician. |
| **$\le$ 90%** | Severe Hypoxia | **Hospital Triage Required.** Immediate cessation of work. Administer oxygen if available. Transport to nearest Emergency Department. |
| **< 85%** | Critical | **Call 112/108.** Life-threatening hypoxia. Immediate advanced life support required. |

---

## 6. TAILORED OCCUPATIONAL & HIGH-RISK COMMUTER PROTOCOLS

*   **Traffic Police & Street Vendors:** Use portable air purifiers at kiosks. Maximum 4-hour shifts in AQI 400+ environments, followed by 4 hours of indoor recovery.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Mandatory water spraying for dust suppression. Industrial-grade P100 respirators permitted. Implement a "Buddy System" to monitor for signs of hypoxia or heat exhaustion.
*   **Pregnant Women:** Priority access to filtered indoor waiting areas. Avoid peak smog hours. Any sustained $\text{SpO}_2$ drop below 94% requires immediate obstetric consultation due to fetal hypoxia risks.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Mandatory carry of rescue inhalers (Salbutamol). Use pediatric-sized N95 masks to ensure a proper seal. Seek emergency care if inhaler relief lasts <4 hours.
*   **Geriatric Citizens (65+):** Monitor for silent hypoxia (low $\text{SpO}_2$ without breathlessness). Lower threshold for hospital triage ($\text{SpO}_2$ < 92%). Avoid morning walks during AQI 150+.

---

## 7. IMPLEMENTATION & COMPLIANCE

*   **Gig Platforms:** Must provide compliant N95 masks and enable "Smog Pause" features allowing riders to log off during AQI 400+ without penalty. Apps must push hydration reminders every 30 minutes.
*   **Employers (Construction/Security):** Must provide shaded rest areas with air purifiers or clean air supply. Failure to provide PPE or enforce rest breaks constitutes a violation of occupational safety codes.

***
*Disclaimer: This mandate provides occupational health guidelines based on standard safety protocols. It does not replace professional medical advice. In case of medical emergency, contact local emergency services (112) or visit the nearest hospital.*
