**2. குறிப்பிட்ட முன்னெச்சரிக்கைகள்**
*   **கர்ப்பிணிப் பெண்கள்:** கருவின் அசைவு குறைதல் அல்லது தாயின் மூச்சுத் திணறல் இருக்கிறதா என கண்காணிக்கவும். உள் அறை காற்று தரத்தை கண்டிப்பாக பராமரிக்கவும் (ஜன்னல்களை மூடவும், வென்டிலேஷன்களில் ஈரமான துணி தடைகளைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்).
*   **ஆஸ்துமா உள்ள குழந்தைகள்: மீட்பு இன்ஹேலர்கள் (Salbutamol) எப்போதும் எடுத்துச் செல்லப்படுவதை உறுதி செய்யவும். பராமரிப்பு ஸ்டீராய்டு முறைகளை கண்டிப்பாகப் பின்பற்றவும். பள்ளிகள் வெளிப்புற கூட்டங்கள் மற்றும் விளையாட்டுக்களை ரத்து செய்ய வேண்டும்.**
*   **முதியோர்:** மூச்சுத் திணறல் வெளிப்படையாகத் தெரிவதற்கு முன்பே ஹைப்பாக்ஸியாவைக் குறிக்கக்கூடிய குழப்பம் அல்லது தீவிர சோர்வு போன்ற வித்தியாசமான அறிகுறிகளை கண்காணிக்கவும்.

#### III. மருத்துவ டிரையாஜ் மற்றும் மருத்துவமனை குறிப்பு வரம்புகள்
*ஆஷா பணியாளர்கள், PHC பணியாளர்கள் மற்றும் குடும்ப பராமரிப்பாளர்களுக்காக*

**1. நாடி ஆக்ஸிமெட்ரி (SpO2) டிரையாஜ் வரம்புகள்**
மூன்றாம் நிலை மருத்துவத்திற்கான தூரம் (பெரும்பாலும் >25 கிமீ) காரணமாக, உடனடி வெளியேற்றத்தை முடிவு செய்ய SpO2-ஐப் பயன்படுத்தவும்:
*   **SpO2 ≥ 94%:** வீடு/PHC-யில் நிர்வகிக்கவும். மூச்சுத்திணறல் இருந்தால் பிரான்கோடைலேட்டர்களை வழங்கவும்; நீரேற்றம் மற்றும் ஓய்வை உறுதி செய்யவும். ஒவ்வொரு 4 மணிநேரத்திற்கும் கண்காணிக்கவும்.
*   **SpO2 90% – 93%:** **உடனடி அவசரம்.** ஆக்ஸிஜன் ஆதரவுடன் அருகிலுள்ள CHC-க்கு மாற்றவும். போக்குவரத்தின் போது கிடைத்தால் நாசி கேனுலா மூலம் ஆக்ஸிஜன் வழங்கவும் (2–4 L/min). தனியார் போக்குவரத்தை எதிர்பார்க்க வேண்டாம்; 108 ஆம்புலன்ஸைக் கோரவும்.
*   **SpO2 < 90%:** **முக்கிய அவசரம்.** உடனடி உயிர் அச்சுறுத்தல். கிடைத்தால் உயர் ஓட்ட ஆக்ஸிஜனைத் தொடங்கவும். மேம்பட்ட உயிர் ஆதரவு இடைமறிப்பிற்காக 108-ஐ அழைக்கவும். மாவட்ட மருத்துவமனைக்கு வந்ததும் குழாய் செருகுதலுக்கு (intubation) தயாராக இருக்கவும். நோயாளி மயக்கமாக இருந்தால் அல்லது மூச்சு விடுவதில் சிரமப்பட்டால் தனியார் வாகன போக்குவரத்தை முயற்சிக்க வேண்டாம்.

**2. உடனடி வெளியேற்றம் தேவைப்படும் சிவப்பு கொடிகள் (SpO2-ஐப் பொருட்படுத்தாமல்)**
*   முழு வாக்கியங்களில் பேச இயலாமை.
*   சயனோசிஸ் (உதடுகள்/நகப் படுக்கைகளில் நீல நிற மாற்றம்).
*   சைலண்ட் செஸ்ட் (குறைந்த காற்று இயக்கம் காரணமாக வீசல் கேட்காத கடுமையான ஆஸ்துமா தாக்குதல்).
*   மாற்றப்பட்ட மன நிலை (குழப்பம், கிளர்ச்சி அல்லது மயக்கம்).

**அமலாக்கக் குறிப்பு:** உள்ளூர் ஆஷா பணியாளர்கள் கிராம ஒலிபெருக்கிகள் மற்றும் வாட்ஸ்அப் குழுக்கள் மூலம் இந்த நெறிமுறைகளை பரப்ப வேண்டும். PHC மருத்துவ அதிகாரிகள் தினசரி N95 இருப்பு நிலைகளை சரிபார்க்க வேண்டும்.

# Comprehensive Occupational Health & Emergency Protocol for NCR Winter Smog (AQI 150–500+)

**Scope:** This framework mandates health and safety standards for outdoor workers (construction laborers, delivery gig riders, traffic police, street vendors) and high-risk commuters (pregnant women, asthmatic children, geriatric citizens) in the National Capital Region during winter smog events.

## 1. AQI Stratification & Operational Restrictions
Protocols escalate based on real-time CPCB data:
*   **AQI 150–300 (Unhealthy to Very Poor):** N95 mandatory for all outdoor workers. Standard shifts with rest breaks every 2 hours. High-risk commuters should limit outdoor exposure.
*   **AQI 301–400 (Hazardous):** N95 mandatory with strict fit checks. Work hours reduced by 25–50%. Heavy exertion and heavy lifting for construction laborers are prohibited. High-risk commuters must remain indoors.
*   **AQI 401–500+ (Severe Hazardous):** Work suspension recommended for non-essential tasks. Essential workers require continuous SpO2 monitoring.

## 2. Respiratory Protection (N95 Mandate)
*   **Standard:** Only BIS-certified (IS 9473) or NIOSH-approved N95/FFP2 respirators are permitted. Cloth and surgical masks are prohibited.
*   **Fit Testing:** Mandatory seal check before every shift; facial hair must be trimmed to ensure a tight seal.
*   **Replacement:** Masks must be replaced every 8 hours or immediately if wet, soiled, or if breathing resistance increases.
*   **Compliance:** Site supervisors must conduct random spot checks. Non-compliance results in immediate removal from the active work zone to a filtered shelter.

## 3. Volumetric Hydration Guide & Rest Breaks
Smog increases mucosal dryness and systemic inflammation, accelerating dehydration.
*   **Construction Laborers (Heavy Exertion):** Minimum **4.0 to 6.0 liters** of water/electrolyte solution per 8-hour shift.
*   **Traffic Police, Vendors, & Delivery Riders (Moderate Exertion):** Minimum **3.0 to 3.5 liters** per shift.
*   **Frequency:** 250ml every 20–30 minutes, regardless of thirst. Mandatory ORS or salted buttermilk (chaas) twice per shift to prevent hyponatremia.
*   **Rest Breaks:** At AQI 300+, workers must take a 15-minute break every hour in a designated "Clean Air Zone" (an enclosed area with air purifiers or high-efficiency ventilation).

## 4. Sector-Specific Protocols
*   **Construction Laborers:** Water sprinkling every hour for dust suppression. Rotate workers between high-exposure (demolition/mixing) and low-exposure tasks every 2 hours.
*   **Delivery Gig Riders & Traffic Police:** Avoid known pollution hotspots. Turn off engines during waits >1 minute. Use full-face helmets with sealed visors to protect eyes from particulates.
*   **Street Vendors:** Relocate at least 50 meters from active traffic lanes during peak hours. All food must be covered.

## 5. High-Risk Commuter Protocols
*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid outdoor travel at AQI 300+. Use enclosed vehicles with cabin filters. Immediate clinic referral required for shortness of breath or reduced fetal movement.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Cancel outdoor sports and assemblies at AQI 150+. Rescue inhalers must be carried at all times. Child-sized N95 masks must be used if outdoor exposure is unavoidable.
*   **Geriatric Citizens (65+):** No morning walks or outdoor exercise at AQI 200+. Monitor blood pressure and SpO2 daily. Homes should use HEPA air purifiers.

## 6. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Triage Thresholds
Site health officers or supervisors must conduct random spot checks using calibrated pulse oximeters.

*   **95% – 100% (Normal):** Continue work with standard monitoring.
*   **93% – 94% (Caution):** **Immediate removal from the job site.** Move to a Clean Air Zone, administer hydration, and monitor for 30 minutes. If SpO2 does not improve, refer to a clinic.
*   **< 93% (Critical):** **Immediate referral to nearest clinic/hospital.** Do not allow return to work until cleared by a physician.
*   **< 90% (Emergency):** **Call ambulance (108).** Administer supplemental oxygen if available. Treat as acute hypoxemia/respiratory distress.

**Immediate ambulance transport is also required if any worker or commuter exhibits:**
*   Cyanosis (bluish tint to lips or fingernails)
*   Respiratory rate >25 breaths per minute at rest
*   Chest pain or tightness
*   Confusion, disorientation, or extreme lethargy

**Emergency Contacts:** Ambulance: **108** | National Emergency: **112** | Pollution Control Helpline: **1950**

## 1. సార్వత్రిక తప్పనిసరి రక్షణ చర్యలు (అన్ని వర్గాలు)

### 1.1 N95 రెస్పిరేటర్ తప్పనిసరి
*   **AQI 150–200:** అధిక ప్రమాదం ఉన్న వర్గాలకు N95/FFP2 మాస్క్‌లు సిఫార్సు చేయబడ్డాయి; పీక్ ట్రాఫిక్ సమయాలలో బహిరంగ కార్మికులకు తప్పనిసరి.
*   **AQI 201–500+:** ముద్ర వేయబడిన వాతావరణాల నుండి బయటకు వెళ్లే అన్ని బహిరంగ కార్మికులు మరియు అధిక ప్రమాదం ఉన్న ప్రయాణికులకు N95 రెస్పిరేటర్లు **తప్పనిసరి**. గుడ్డ లేదా సర్జికల్ మాస్క్‌లు ఖచ్చితంగా నిషిద్ధం.
*   **ఫిట్ & రీప్లేస్‌మెంట్:** గడ్డం జోక్యం లేకుండా గట్టిగా సీల్ అయ్యేలా చూసుకోండి. సున్నితమైన చర్మం ఉన్న వృద్ధ రోగులకు, పీడన వల్ల కలిగే గాయాలను నివారించడానికి వైద్యపరమైన అంటుకునే ప్యాచ్‌లను ఉపయోగించండి. మాస్క్‌లు తడిసిపోతే లేదా ప్రతి 4–8 గంటలకు మార్చండి.

### 1.2 తప్పనిసరి హైడ్రేషన్ ప్రోటోకాల్
నిర్జలీకరణ వల్ల కలిగే శ్లేష్మ పొరల ఎండడం మరియు thrombotic సంఘటనలను నివారించడానికి:
*   **బహిరంగ కార్మికులు:** ప్రతి 30–60 నిమిషాలకు కనీసం 250–300 మి.లీ. నీరు. ఉష్ణ ఒత్తిడి మరియు పొగమంచుకు గురైన కార్మికులకు ఓరల్ రీహైడ్రేషన్ సొల్యూషన్ (ORS) అవసరం.
*   **వృద్ధులు/అధిక ప్రమాదం:** ఊపిరితిత్తుల వాపును (pulmonary edema) నివారించడానికి గుండె పనితీరు మరియు మూత్రపిండాల పనితీరును బట్టి సమతుల్యం చేస్తూ, మెలకువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు ప్రతి 45 నిమిషాలకు 150 మి.లీ. నీరు.

### 1.3 తప్పనిసరి విశ్రాంతి విరామాలు
*   **బహిరంగ కార్మికులు:** ప్రతి 2 గంటలకు ఇండోర్, గాలి శుద్ధి చేయబడిన లేదా తక్కువ ట్రాఫిక్ ఉన్న ప్రాంతంలో 15–20 నిమిషాల నీడ విశ్రాంతి విరామం.
*   **అధిక ప్రమాదం ఉన్న ప్రయాణికులు:** AQI 350+ సమయంలో బహిరంగ ప్రదేశాల్లో గడపే సమయాన్ని <30 నిమిషాల కంటే తక్కువగా పరిమితం చేయండి.

## 2. ఆక్యుపేషనల్ హెల్త్ ప్రోటోకాల్స్ (భారతీయ బహిరంగ కార్మికులు)

### 2.1 డెలివరీ గిగ్ రైడర్లు & ట్రాఫిక్ పోలీసులు
*   **ప్రమాదం:** శ్వాస స్థాయి వద్ద వాహనాల పొగానికి దీర్ఘకాలికంగా గురికావడం.
*   **ప్రోటోకాల్:** AQI 300+ సమయంలో వరుసగా 4 గంటలకు మించి బహిర్గతం కాకుండా ఉండటానికి షిఫ్టులను మార్చండి. పీక్ పొగమంచు సమయాలలో తెలిసిన రద్దీ ప్రాంతాలను నివారించండి. పార్టిక్యులేట్ మ్యాటర్ (PM2.5) ను తొలగించడానికి షిఫ్ట్ తర్వాత తప్పనిసరిగా నాసికా ఉప్పు నీటి శుభ్రపరచడం (nasal saline irrigation) చేయండి.
*   **అత్యవసరం:** SpO2 94% కంటే తగ్గినట్లయితే లేదా ఛాతీ బిగుతుగా అనిపిస్తే వెంటనే పనిని ఆపివేయండి.

### 2.2 నిర్మాణ కార్మికులు & వీధి వ్యాపారులు
*   **ప్రమాదం:** శారీరక శ్రమ కాలుష్యాల పీల్చుకునే రేటును పెంచుతుంది.
*   **ప్రోటోకాల్:** AQI 350+ సమయంలో షిఫ్టులు 06:00–10:00 మరియు 16:00–20:00 కు పరిమితం చేయండి. శారీరక పనిభారాన్ని 50% తగ్గించండి మరియు AQI 400+ సమయంలో భారీ ఎత్తిమోయడాన్ని నిషేధించండి. విరామాల కోసం "క్లీన్ ఎయిర్ జోన్స్" (గాలి శుద్ధి యంత్రాలు/మిస్టింగ్ స్టేషన్లతో కూడిన టెంట్లు) ఏర్పాటు చేయండి.
*   **అత్యవసరం:** స్పృహ తప్పడం (syncope) లేదా తీవ్రమైన శ్వాసకోశ ఇబ్బంది సంభవించినట్లయితే వెంటనే వైద్య సహాయం కోసం రెఫర్ చేయండి.

---

## 3. అధిక ప్రమాదం ఉన్న ప్రయాణికుల ప్రోటోకాల్స్

### 3.1 గర్భిణీలు & ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు
*   **గర్భిణీలు:** AQI 250+ సమయంలో బహిరంగ ప్రయాణాన్ని నివారించండి. రీసర్క్యులేటెడ్ ACతో కిటికీలు మూసివేయబడిన వాహనాలను ఉపయోగించండి. హైపోక్సియా లక్షణాలను (తలతిరగడం, వేగంగా గుండె కొట్టుకోవడం) గమనించండి.
*   **ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు:** AQI 200+ సమయంలో బహిరంగ ఆటలు నిషిద్ధం. AQI 150+ సమయంలో పాఠశాల ప్రయాణానికి పిల్లల పరిమాణంలో ఉండే N95 మాస్క్‌లు అవసరం. రెస్క్యూ ఇన్‌హేలర్లు (సాల్బుటమోల్) ఎల్లప్పుడూ తీసుకువెళ్లాలి. పీక్ ఫ్లో మీటర్‌ను రోజుకు రెండుసార్లు ఉపయోగించండి.

---

## 4. ప్రత్యేక క్లినికల్ మార్గదర్శకం: హృదయ సంబంధిత వ్యాధులు (CVD) ఉన్న వృద్ధ పౌరులు (70+)

**అమలు:** AQI 350+ (చాలా పేలవం నుండి తీవ్రం).
**పాథోఫిజియాలజీ:** PM2.5 వ్యవస్థాగత మంటను, రక్తనాళాల సంకోచాన్ని మరియు రక్తం స్నిగ్ధతను పెంచుతుంది, ఇది ఇస్కెమిక్ హృదయ వ్యాధి మరియు గుండె వైఫల్యాన్ని మరింత తీవ్రతరం చేస్తుంది.

### 4.1 పల్స్ ఆక్సిమెట్రీ పర్యవేక్షణ ప్రోటోకాల్
*   **పౌనఃపున్యం:** 
    *   **AQI 350–450:** మెలకువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు ప్రతి 4 గంటలకు SpO2 తనిఖీ చేయండి.
    *   **AQI 450+:** మెలకువగా ఉన్నప్పుడు ప్రతి 2 గంటలకు SpO2 తనిఖీ చేయండి.
    *   **శ్రమ తర్వాత/లక్షణాలు:** శ్వాసకోశ ఇబ్బంది, ఛాతీ బిగుతు లేదా ఏదైనా కదలిక (ఇంటి లోపల నడక కూడా) తర్వాత వెంటనే తనిఖీ చేయండి.
*   **బేస్‌లైన్:** వ్యక్తిగత బేస్‌లైన్‌ను నిర్ణయించడానికి ఆరోగ్యకరమైన గాలి రోజులలో (సాధారణంగా 94–98%) SpO2 ను రికార్డ్ చేయండి.

### 4.2 'పొగమంచు వల్ల కలిగే' శ్వాసకోశ ఇబ్బంది (Dyspnea) నిర్వహణ
*   **తక్షణ చర్య:** 
    1.  అన్ని శారీరక కార్యకలాపాలను ఆపివేయండి. HEPA గాలి శుద్ధి యంత్రం ఉన్న లేదా కిటికీలు మూసివేయబడిన ఇండోర్ గదికి వెళ్లండి.
    2.  ఊపిరితిత్తుల విస్తరణను గరిష్టీకరించడానికి హై ఫౌలర్స్ లేదా ట్రైపాడ్ స్థానంలో (ముందుకు వంగి కూర్చోవడం) ఉండండి.
    3.  గాలి చిక్కుకోవడాన్ని తగ్గించడానికి పర్స్డ్-లిప్ బ్రీతింగ్ (2 సెకన్లు పీల్చండి, 4 సెకన్లు వదలండి) చేయండి.
*   **ఔషధ జోక్యం:** 
    *   శ్వాసలో శీల్ ఉంటే స్పేసర్ ద్వారా సూచించబడిన షార్ట్-యాక్టింగ్ బీటా-అగోనిస్ట్స్ (SABA) ఇవ్వండి.
    *   గుండె ఛాతీ బిగుతు లేదా వాపు ఉంటే వైద్యుడి స్టాండింగ్ ఆర్డర్ల ప్రకారం సూచించబడిన నైట్రేట్స్ లేదా మూత్రవిసర్జన మందులు (diuretics) ఇవ్వండి.
    *   శ్వాస ప్రేరణను అణచివేయగల సెడేటివ్‌లను స్వయంగా వాడకూడదు.
*   **గుండె హెచ్చరిక:** శ్వాసకోశ ఇబ్బందితో పాటు చెమటలు పట్టడం, చేతి/దవడలో నొప్పి విస్తరించడం లేదా సైనోసిస్ ఉంటే, SpO2 స్థాయిలతో సంబంధం లేకుండా దీనిని అక్యూట్ కొరోనరీ సిండ్రోమ్ (ACS) గా పరిగణించి వెంటనే 112 కు డయల్ చేయండి.

### 4.3 తప్పనిసరి హైడ్రేషన్ షెడ్యూల్ (శ్లేష్మ పొరల రక్షణ)
వృద్ధ రోగులకు దాహం అనిపించే ప్రక్రియ తగ్గుతుంది; నిర్జలీకరణ శ్లేష్మాన్ని గాఢత చేస్తుంది, సిలియరీ క్లియరెన్స్‌ను దెబ్బతీస్తుంది మరియు thrombosis ప్రమాదాన్ని పెంచుతుంది.
*   **ఉదయం 07:00:** 200 మి.లీ. గోరువెచ్చని నీరు (లేచిన వెంటనే).
*   **మధ్యాహ్నం 11:00:** 150 మి.లీ. నీరు లేదా హెర్బల్ టీ (నెమ్మదిగా తాగండి).
*   **మధ్యాహ్నం 02:00:** 150–200 మి.లీ. నీరు (భోజనం తర్వాత).
*   **సాయంత్రం 05:00:** 150 మి.లీ. నీరు.
*   **రాత్రి 08:00:** 100 మి.లీ. నీరు.
*   **రాత్రిపూట:** శ్లేష్మ పొరల తేమను కాపాడటానికి ప్రతి 6 గంటలకు సలైన్ నాసికా స్ప్రే (వైద్యపరం కానిది).
*   **నియంత్రణ:** నిద్రకు అంతరాయం కలిగించే నాక్ట్యూరియాను నివారించడానికి 20:00 తర్వాత అధిక ద్రవాలను తీసుకోవడం మానుకోండి, హృదయ వైఫల్యానికి క్లినికల్ సూచనలు లేనంత వరకు. కెఫిన్/ఆల్కహాల్ మానుకోండి.

---

## 5. క్లినికల్ అత్యవసర & SpO2 హాస్పిటల్ ట్రైయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్స్

AQI 150–500+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో అన్ని వర్గాలు ఈ క్రింది ట్రైయేజ్ థ్రెషోల్డ్‌లను పాటించాలి.

| SpO2 స్థాయి | క్లినికల్ స్థితి | చర్య ప్రోటోకాల్ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | సాధారణం | ఇంటి పర్యవేక్షణను కొనసాగించండి; హైడ్రేషన్‌ను నిర్వహించండి. |
| **93% – 94%** | తేలికపాటి హైపోక్సియా | **విశ్రాంతి విరామం తప్పనిసరి.** ఇండోర్ గాలి శుద్ధిని పెంచండి; సూచించబడితే అనుబంధ $O_2$ ను ప్రారంభించండి. ప్రాథమిక వైద్యుడిని సంప్రదించండి. |
| **90% – 92%** | మితమైన హైపోక్సియా | **అత్యవసర హెచ్చరిక.** వెంటనే ED మూల్యాంకనం. అత్యవసర మందులు (ఇన్‌హేలర్లు/నైట్రేట్లు) ఇవ్వండి. ఆసుపత్రి రవాణాకు సిద్ధం కాండి. |
| **< 90%** | తీవ్రమైన హైపోక్సియా | **తక్షణ ఆసుపత్రి ట్రైయేజ్.** అత్యవసర సేవలను (108/112) పిలవండి. అంబులెన్స్ ఆలస్యమైతే, కిటికీలు మూసివేసి AC ను రీసర్క్యులేట్‌లో ఉంచి ప్రైవేట్ వాహనంలో వెళ్లండి. |
| **>4% పడిపోవడం** | సైలెంట్ హైపోక్సియా | SpO2 1 గంటలో బేస్‌లైన్ కంటే >4% పడిపోతే, లేదా వ్యక్తిగత ఇబ్బంది లేకుండా <92% ఉంటే (వృద్ధులు/CVD రోగులలో సాధారణం), పరిశీలన కోసం చేర్చుకోండి. |
| **ఏ స్థాయి అయినా** | **రెడ్ ఫ్లాగ్స్** | **తక్షణ ట్రైయేజ్** ఒకవేళ ఇవి ఉంటే: సైనోసిస్, గందరగోళం, పూర్తి వాక్యాలు మాట్లాడలేకపోవడం, టాకీకార్డియా (>110 bpm), లేదా ఛాతీ నొప్పి. |

**భారతీయ సందర్భం కోసం గమనిక:** పీక్ పొగమంచు సీజన్లలో (అక్టోబర్–జనవరి), CVD ఉన్న వృద్ధ రోగులు, AQI 500+ సంఘటనల సమయంలో ఇంటి SpO2 స్థిరంగా తగ్గుముఖం పట్టినట్లయితే ప్రాధాన్యత ఆక్సిజన్ మద్దతు కోసం స్థానిక ప్రాథమిక ఆరోగ్య కేంద్రాలలో (PHC) ముందుగా నమోదు చేసుకోవాలి.

| AQI Range | Category | Operational Status | PPE Requirement |

| **150 – 200** | Moderate-Unhealthy | Normal Ops with Precautions | N95/FFP2 Mandatory |
| **201 – 300** | Poor | Reduced Exertion Protocol | N95/FFP2 + Eye Protection |
| **301 – 400** | Very Poor | Critical Reduction Protocol | N95/FFP2 + Full Face Shield |
| **401 – 500+** | Severe/Hazardous | **Work Suspension** (Except Emergencies) | N95/FFP2 if movement essential |

---

## 3. MANDATORY PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT (PPE)
*   **Standard:** All outdoor workers must wear BIS-certified N95 or FFP2 respirators without exhalation valves (to prevent mutual contamination in dense traffic). Cloth and surgical masks are prohibited.
*   **Fit Check:** Workers must perform a seal check every shift. Facial hair interfering with the seal is prohibited.
*   **Replacement:** Masks must be replaced every 8 hours or immediately if soiled, wet, or damaged.
*   **Distribution:** Gig platforms and municipal corporations must provide free N95 masks during AQI >150 events.

---

## 4. MANDATORY HYDRATION AND REST BREAKS
Physical exertion increases respiration rate, deepening pollutant intake into alveolar tissue. Hydration supports mucociliary clearance in the lungs.

### 4.1. Hydration Requirements
*   **Baseline:** Minimum 3 liters of water per 8-hour shift (approx. 250-500ml every hour).
*   **Electrolytes:** Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) or electrolyte drinks mandatory for shifts exceeding 2 hours of continuous outdoor exposure in AQI >300.
*   **Prohibition:** Caffeine and alcohol are prohibited during shifts as they accelerate dehydration.

### 4.2. Rest Break Intervals
Rest must occur in indoor, air-filtered, or clean-air environments.
*   **AQI 150–200:** 10 to 15-minute rest break every 2 hours.
*   **AQI 201–300:** 15-minute rest break every 90 minutes.
*   **AQI 301–400:** 20-minute rest break every 60 minutes.
*   **AQI 401–500+:** Work suspension. If movement is essential, 30-minute rest break every 45 minutes.

---

## 5. SECTOR-SPECIFIC OCCUPATIONAL PROTOCOLS

### 5.1. Delivery Gig Riders (Primary Focus)
*   **Exertion Management:** Avoid "rapid-delivery" sprinting and rapid acceleration to limit heavy breathing. Use eco-mode or low-gear settings on vehicles.
*   **Route Planning:** Avoid known pollution hotspots (e.g., Silk Board Junction, Majestic Bus Stand) even if routes are longer. Use side streets with better ventilation.
*   **Platform Duty:** Apps must disable "rush mode" incentives and mandate algorithmic "cool-off" lockouts (15 mins after 2 hours) during AQI >300 to prevent hyperventilation.

### 5.2. Traffic Police Personnel
*   **Stationary Exposure:** Retreat to air-conditioned/portable air-purified booths during peak pollution hours (8–10 AM, 5–8 PM).
*   **Rotation:** Mandatory rotation away from high-density intersections every 45 to 60 minutes during AQI >300.
*   **Monitoring:** Squad leaders must carry pulse oximeters for random spot checks.

### 5.3. Construction Laborers
*   **Dust Suppression:** Water sprinkling on site is mandatory every 30 minutes to suppress dust compounding smog.
*   **Task Modification:** Heavy lifting, demolition, and cement mixing must cease during AQI >300. Shift to light duty indoors.
*   **Shelter:** Designated clean-air rest rooms with air purifiers must be available on-site.

### 5.4. Street Vendors
*   **Location:** Relocate stalls away from immediate exhaust zones (minimum 5 meters from idling vehicles).
*   **Cooking:** Use LPG/Electric stoves only; charcoal/wood burning is prohibited during AQI >200.
*   **Protection:** Install transparent polyethylene barriers around food prep areas to prevent particulate settlement.

---

## 6. HIGH-RISK COMMUTER ADVISORY

### 6.1. Pregnant Women
*   **Travel:** Avoid outdoor travel during AQI >200. If necessary (antenatal visits), use AC vehicles with recirculation mode.
*   **Symptoms:** Immediate medical consult required for dizziness, reduced fetal movement, or shortness of breath.

### 6.2. Asthmatic Children
*   **School Protocol:** Outdoor sports and assemblies canceled during AQI >150.
*   **Medication:** Rescue inhalers must be carried at all times. 
*   **Masking:** Child-sized N95 masks mandatory for school commutes.

### 6.3. Geriatric Citizens (65+)
*   **Movement:** Avoid morning walks entirely (peak pollution hours 7–10 AM) during AQI >150. Use indoor walking spaces.
*   **Monitoring:** Daily blood pressure and oxygen saturation checks at home.
*   **Support:** Family members must ensure a 15-day stock of cardiac/respiratory medications during smog events.

---

## 7. CLINICAL EMERGENCY AND HOSPITAL TRIAGE SYSTEM
All outdoor worker hubs (delivery centers, police stations, construction sites) must be equipped with pulse oximeters. The following applies to workers presenting with acute respiratory distress.

### 7.1. SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds

| SpO2 Level (Room Air) | Triage Category | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Green (Stable) | Continue work with standard breaks, N95, and hydration. |
| **91% – 94%** | Yellow (Caution) | **Immediate removal from duty.** 30-minute rest in filtered air. Transport to nearest Primary Health Centre if not resolved. No further work allowed. |
| **$\le$ 90%** | Red (Critical) | **EMERGENCY TRIAGE.** Call 108 Ambulance. Transport to Tertiary Care. Administer high-flow oxygen. Rule out CO poisoning. |

### 7.2. Emergency Red Flags (Immediate Medical Evacuation)
*   **Cyanosis:** Bluish tint to lips or fingernails.
*   **Tachypnea:** Respiratory rate $> 25$ breaths per minute at rest.
*   **Altered Mental Status:** Confusion, extreme lethargy, or loss of consciousness.
*   **Stridor:** High-pitched wheezing during inhalation.

### 7.3. Emergency Response Flow
1.  **Stop Work:** Cease all physical exertion immediately.
2.  **Assess:** Check SpO2 and respiratory rate.
3.  **Relocate:** Move individual to an indoor area with clean air/HEPA filtration.
4.  **Triage:** If SpO2 <90%, cyanosis, or unconscious, activate EMS (108). If asthmatic attack, administer prescribed bronchodilator; if no relief in 10 mins, activate EMS.
5.  **Report:** Log incident in the occupational health register for insurance/workmen compensation claims.

---

## 8. ENFORCEMENT AND COMPLIANCE
*   **Gig Platforms:** Must integrate AQI data into rider apps. Riders found without N95 masks during AQI >150 will be temporarily suspended for safety compliance.
*   **Municipal Corporation:** Health inspectors will conduct random checks on construction sites and street vendors.
*   **Liability:** Employers failing to provide N95 masks, clean-air rest areas, or hydration during hazardous AQI events will be liable under the Factories Act and Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, 2020.
*   **Right to Refuse:** Workers have the right to refuse unsafe work during AQI >500 without penalty.

**Emergency Contacts:**
*   **Ambulance:** 108 | **Police:** 100
*   **Karnataka Health Helpline:** 104 | **KSPCB Complaint:** 1090

# Comprehensive Clinical & Occupational Health Protocol: COPD Prevention in High-Pollution Zones (India)

**Objective:** To prevent Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD) and acute respiratory distress among Indian outdoor workers (street vendors, delivery gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers) and high-risk commuters (pregnant women, asthmatic children, geriatric citizens) during hazardous AQI 150 to 500+ smog events.

---

## 1. AQI-Based Action Matrix (150 to 500+)

| AQI Range | Category | Protocol for Outdoor Workers (Vendors, Riders, Police, Laborers) | Protocol for High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant, Children, Geriatric) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | Poor | **N95 Mandatory.** Limit continuous exposure to 4 hours where possible. | Avoid outdoor movement. N95 mandatory if travel is unavoidable. |
| **201 – 300** | Very Poor | **N95 Mandatory.** Mandatory 15-min rest breaks every 2 hours in clean air zones. | Strict indoor confinement. Telemedicine consults only. Travel via sealed, filtered vehicles. |
| **301 – 400** | Severe | **N95 Mandatory + Rotation.** Shift rotation required. Max 4 hours/day outdoor exposure. | Emergency protocols active. Oxygen support readiness at home. No outdoor activity. |
| **401 – 500+** | Severe+ | **Work Suspension.** Essential workers only (Police/Emergency) with full PPE. | **Complete Lockdown.** Monitor SpO2 twice daily. Hospital pre-registration for respiratory history. |

---

## 2. Respiratory Protection: N95 Mandates & Rotation

Standard surgical or cloth masks are insufficient against PM2.5. N95/FFP2 respirators are required to prevent deep alveolar deposition of pollutants that drive COPD progression.

*   **Certification & Fit:** Only BIS-certified or NIOSH-approved N95/FFP2 respirators are permitted. Workers must perform a user seal check daily; facial hair must be trimmed to ensure a tight seal. Do not wash N95s, as this destroys the electrostatic charge.
*   **Rotation & Replacement Schedule:**
    *   **AQI 150–300:** Replace every 8–12 hours of cumulative wear.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** Replace every 4–6 hours. Street vendors operating near combustion sources (generators, heavy traffic) must change masks every 4 hours.
    *   **Reuse Protocol:** If supply constraints necessitate reuse, rotate between 3 masks, storing each in a breathable paper bag for 72 hours between uses.
    *   **Immediate Replacement:** Discard immediately if the mask becomes damp, visibly soiled, or if breathing resistance increases significantly.

---

## 3. Mandatory Hydration & Rest Breaks

Dehydration thickens mucus, impairing the mucociliary escalator's ability to clear trapped smog particles and exacerbating COPD and asthma risks.

*   **Hydration Protocol:**
    *   **Intake:** Minimum 3 liters of water per shift. Consume 250ml of warm water hourly.
    *   **Electrolytes:** Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) or coconut water every 4 hours for construction laborers and delivery riders.
    *   **Restrictions:** Avoid ice-cold beverages and excess caffeine, which may trigger bronchospasm in asthmatics.
*   **Rest Breaks:**
    *   **Frequency:** Mandatory 10–15 minute break every 2 hours.
    *   **Location:** Breaks must be taken in indoor, shaded, or designated "Clean Air Shelters" with HEPA filtration, away from idling vehicle exhaust.
    *   **Activity:** Practice diaphragmatic or pursed-lip breathing during breaks to reduce air trapping and improve oxygen exchange.

---

## 4. Clinical Monitoring: SpO2 Triage & COPD Early Diagnosis

Early diagnosis of hypoxemia and chronic lung damage is critical. Pulse oximetry must be conducted at the start and end of shifts for workers, and daily for high-risk commuters.

### A. SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds
| SpO2 Reading | Clinical Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Normal | Continue standard precautions. Maintain hydration and N95 rotation. |
| **91% – 94%** | **Warning Zone** | **Immediate Rest.** Stop outdoor work. Move to a clean air environment. Recheck in 30 mins. If persistent, consult a primary care physician for early COPD screening. |
| **90% – 92%** | **Clinical Triage** | **Immediate Referral.** Proceed to the nearest Primary Health Centre (PHC) or Mohalla Clinic. Administer supplemental oxygen if available. |
| **< 90%** | **Medical Emergency** | **Call Emergency Services (112).** Risk of respiratory failure. Immediate transport to the Emergency Department for oxygen therapy and arterial blood gas (ABG) analysis. |

*Note: Geriatric citizens, pregnant women, and those with pre-existing conditions should seek triage at SpO2 < 94%.*

### B. COPD Prevention & Screening
*   **Symptom Surveillance:** Monitor for chronic cough, sputum production, wheezing, and shortness of breath during mild exertion lasting >3 weeks.
*   **Spirometry Screening:** Mandatory annual spirometry for workers with >5 years of outdoor exposure in AQI >200 zones.
*   **Red-Flag Symptoms:** Seek emergency care immediately if experiencing cyanosis (bluish lips/nails), inability to speak in full sentences, visible chest retractions, or resting tachycardia (>100 bpm).

---

## 5. Emergency Protocols for Specific High-Risk Groups

*   **Pregnant Women:** Reduced oxygen saturation affects fetal health, risking hypoxia and preterm birth. Strict indoor confinement during AQI 400+. Immediate obstetric and respiratory consultation if SpO2 drops below 95%.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Ensure preventive inhalers are used before any outdoor exposure. Schools must cancel outdoor activities during AQI 200+. Carry rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) at all times; if relief lasts <3 hours, proceed to the ER.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** High risk of silent hypoxia (low SpO2 without visible distress) and comorbid heart failure. Caregivers must monitor for confusion or lethargy and check SpO2 twice daily. Avoid outdoor activity during smog peaks (6 AM – 10 AM).
*   **Delivery Riders & Outdoor Workers:** If experiencing chest tightness or sudden breathlessness, pull over immediately, remove the mask in a safe zone, and practice slow breathing. If SpO2 does not recover to 95% within 10 minutes, seek medical aid.

---

## 6. Implementation & Compliance

*   **Employer Responsibility:** Gig platforms and construction firms must provide BIS-certified N95 masks, pulse oximeters, and enforce paid rest breaks during AQI >200.
*   **Public Infrastructure:** Municipal corporations must establish "Smog Shelters" with air purifiers and oxygen support near high-traffic vendor zones.
*   **Reporting:** Any workplace respiratory incident or worker recording SpO2 < 90% must be logged in Occupational Health Safety records for longitudinal COPD tracking and post-smog season lung function testing.

***Disclaimer:** This guide outlines occupational health and public safety protocols. It does not replace professional medical advice. In case of severe respiratory distress, contact emergency services (112) immediately.*

*   **रूट प्लानिंग:** पीक स्मॉग घंटों (सुबह 8 बजे - 10 बजे, शाम 8 बजे - 10 बजे) के दौरान ज्ञात भीड़ वाले हॉटस्पॉट्स से बचें।

*   **बूथ सुरक्षा:** गश्ती बूथों में एयर कूलर/AC और एयर प्यूरीफायर लगे होने चाहिए।

*   **छाया और धूल:** कार्य स्थलों पर अनिवार्य अस्थायी छाया नेट। पार्टिकुलेट मैटर को कम करने के लिए पानी के छिड़काव की आवश्यकता।
*   **कार्य घंटे:** गर्मियों के दौरान शिफ्ट कार्य सुबह 5 बजे - 10 बजे और शाम 4 बजे - 7 बजे के लिए समायोजित करें।

*   **स्थान और गियर:** जहां संभव हो स्टॉल को सीधे एग्जॉस्ट जोन से दूर ले जाएं। छाया के लिए अनिवार्य UV सुरक्षा छाते।

### 3.5 उच्च-जोखिम वाले यात्री
*   **गर्भवती महिलाएं:** लंबे समय तक खड़े रहने से बचें। ORS साथ रखें। हाइपोक्सिया भ्रूण के ऑक्सीजनीकरण को प्रभावित करता है; SpO2 >95% बनाए रखना चाहिए। हीटवेव के दौरान जलयोजन बढ़ाकर दिन में 4 लीटर करें।

*   **वरिष्ठ नागरिक:** बाहरी आवाजाही के लिए बडी सिस्टम (साथी प्रणाली) आवश्यक है। साइलेंट हाइपोक्सिया (सांस की तकलीफ के बिना कम SpO2) की निगरानी करें। यदि बाहर यात्रा कर रहे हैं तो हर 30 मिनट में अनिवार्य विश्राम विराम लें।

## 4. नैदानिक आपातकालीन प्रोटोकॉल: हीटस्ट्रोक और हाइपोक्सिया

### 4.1 पहचान के लक्षण
*   **हीटस्ट्रोक:** कोर तापमान > 40°C, पसीना आना बंद होना (या एक्सरशनल हीटस्ट्रोक में अत्यधिक पसीना), गर्म/सूखी त्वचा, भ्रम, गिरना, टैकीकार्डिया।
*   **हाइपोक्सिया:** SpO2 < 94%, सायनोसिस (नीले होंठ/नाखून), सांस की तकलीफ, छाती में जकड़न, तेज सांस लेना, भ्रम।

### 4.2 तत्काल प्राथमिक चिकित्सा
*   **हीटस्ट्रोक:** छाया/AC में ले जाएं, अतिरिक्त कपड़े उतारें, गर्दन, जांघ और बगल में गीले तौलिये/बर्फ की थैलियां लगाएं। यदि होश में हों तो ORS दें।
*   **हाइपोक्सिया:** ताजी हवा/कम AQI वाले क्षेत्र में ले जाएं, कसे हुए कपड़े ढीले करें, यदि उपलब्ध हो तो सप्लीमेंटल ऑक्सीजन दें। अस्थमा के मरीजों को तुरंत रेस्क्यू इंहेलर का उपयोग करना चाहिए।

## १. AQI ॲक्शन मॅट्रिक्स आणि PPE चे अनिवार्य नियम
लक्ष्य गटातील सर्व व्यक्तींनी CPCB/SAFAR च्या रिअल-टाइम AQI डेटानुसार खालीलप्रमाणे वागणे बंधनकारक आहे:

| AQI श्रेणी | प्रकार | रेस्पिरेटर (मास्क) अनिवार्य | क्रियाकलापांवर निर्बंध |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **१५१–२००** | मध्यम | उच्च जोखीम गटांसाठी N95 ची शिफारस. | बाहेर दीर्घकाळ शारीरिक मेहनत टाळा. |
| **२०१–३००** | खराब | सर्व बाहेरील कर्मचाऱ्यांसाठी आणि उच्च जोखीम प्रवाशांसाठी **N95 अनिवार्य**. | वाहतूक पोलीस/विक्रेत्यांनी दर २ तासाने शिफ्ट बदलावी. |
| **३०१–४००** | अतिशय खराब | **N95/FFP2 अनिवार्य (फिट-चेक केलेले)** सर्वांसाठी. | बांधकाम कामगारांनी जड शारीरिक मेहनत थांबवावी; गिग डिलिव्हरीची वेळ वाढवून द्यावी. |
| **४०१–५००+** | गंभीर | **N95/FFP2 अनिवार्य** | **गर्भवती महिला आणि COPD रुग्णांसाठी बाहेरील काम पूर्णपणे निलंबित.** फक्त अत्यावश्यक कर्मचारी. |

*   **N95 प्रोटोकॉल:** मास्क BIS/NIOSH प्रमाणित असणे आवश्यक आहे. कापडी/सर्जिकल मास्क PM2.5 विरुद्ध अप्रभावी आहेत. मास्क वापरल्याच्या ८ तासांनंतर किंवा ते मळले/ओले/श्वास घेण्यास कठीण झाल्यास तात्काळ बदलावेत. AQI > २०० असताना मालकांनी मोफत N95 मास्क पुरवावेत.

## २. व्यावसायिक आरोग्य प्रोटोकॉल (भारतीय बाह्य कर्मचारी)
*   **डिलिव्हरी गिग रायडर्स:** गर्दीच्या आणि वाहतूक कोंडीच्या क्षेत्रात जाणे टाळा. दर २ तासांनी १५ मिनिटे एसी किंवा हवा शुद्धीकरण असलेल्या बंद जागेत विश्रांती घ्या.
*   **वाहतूक पोलीस:** स्वच्छ हवेच्या बूथमध्ये दर २ तासांनी ड्यूटी रोटेशन करा. AQI > ३०० असताना वाहतूक बेटांवर पॉझिटिव्ह प्रेशर एअर प्युरिफायर बसवणे आवश्यक आहे.
*   **बांधकाम कामगार:** सकाळच्या स्मॉगच्या वेळेतून वाचण्यासाठी जड कामे सकाळी लवकर (पहाटे ४ ते सकाळी ८) करा. धूळ दाबण्यासाठी साइटवर पाण्याची फवारणी करणे बंधनकारक.
*   **रस्त्यावरील विक्रेते:** आतल्या जागेत जाण्यासाठी पार्टनरसोबत रोटेशन करा. वाऱ्याने येणाऱ्या स्मॉगपासून संरक्षणासाठी अडथळा म्हणून पारदर्शक प्लास्टिक शीटचा वापर करा.

## ३. उच्च जोखीम प्रवासी प्रोटोकॉल
*   **ज्येष्ठ नागरिक (COPD सहित):** AQI > ३०० असताना बाहेर पडू नका. बचावासाठीचे इन्हेलर (सालब्युटामॉल) आणि मेंटेनन्स इन्हेलर सहज उपलब्ध ठेवा. घरात HEPA एअर प्युरिफायर वापरा; खिडक्या बंद ठेवा.
*   **गर्भवती महिला:** AQI ३००+ असताना बाहेरील प्रवास पूर्णपणे टाळा. रिसर्क्युलेटेड एअर असलेल्या बंद वाहनांचा वापर करा. AQI > २०० असताना बाहेर कोणतीही शारीरिक मेहनत करू नका.
*   **दम्याचे बालरुग्ण:** AQI > २०० असताना बाहेरील खेळ आणि सभा बंद. पालकांनी दिवसातून दोनदा पीक फ्लो मीटर तपासावा. बचावासाठीचे इन्हेलर सोबत ठेवणे अनिवार्य.

निर्जलीकरणामुळे कफ घट्ट होतो, ज्यामुळे COPD आणि दम्याची लक्षणे वाढतात. कोमट पाणी प्या; बर्फासारके थंड पेय टाळा कारण त्यामुळे ब्रोंकोस्पाझम होऊ शकतो. श्वसनमार्गांना आराम देण्यासाठी अँटिऑक्सिडंट्स (व्हिटॅमिन C/E) आणि कोमट द्रवपदार्थ (हर्बल चहा, सूप) सेवन करा.

| कर्मचारी/प्रवासी प्रकार | विश्रांतीची वारंवारता | कालावधी | स्थानाची आवश्यकता |

| **वाहतूक पोलीस** | दर २ तासांनी | १५ मिनिटे | एअर प्युरिफायर असलेल्या इनडोर बूथमध्ये किंवा वाहनात (खिडक्या बंद, AC रिसर्क्युलेट). |

| **बांधकाम कामगार** | दर ९० मिनिटांनी | २० मिनिटे | हवा फिल्ट्रेशन असलेली निर्धारित सावलीदार इनडोर जागा. |

## ५. पायरीवार SpO2 रुग्णालय ट्रायज प्रक्रिया
**लक्ष्य गट:** वृद्ध (COPD सह), दम्याचे रुग्ण, गर्भवती महिला आणि लक्षणे दिसणारे कर्मचारी.
**साधन:** कॅलिब्रेटेड पल्स ऑक्सिमीटर.

**पायरी १: बेसलाइन मोजमाप**
*   ५ मिनिटे शांत बसा. नखाला लावलेली पॉलिश काढा. हात थंड असल्यास ते कोमट करा.
*   घरात आरामात असताना SpO2 मोजा. बेसलाइन रेकॉर्ड करा (COPD रुग्णांसाठी सामान्य ८८–९२% असू शकतो; निरोगी व्यक्तींसाठी >९५%).

**पायरी २: एक्सपोजर तपासणी आणि ट्रायज थ्रेशोल्ड**
*   AQI >४०० च्या संपर्कात आल्यास, घरात परतल्यावर तात्काळ SpO2 मोजा. जर बेसलाइनपेक्षा ३% पेक्षा जास्त घट झाली असेल, तर विश्रांती घ्या आणि डॉक्टरांनी सांगितलेले ब्रोंकोडायलेटर वापरा.

## २. वैद्यकीय आपत्कालीन मार्गदर्शक: गर्भवती महिला (प्राधान्य केंद्र)
**उद्देश:** मातृत्वाच्या श्वसनाच्या त्रासाचे प्रतिबंध आणि गर्भाच्या ऑक्सिजनपुरवठ्याचे संरक्षण.

### अ. श्वसन संरक्षण आणि N95 सक्ती
*   **AQI १५०–२००:** सर्व बाहेरील प्रवासासाठी N95 रेस्पिरेटरची शिफारस.
*   **AQI २०१–३००:** **N95 वापर सक्तीचा.** गर्भारपणात वाढलेला श्वसन दर आणि ऑक्सिजनची मागणी लक्षात घेता, फिल्ट्रेशन कार्यक्षमतेत तडजोड करता येणार नाही.
*   **AQI ३०१–५००+:** बाहेरील हालचालींवर पूर्ण निर्बंध. जर प्रवास अपरिहार्य असेल, तर फिट-टेस्टेड N95 किंवा त्यापेक्षा उच्च (N99/P100) सक्तीचे आहे.
*   **वैद्यकीय टीप:** 'मास्क-इंड्युस्ड डिस्पनिया' (मास्कमुळे होणारा श्वासोच्छ्वासाचा त्रास) यावर लक्ष ठेवा. जर मास्कमुळे श्वास घेण्यास त्रास होत असेल, तर मास्क काढण्यापेक्षा तात्काळ आत हलवणे प्राधान्य द्या.

*   **तर्क:** धुके घटनांमधील प्रणालीबद्ध निर्जलीकरणामुळे श्लेष्मल त्वचा कोरडी पडते, मातेचे रक्त घट्ट होते (धुक्यामुळे होणाऱ्या सूजामुळे थक्का होण्याचा धोका वाढतो) आणि अम्निओटिक द्रवाच्या प्रमाणात घट होण्याशी (ओलिगोहायड्राम्नियोसचा धोका) संबंधित असते.
*   **प्रोटोकॉल:** दररोज ३–४ लिटर पाण्याचे सेवन सक्तीचे आहे. गर्भवती महिलांनी दिवसाच्या वेळी दर तासाला २५० मिली पाणी प्यावे.
*   **निरीक्षण:** लघवीचा रंग फिकट पिवळा राहिला पाहिजे. गडद लघवी म्हणजे तात्काळ हायड्रेशनची कमतरता ज्यासाठी वैद्यकीय लक्ष आवश्यक आहे.

### क. SpO2 रुग्णालय ट्रायज थ्रेशोल्ड्स
गर्भवती महिलांमध्ये ऑक्सिजनची मूळ मागणी जास्त असते. ट्रायज आक्रमक असली पाहिजे:
*   **SpO2 ९५%–९८%:** निरीक्षण; AQI संपर्कातून तात्काळ काढा.
*   **SpO2 ९१%–९४%:** **तातडीचे ट्रायज.** स्वच्छ हवेत (HEPA फिल्टर्ड खोली) तात्काळ विश्रांती. पूरक ऑक्सिजन सुरू करा; डॉप्लर/CTG द्वारे गर्भाच्या हृदय गतीचे (FHR) मूल्यांकन करा. स्त्रीरोग तज्ज्ञांशी संपर्क साधा.
*   **SpO2 < ९०%:** **गंभीर आपत्कालीन.** गर्भाच्या हायपोक्सियाला प्रतिबंध करण्यासाठी तात्काळ रुग्णालयात दाखल करणे, उच्च-प्रवाह ऑक्सिजन आणि स्त्रीरोग आपत्कालीन सल्ला.
*   **ER आवश्यक असलेली लक्षणे:** विश्रांतीत श्वास घेण्यास त्रास, छातीत घट्टपणा, गर्भाची हालचाल कमी होणे, किंवा पोटावर दाब निर्माण करणारे सतत खोकल्याचे झटके.

## ३. भारतीय बाहेरील कामगारांसाठी व्यावसायिक आरोग्य प्रोटोकॉल्स
**लक्ष्य गट:** डिलिव्हरी गिग रायडर्स, वाहतूक पोलीस, बांधकाम मजूर, रस्ते विक्रेते.

### अ. AQI स्तरानुसार संपर्क व्यवस्थापन
*   **AQI १५०–२००:** दर २ तासांनी सावलीत किंवा आतील भागात १० मिनिटांचा ब्रेक.
*   **AQI २०१–३००:** कामाचे तास ३०% कमी. सक्तीचे हायड्रेशन (दर तासाला ५०० मिली). दर तासाला आतील/फिल्टर्ड वातावरणात १५ मिनिटांचा ब्रेक.
*   **AQI ३०१–५००+:** **नॉन-एसेन्शियल बाहेरील काम बंद.** जर आवश्यक सेवा सुरू राहिल्या, तर सततच्या संपर्काचे शिफ्ट ४ तासांपेक्षा जास्त नसावेत.

### ब. क्षेत्र-विशिष्ट हस्तक्षेप
*   **डिलिव्हरी गिग रायडर्स:** लॉजिस्टिक्स कंपन्यांनी N95 पुरवले पाहिजेत. डिलिव्हरी ॲप्सने रायडर्सना पीक प्रदूषणाच्या तासांत (सकाळी ८–१०; रात्री ८–१०) थांबण्याची परवानगी देणारे 'पॉज' बटन लागू केले पाहिजे.
*   **वाहतूक पोलीस:** डेप्लॉयमेंट रोटेशन वाढवले पाहिजे (उच्च गर्दीच्या चौकांपासून दूर सतत २ तासांचा कमाल संपर्क). प्रमुख बूथमध्ये एअर प्युरिफायर्स आणि पोर्टेबल ऑक्सिजन कॉन्सन्ट्रेटर्स असणे आवश्यक आहे.
*   **बांधकाम मजूर:** धूळ दाबण्यासाठी साइटवर पाण्याचे फवारे मारणे सक्तीचे. AQI >२५० असताना ऑक्सिजनची मागणी कमी करण्यासाठी जड वजन उचलण्यावर निर्बंध. AQI ५००+ घटनांमध्ये काम पूर्णपणे थांबले पाहिजे.
*   **रस्ते विक्रेते:** शक्य तितक्या एअर फिल्ट्रेशनसह आतील बाजार किंवा सावलीच्या भागात रस्त्याच्या लगतच्या एग्झॉस्ट फ्यूमपासून दूर स्थलांतर.

### क. कामगार सुरक्षा
*   मालक/प्लॅटफॉर्मने मोफत पिण्याचे पाणी, ORS आणि प्रमाणित N95 रेस्पिरेटर्स पुरवले पाहिजेत.
*   सक्तीचे विश्रांतीचे ब्रेक हे वेतन-सुरक्षित असतील; प्रदूषणामुळे सक्तीच्या ब्रेकसाठी कामगारांना दंड केला जाऊ शकत नाही.

---

## ४. इतर उच्च-जोखीम प्रवाशांसाठी प्रोटोकॉल्स

### अ. अस्थमाचे बालरुग्ण
*   **प्रतिबंध:** AQI >१५० असताना बाहेरील खेळ/क्रीडा रद्द. बाहेरील संपर्कापूर्वी बालरोग तज्ज्ञांच्या सल्ल्यानुसार प्रोफिलॅक्टिक ब्रोन्कोडायलेटरचा वापर.
*   **सक्ती:** मुलांच्या आकाराचे/फिट केलेले N95 मास्क वापरले पाहिजेत; सैल फिट मास्क गैर-अनुपालित आहेत. रेस्क्यू इन्हेलर्स नेहमी सोबत ठेवले पाहिजेत.
*   **ट्रायज:** जर SpO2 **९४%** पेक्षा कमी झाले किंवा ४ तासांत रेस्क्यू इन्हेलरचे वापर ३ डोसपेक्षा जास्त झाले तर तात्काळ रुग्णालयात दाखल करा.

### ब. वृद्ध नागरिक (६५+)
*   **प्रतिबंध:** पीक धुक्याच्या तासांत (सकाळी ६ – १० आणि संध्याकाळी ६ – १०) बाहेरील हालचाली पूर्णपणे टाळा. COPD किंवा हृदय विकार असलेल्या रुग्णांनी दिवसातून दोनदा SpO2 मॉनिटर केले पाहिजे.
*   **सक्ती:** सर्व आवश्यक हालचालींसाठी N95 मास्क.
*   **ट्रायज:** जर SpO2 **९२%** पेक्षा कमी झाले किंवा अचानक गोंधळ/सुस्ती (हायपोक्सियाची लक्षणे) किंवा छातीत दुखणे सुरू झाले तर रुग्णालयात दाखल करा.

---

## ५. रुग्णालय ट्रायज आणि आपत्कालीन थ्रेशोल्ड्स सारांश
धुके आपत्कालीन परिस्थितीत ट्रायजसाठी वैद्यकीय सुविधांनी खालील SpO2 थ्रेशोल्ड्सचा वापर केला पाहिजे.

| रुग्ण गट | चेतावणी स्तर | आपत्कालीन ट्रायज स्तर | कृती |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **गर्भवती महिला** | ९५% – ९४% | **< ९४%** | **ER ॲडमिशन.** गर्भ मॉनिटरिंग + मातृ O2. |
| **अस्थमाचे बालरुग्ण** | ९५% – ९४% | **< ९४%** | नेब्युलायझेशन + बालरोग ER. |
| **वृद्ध नागरिक** | ९३% – ९२% | **< ९२%** | हृदय/श्वास ER मूल्यांकन. |
| **बाहेरील कामगार** | ९४% – ९३% | **< ९२%** | व्यावसायिक आरोग्य युनिट + लक्षणे असल्यास ER. |

**आपत्कालीन कृती योजना:**
१. **काढा:** रुग्णाला प्रदूषित वातावरणातून तात्काळ बाहेर काढा.
२. **द्या:** लक्ष्य थ्रेशोल्ड्सच्या वर SpO2 राखण्यासाठी ऑक्सिजन द्या.
३. **वाहतूक:** थ्रेशोल्ड्स ओलांडल्यास पल्मोनोलॉजी/ऑब्स्टेट्रिक सपोर्ट असलेल्या जवळच्या सुविधेत नेण्याची व्यवस्था करा.
४. **अहवाल:** कार्यक्षेत्राच्या सुरक्षा ऑडिटिंगसाठी स्थानिक आरोग्य प्राधिकाऱ्यांना व्यावसायिक केसेसचा अहवाल द्या.

# Integrated Smog Health & Occupational Safety Protocol (AQI 150–500+)

**Scope:** This protocol provides clinical emergency and occupational health guidelines for hazardous air quality events in India (AQI 150 to 500+). It mandates specific safety measures for outdoor workers and high-risk commuters, with a dedicated focus on geriatric citizens with comorbid diabetes and asthma.

**Disclaimer:** *This document provides general safety guidelines and triage thresholds. It does not replace professional medical advice. In emergencies, contact local emergency services (112 in India).*

---

## 1. Occupational Health Protocols: Indian Outdoor Workers
*Target Groups: Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors.*

### A. N95 Respirator Mandate
*   **Requirement:** All outdoor workers must wear certified **N95 or FFP2 respirators** at all times while on duty. Cloth or surgical masks are insufficient for PM2.5 protection during AQI >150.
*   **Fit & Replacement:** Ensure no gaps around the nose or chin. Replace masks every 6–8 hours or sooner if soiled/wet.
*   **Enforcement:** Employers (gig platforms, municipal corporations, construction firms) must provide masks free of cost.

### B. Mandatory Hydration & Rest Breaks
*   **Hydration:** Workers must consume 250ml of water every hour to maintain mucosal hydration and assist particulate clearance.
*   **Rest Breaks:**
    *   **AQI 150–300:** 10-minute indoor or sheltered break every 2 hours.
    *   **AQI 300–500+:** 15-minute indoor or sheltered break every hour. 
*   **Work Rotation:** For construction laborers and traffic police, rotate shifts to limit continuous exposure to no more than 4 hours per day during AQI 400+ events. Dust-generating activities on construction sites must cease entirely during AQI >300.

### C. Symptom Monitoring
*   Supervisors must monitor workers for coughing, wheezing, eye irritation, or dizziness. Any worker exhibiting these symptoms must be relieved from duty immediately and assessed for oxygen saturation (SpO2). If SpO2 falls below 94%, the shift must be terminated.

---

## 2. High-Risk Commuter Protocols
*Target Groups: Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens.*

### A. General Commuter Guidelines
*   **Travel Restriction:** Non-essential outdoor travel is prohibited for high-risk groups during AQI 300+.
*   **Protection:** If travel is essential (e.g., medical appointments), **N95 respirators** are mandatory. Vehicle windows must remain closed; use recirculated air with cabin filters.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Outdoor sports and assemblies should be cancelled during AQI >200. Schools must hold rescue inhalers and have written action plans.
*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid open two-wheeler travel. Monitor fetal movement and maternal SpO2; SpO2 <95% requires obstetric consultation.

---

## 3. Geriatric Protocol: Comorbid Diabetes & Asthma
*Specific focus on elderly citizens (60+) managing insulin/oral hypoglycemics and respiratory inhalers.*

### A. Environmental Exposure & PPE
*   **Indoor Shelter:** Strict "Stay Indoors" mandate when AQI exceeds 200. Use HEPA air purifiers or create a "clean room" with minimal outdoor air leakage.
*   **N95 Respirators:** Mandatory if outdoor transit is unavoidable. *Note:* If the N95 increases the work of breathing (dyspnea), transition to a high-quality surgical mask with a filter, though N95 is the gold standard.
*   **Activity:** Strictly avoid morning walks or outdoor exercise until AQI drops below 100.

### B. Hydration to Prevent Hyperglycemic Crises
*   **Risk:** Smog-induced stress increases cortisol, raising blood glucose. Dehydration concentrates blood sugar, triggering **Diabetic Ketoacidosis (DKA)** or Hyperosmolar Hyperglycemic State (HHS).
*   **Intake:** Minimum **1.5 to 2.5 liters of water daily** unless contraindicated by heart or kidney failure. Take small sips every 30 minutes to maintain mucosal moisture.
*   **Monitoring:** Check blood glucose every 4 hours during AQI 200+ events. Track urine output (color should be pale yellow). If blood glucose exceeds 250 mg/dL, test urine/blood for ketones immediately.
*   **Electrolytes:** Include oral rehydration solutions (ORS) once daily to maintain sodium/potassium levels without excessively spiking glucose.

### C. Respiratory Management
*   **Inhaler Adherence:** Continue maintenance inhalers (ICS/LABA) strictly as prescribed; do not skip doses. Keep rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) accessible at all times.
*   **Pre-emptive Therapy:** Increase preventer inhaler usage as per a physician's action plan during AQI >150.

---

## 4. Clinical Emergency & Hospital Triage Thresholds

Pulse oximetry must be used to determine the need for hospitalization during smog events.

| SpO2 Level | Clinical Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% - 100%** | Normal | Monitor twice daily. Continue home care and hydration. |
| **93% - 94%** | Mild Distress | **Tele-consult.** Increase bronchodilator frequency as per doctor advice. Strict indoor rest. |
| **91% - 92%** | Moderate Distress | **Immediate Medical Evaluation.** Start supplemental oxygen if available; transport to clinic. |
| **≤ 90%** | Severe Distress | **IMMEDIATE HOSPITAL TRIAGE.** Call emergency services (112). Administer rescue inhaler while awaiting help. |
| **< 88%** | Critical | **ICU Admission.** Life-threatening risk of respiratory failure. Requires high-flow oxygen or ventilation. |

*Note: For patients with chronic COPD, baseline SpO2 may be lower (88-92%). A drop of >3% to 4% from baseline warrants triage.*

### Emergency Red Flags (Diabetes & Asthma)
Proceed to the Emergency Department immediately if any of the following occur during AQI 150-500+ events:
1.  **SpO2 ≤ 90%** despite rescue inhaler use.
2.  **Blood Glucose > 300 mg/dL** with ketones in urine/blood.
3.  **Retractions:** Visible pulling of skin between ribs or at the neck during breathing.
4.  **Cyanosis:** Blue tint to lips or fingernails.
5.  **Altered Mental Status:** Confusion, drowsiness, or inability to speak in full sentences.

**పరిధి:** భారతీయ బహిరంగ కార్మికులు (డెలివరీ గిగ్ రైడర్లు, ట్రాఫిక్ పోలీసు, నిర్మాణ కార్మికులు, వీధి వ్యాపారులు) మరియు అధిక ప్రమాదం ఉన్న ప్రయాణికులు (గర్భిణీ స్త్రీలు, ఆస్తమా ఉన్న పిల్లలు, వృద్ధులు).

బహిరంగ కార్మికులలో అనుకూలత లేకపోవడానికి ప్రధాన కారణాలు సామాజిక ఒత్తిడి బిందువులు: బలహీనతగా భావించడం, సామర్థ్యం తగ్గుతుందనే భయం మరియు కమ్యూనికేషన్ అడ్డంకులు. ఈ ప్రోటోకాల్ రక్షణను సాధారణీకరించడానికి సమూహ గతిశీలతను ఉపయోగిస్తుంది.

    *   *ఒత్తిడి బిందువు:* మాస్క్‌లు అధికారాన్ని, దృశ్యమానతను లేదా ధైర్యాన్ని దెబ్బతీస్తాయనే అభిప్రాయం.

1.  **அணிதல்:** முகக்கவசத்தை மூக்கு மற்றும் வாயின் மீது வைத்து, மேல் நாடாவை தலையின் உச்சியிலும், கீழ் நாடாவை காதுகளுக்குக் கீழேயும் பொருத்தவும். சுவாசக் கவசம் மூக்குப் பாலம் மற்றும் கன்னங்களுடன் இடைவெளி இல்லாமல் இறுக்கமாகப் பொருந்தியிருப்பதை உறுதி செய்யவும்.
2.  **உள்ளிழுப்பு சோதனை:** கூர்மையாக உள்ளிழுக்கவும்; முகக்கவசம் முகத்திற்கு எதிராக சற்று உள்ளிழுக்கப்பட வேண்டும்.
3.  **வெளியிடும் சோதனை:** கூர்மையாக வெளியிடவும். காற்று விளிம்புகளிலிருந்து வெளியேறினால் (கன்னங்கள் அல்லது கண்களில் காற்று படும் உணர்வால் கண்டறியப்பட்டால்), பொருத்தம் தோல்வியடைந்தது. மூக்கு கிளிப் அல்லது நாடா இறுக்கத்தை சரிசெய்யவும்.
4.  **மாற்று:** சரியான முத்திரையைப் பெற முடியவில்லை என்றால், குழந்தை வெளியே பயணம் செய்யக்கூடாது. மூடிய, காற்று வடிகட்டப்பட்ட வாகனங்களைப் பயன்படுத்தவும் அல்லது உடனடியாக உள்ளே தங்குமிடம் தேடவும்.

### B. மருத்துவ பிரித்தறிதல் மற்றும் சுவாசத் தோல்வி வரம்புகள்
குழந்தை நோயாளிகள் விரைவாக மோசமடைய வாய்ப்புள்ளது. பிரித்தறிதல் SpO2 மற்றும் மருத்துவ அறிகுறிகளின் அடிப்படையில் உள்ளது.

**மருத்துவமனை பிரித்தறிதல் வரம்புகள் (SpO2):**
*   **பச்சை (நிலையானது):** SpO2 ≥ 95%. கண்காணிப்பைத் தொடரவும்.
*   **மஞ்சள் (மருத்துவ மதிப்பீடு):** SpO2 92%–94%. ஆஸ்துமா உள்ளவர்களுக்கு உடனடியாக மூச்சுக்குழாய் விரிவாக்கிகள்/நெபுலைசேஷன் வழங்கவும்.
*   **சிவப்பு (அவசர பிரித்தறிதல்):** அறை காற்றில் SpO2 < 92%. உடனடியாக அவசர சிகிச்சைப் பிரிவுக்கு (Emergency Department) மாற்றவும்.
*   **கடுமையானது (சுவாசத் தோல்வி):** SpO2 < 90% அல்லது 3%-க்கு மேல் விரைவான வீழ்ச்சி. உடனடியாக ஆக்ஸிஜன் வழங்கி அவசர போக்குவரத்தைத் தொடங்கவும்.

**SpO2-ஐப் பொருட்படுத்தாமல் உடனடி பிரித்தறிதல் தேவைப்படும் மருத்துவ அறிகுறிகள்:**
*   இடைவிலா/கீழ்விலா உள்ளிழுப்பு (மார்பு உள்ளிழுத்தல்)
*   மூக்கு விரிதல் அல்லது கிரண்டிங் (grunting)
*   சயனோசிஸ் (உதடுகள் அல்லது நகப்படுக்கைகளில் நீல நிறம்)
*   மாற்றப்பட்ட மனநிலை, கடும் சோர்வு அல்லது அமைதியின்மை
*   முழு வாக்கியங்களில் பேச இயலாமை

## 3. இந்திய வெளியங்கு தொழிலாளர்களுக்கான தொழில்முறை சுகாதார நெறிமுறைகள்
விநியோக ஓட்டுநர்கள், போக்குவரத்து காவலர்கள், கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள் மற்றும் தெரு விற்பனையாளர்களுக்காக வேலையளிப்பவர்கள் மற்றும் கிக் தளங்கள் (gig platforms) பின்வருவனவற்றைக் கட்டாயப்படுத்த வேண்டும்.

### A. கட்டாய பாதுகாப்பு உபகரணங்கள் (PPE)
*   **N95 கட்டாயம்:** AQI 200-ஐ தாண்டும்போது, தொழிலாளர்களுக்கு எந்தச் செலவும் இல்லாமல் BIS சான்றிதழ் பெற்ற N95/FFP2 சுவாசக் கவசங்களை வழங்குவது கட்டாயமாகும்.
*   **தொழில்முறை பொருத்தச் சோதனை:** முத்திரையைச் சுற்றி கசிவு இல்லை என்பதை உறுதி செய்ய, தொழிலாளர்கள் ஆண்டுதோறும் தரமான பொருத்தச் சோதனைக்கு (சாக்கரின் அல்லது Bitrex கரைசல்) உட்படுத்தப்பட வேண்டும்.
*   **கண் பாதுகாப்பு:** ஓட்டுநர்கள் மற்றும் காவலர்களின் பார்வையைப் பாதிக்கக்கூடிய கண் அழற்சி மற்றும் கண்ணீரைத் தடுக்க இறுக்கமான கண்ணாடிகள்.

### B. கட்டாய நீரேற்றம் மற்றும் உடலியல் பராமரிப்பு
*   **நீரேற்றம்:** சுவாசப் பாதையில் மியூகோசிலியரி கிளியரன்ஸை (mucociliary clearance) பராமரிக்க, தொழிலாளர்கள் ஒவ்வொரு மணிநேரமும் 250ml தண்ணீர் குடிக்க வேண்டும் (தினசரி 3–4 லிட்டர்).
*   **மின்னுப்புகள் ஆதரவு:** வெப்ப-புகைமூட்ட கூட்டு சோர்வைத் தடுக்க, கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள் மற்றும் போக்குவரத்து காவலர்களுக்கு ORS (வாய்வழி நீரேற்ற உப்புகள்) கட்டாயமாக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

### C. கட்டாய ஓய்வு மற்றும் மீட்பு இடைவெளிகள்
*   **AQI 150–300:** நிழலான அல்லது உள்ளங்கு இடத்தில் ஒவ்வொரு 2 மணிநேரத்திற்கும் 10 நிமிட இடைவெளி.
*   **AQI 300–500+:** HEPA காற்று வடிகட்டி கொண்ட மூடிய இடத்தில் அல்லது குறிப்பிட்ட "பச்சை மண்டலத்தில்" ஒவ்வொரு மணிநேரமும் 15 நிமிட "சுத்தமான காற்று இடைவெளி". போக்குவரத்து காவல் கூடங்களில் போர்ட்டபிள் ஏர் பியூரிஃபையர்கள் (portable air purifiers) பொருத்தப்பட வேண்டும்.
*   **வேலை இடைநிறுத்தம்:** AQI 300+ இல், வெளியங்கு ஷிஃப்ட் நேரங்கள் 50% குறைக்கப்பட வேண்டும். AQI 400+ இல், தேவையற்ற வெளியங்கு வேலை (கட்டுமானம், தெரு விற்பனை) உச்ச நேரங்களில் (காலை 10 மணி – இரவு 8 மணி) நிறுத்தப்பட வேண்டும்.
*   **அறிகுறி அறிக்கை:** மூச்சுத் திணறல், தொடர்ச்சியான இருமல் அல்லது மார்பு இறுக்கத்தை அனுபவிக்கும் எந்தவொரு தொழிலாளியும் உடனடியாக வேலையை நிறுத்தி SpO2 திரையிடலுக்கு உட்படுத்தப்பட வேண்டும்.

## 4. உயர் அபாய பயணிகளுக்கான மருத்துவ நெறிமுறைகள்

### A. கர்ப்பிணிப் பெண்கள்
*   **நெறிமுறை:** AQI 300+ இல் வெளியங்கு வெளிப்பாட்டைக் கட்டாயமாகத் தவிர்க்கவும். சுவாச வீதத்தைக் குறைக்க உடல் உழைப்பைக் குறைக்கவும். காற்று சுத்திகரிப்புடன் கூடிய தனியார் போக்குவரத்தைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்.
*   **அவசர அறிகுறிகள்:** கருவில் இதயத் துடிப்பு மாறுபாடு அதிகரிப்பு, தலைச்சுற்றல் அல்லது தாய்க்கு மூச்சுத் திணறல் ஆகியவை உடனடி மருத்துவ மதிப்பீட்டைத் தேவைப்படுகின்றன.

### B. முதிய குடிமக்கள்
*   **நெறிமுறை:** வெளியே செல்வதை அவசியமான மருத்துவ வருகைகளுக்கு மட்டுப்படுத்தவும். பராமரிப்பாளர்கள் குழப்பம் அல்லது சோர்வைக் கண்காணிக்க வேண்டும், இது ஹைப்பாக்ஸியாவை (hypoxia) குறிக்கலாம். முன்கூட்டியே COPD உள்ளவர்களுக்கு போர்ட்டபிள் ஆக்ஸிஜன் செறிவூட்டிகளைப் (portable oxygen concentrators) பயன்படுத்தவும்.
*   **பிரித்தறிதல்:** முதிய நோயாளிகளில் SpO2 < 90% உடனடி மருத்துவமனையில் அனுமதிக்கப்பட வேண்டும்.

### C. ஆஸ்துமா உள்ள குழந்தைகள்
*   **நெறிமுறை:** குழந்தைகள் மருத்துவரின் ஆலோசனையின்படி, பயணத்திற்கு முன் ஸ்பேசர் (spacer) மூலம் குறுகிய கால பீட்டா-அகோனிஸ்டுகள் (SABA) நிர்வகிக்கப்பட வேண்டும். ஸ்பேசர் மற்றும் போர்ட்டபிள் பீக்-ஃப்ளோ மீட்டர் அடங்கிய "மீட்பு கிட்" எடுத்துச் செல்லவும்.

## 5. செயல்பாடு மற்றும் இணக்கம்
*   **வேலையளிப்பவர் பொறுப்பு:** கிக் தளங்கள் மற்றும் கட்டுமான நிறுவனங்கள் PPE வழங்குவதற்கும், அதிகாரப்பூர்வ அரசு செயலிகள் மூலம் (எ.கா., SAFAR) AQI நிலைகளைக் கண்காணிப்பதற்கும் பொறுப்பாவார்கள். N95 முகக்கவசங்களை வழங்கத் தவறுவது தொழில்முறை பாதுகாப்பு மீறலாகும்.
*   **பொது சுகாதார அறிவுரை:** உள்ளூர் மாநகராட்சிகள் 300-ஐ தாண்டும்போது SMS மற்றும் சைரன் மூலம் AQI எச்சரிக்கைகளை ஒலிபரப்ப வேண்டும். உள்ளூர் மருத்துவமனைகள் எதிர்பார்க்கப்படும் புகைமூட்ட உச்சங்களின் போது நெபுலைசர்கள் மற்றும் ஆக்ஸிஜன் ஆதரவை இருப்பில் வைத்திருக்க வேண்டும்.
*   **அவசரகால பதில்:** கடுமையான மூச்சுத் திணறல் அல்லது சயனோசிஸ் ஏற்பட்டால், உடனடியாக அவசர சேவைகளை (இந்தியாவில் 112) அழைக்கவும். SpO2 கடுமையான வரம்புகளுக்குக் கீழே இருந்தால், நோயாளியைத் தனிப்பட்ட முறையில் ஓட்டிச் செல்ல முயற்சிக்க வேண்டாம்.

***நிராகரிப்பு:** இந்தத் திட்டம் பொதுவான பொது சுகாதார மற்றும் தொழில்முறை பாதுகாப்பு வழிகாட்டுதல்களை வழங்குகிறது. இது தனிப்பட்ட மருத்துவ ஆலோசனைக்குப் பதிலாகாது. குறிப்பிட்ட சுவாச நிலைமைகளுக்கு தகுதிவாய்ந்த மருத்துவ நிபுணரை அணுகவும்.*

*   **AQI 300–450 (மிகவும் ஆரோக்கியமற்றது):** ஒவ்வொரு 1 மணிநேரத்திற்கும் 15 நிமிடங்கள் ஓய்வு நேரம் கட்டாயம்.
*   **AQI 450–500+ (கடுமையானது/ஆபத்தானது):** பாதிக்கப்படக்கூடிய குழுக்களுக்கு வெளியில் வேலை செய்வது நிறுத்தப்பட வேண்டும். அவசியமான தொழிலாளர்கள் காற்று வடிகட்டப்பட்ட அறைகளில் ஒவ்வொரு மணிநேரத்திற்கும் 30 நிமிடங்கள் ஓய்வு எடுக்க வேண்டும். AQI 450-ஐத் தாண்டி 4 மணிநேரத்திற்கும் மேல் தொடர்ந்தால் கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள் மற்றும் தெருவோர வியாபாரிகள் பணிகளை நிறுத்த வேண்டும்.
*   **கிக் தொழிலாளர் பாதுகாப்பு:** வருமான இழப்பைத் தடுக்க, கட்டாய ஓய்வு நேரங்களின் போது பிளாட்பாரம் அல்காரிதம்கள் டைமரை நிறுத்த வேண்டும். ஆபத்தான AQI நிலையில் 4 மணிநேர பணிக்குப் பிறகு 30 நிமிட "குளிர்ச்சி" நேரத்தைக் கடைபிடிக்க வேண்டும்.

### B. இலக்கு நெறிமுறைகள்
*   **டெலிவரி ரைடர்கள்:** அதிக உடல் உழைப்பு PM2.5 உட்கொள்ளலை அதிகரிக்கிறது; எனவே நீர்ச்சத்து மற்றும் முகக்கவச மாற்றுதலில் கடுமையான கவனம் தேவை.
*   **போக்குவரத்து காவலர்கள்:** 2 மணிநேர வெளியில் பணி, அதனைத் தொடர்ந்து 1 மணிநேர உள்ளறை மீட்பு சுழற்சி.
*   **கட்டுமானத் தொழிலாளர்கள்:** தூசி அடங்குவதற்கு நீர் தெளிப்பது கட்டாயம்; சாதாரண தூசி முகக்கவசங்களுக்கு மேல் N95 அணிய வேண்டும். AQI 400+ இருக்கும் போது ஒரு நாளைக்கு <4 மணிநேர வெளிப்பாட்டை உறுதி செய்ய ஷிப்ட்களை மாற்ற வேண்டும்.
*   **தெருவோர வியாபாரிகள்:** ஓய்வு நேரங்களில் காற்று சுத்திகரிப்பு "சுத்தமான காற்று மண்டலங்கள்" அல்லது உள்ளறை அடைக்கலங்களைப் பயன்படுத்த வேண்டும்.

## 4. மருத்துவ அவசரகாலம் மற்றும் SpO2 பிரித்தறிதல் வரம்புகள்
தீவிர சுவாச வீழ்ச்சியைத் தடுக்க ஹைபோக்ஸியாவை (ஆக்சிஜன் பற்றாக்குறை) ஆரம்பத்தில் கண்டறிவது மிக முக்கியம். தொழில் சுகாதார மையங்கள், கட்டுமான மருத்துவமனைகள் மற்றும் வீட்டு கிட்களில் பல்ஸ் ஆக்சிமீட்டர் கிடைக்க வேண்டும்.

### A. SpO2 பிரித்தறிதல் வரம்புகள்
*   **SpO2 95%–100%:** இயல்பு. N95 பயன்பாடு, நீர்ச்சத்து மற்றும் ஊட்டச்சத்து நெறிமுறைகளைத் தொடரவும்.
*   **SpO2 93%–94% (எச்சரிக்கை மண்டலம்):** வெளியில் செயல்படுவதை உடனடியாக நிறுத்தவும். சுத்தமான காற்று சூழலுக்குச் செல்லவும். நீர்ச்சத்து மற்றும் ஆன்டிஆக்சிடன்ட்களை வழங்கவும். 30 நிமிடங்களில் மீண்டும் சோதிக்கவும். 4 மணிநேரத்திற்கும் மேல் தொடர்ந்தால் முதன்மை மருத்துவரை அணுகவும்.
*   **SpO2 ≤ 92% (மருத்துவமனை பிரித்தறிதல் வரம்பு):** அவசரப் பிரிவுக்கு (Emergency Department) கட்டாயமாக அனுப்ப வேண்டும். ஆக்சிஜன் சிகிச்சை மற்றும் மூச்சுக்குழாய் விரிவாக்கிகள் (bronchodilators) தேவைப்படலாம் என்பதால் உடனடி மருத்துவ மதிப்பீடு அவசியம்.
*   **SpO2 < 90% (கடுமையான அவசரகாலம்):** அவசர சேவைகளை (112) அழைக்கவும். சுவாச வீழ்ச்சி அபாயம் உள்ளது. கொண்டு செல்லும் போது ஆக்சிஜன் கிடைத்தால் வழங்கவும்.

### B. அதிக ஆபத்துள்ளவர்களுக்கான குறிப்புகள் மற்றும் அவசரகால எச்சரிக்கை அறிகுறிகள்
*   **கர்ப்பிணிப் பெண்கள்:** தாயின் SpO2 குறைவதற்கு முன்பே கருவில் உள்ள குழந்தைக்கு அழுத்தம் ஏற்படலாம்; தாயின் SpO2 < 94% இருந்தால் உடனடி மகப்பேறு மற்றும் சுவாச ஆலோசனை தேவை.
*   **முதியவர்கள்:** அடிப்படை SpO2 குறைவாக இருக்கலாம். 92%-க்கு மேல் இருந்தாலும், தனிநபரின் அடிப்படை அளவிலிருந்து >3% வீழ்ச்சி இருந்தால் மருத்துவ ஆய்வு தேவை.
*   **ஆஸ்துமா உள்ள குழந்தைகள்:** மூச்சுத்திணறல் (wheezing) உடன் SpO2 < 94% இருந்தால் உடனடி நெபுலைசேஷன் மற்றும் அவசர சிகிச்சை தேவை. செயல் திட்டத்தின்படி மீட்பு இன்ஹேலர்களைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்.
*   **SpO2 அளவைப் பொருட்படுத்தாமல் உடனடி பிரித்தறிதல் தேவை:** சுவாசிப்பதற்கு துணைத் தசைகளைப் பயன்படுத்துதல், முழு வாக்கியங்களில் பேச முடியாமை, தீவிர மார்பு வலி, அல்லது நரம்பியல் மாற்றங்கள் (குழப்பம், அதிக சோர்வு).

## 5. ஒருங்கிணைந்த பாதுகாப்பின் சுருக்கம்
இத்திட்டத்தின் செயல்திறன் **சுற்றுச்சூழல்-ஊட்டச்சத்து இணைப்பை** அடிப்படையாகக் கொண்டது. N95 சுவாசக் கவசம் நச்சுத் துகள்கள் *உள்நுழைவதைத்* தடுக்கிறது, அதே சமயம் ஆன்டிஆக்சிடன்ட் நிறைந்த நீர்ச்சத்து மற்றும் உணவுமுறை வடிகட்டியைத் தாண்டிச் செல்லும் நுண்ணிய துகள்களின் *உயிரியல் சேதத்தை* நிர்வகிக்கிறது. புகைமூட்ட காலங்களில் இந்த ஒருங்கிணைந்த நெறிமுறைகளைத் தொடர்ந்து கடைபிடிப்பது ஆக்சிஜனேற்ற அழுத்தத்தின் குவிவு சுமையைக் குறைக்கிறது, இதன் மூலம் தீவிர சுவாச வீழ்ச்சியைத் தடுத்து, இந்திய தொழிலாளர்கள் மற்றும் பாதிக்கப்படக்கூடிய மக்களிடம் மாசுபாட்டால் ஏற்படும் நாள்பட்ட நோய்களின் ஆயுட்கால அபாயத்தைக் குறைக்கிறது.

# Protocol for Somatic Preservation and Collective Resilience: The Smog Emergency Framework (AQI 150–500+)

## I. Theoretical Preamble: The Psycho-Anthropology of Air Anxiety
Bridging Western psychoanalytic theory and cultural anthropology, severe smog in Indian urban centers must be understood not merely as a particulate hazard, but as an intrusion of the "Real" into the symbolic order of daily life. The invisible threat of particulate matter functions as a pervasive "death drive" intruding upon the life instinct (*Eros*), creating a paranoid anxiety where the environment itself becomes a hostile "Other" that threatens the bodily ego. 

Cultural anthropology reveals that the street is a social organism—a space of economic ritual, dignity, and survival. When AQI rises, the "rituals of survival" (work, commute, vending) clash with the "rituals of preservation" (masking, hiding indoors). This often leads to a dangerous cognitive dissonance where workers ignore somatic distress to maintain economic survival. This protocol reframes health preservation from a luxury or a weakness into a mandatory ritual of self-care—a necessary boundary-setting against an environment that seeks to penetrate the bodily integrity of the worker and the commuter.

## II. Occupational Health Mandates for Outdoor Workers
**Target Demographic:** Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors.
**Trigger Condition:** Hazardous AQI 150 to 500+ Smog Events.

### 1. The Symbolic Boundary: N95 Respirator Mandate
*Psychoanalytic Interpretation:* The mask serves as a "skin ego" extension, creating a necessary separation between the vulnerable self and the toxic environment. It is a tangible assertion of agency.
*   **Mandatory Equipment:** All outdoor workers must wear BIS-certified N95 or FFP2 respirators when AQI exceeds 150. Surgical or cloth masks are clinically insufficient for PM2.5 filtration.
*   **Fit Testing:** Workers must be trained in "seal-checking" to ensure the mask seals tightly around the nose and mouth. 
*   **Replacement Cycle:** Respirators must be replaced every 8–12 hours of active use, or immediately if soiled, wet, or breathing resistance increases.
*   **Enforcement:** Gig platforms, construction firms, and municipal corporations must provide N95s at no cost. Non-compliance is treated as an occupational safety violation. Platforms must disable penalties for late deliveries during AQI 500+ events.

### 2. Rituals of Sustenance: Mandatory Hydration & Rest
*Anthropological Interpretation:* Mandatory breaks reintroduce a "liminal space" for recovery, disrupting the cycle of exploitation and acknowledging human fragility.
*   **Mandatory Hydration:** Pollution induces systemic inflammation; hydration aids mucociliary clearance in the respiratory tract. Minimum intake of 250ml of water every hour. Electrolyte solutions/ORS are recommended for laborers and gig riders engaged in high exertion. Dark urine indicates immediate dehydration requiring cessation of work.
*   **Enforced Rest Breaks:**
    *   **AQI 150–250:** Mandatory 15-minute shaded rest break every 2 hours in a designated low-pollution zone (indoor or filtered area).
    *   **AQI 251–500+:** 20-minute rest break every 90 minutes. Work hours must be reduced by 50%, and rest breaks increased.
*   **Population-Specific Enforcement:**
    *   *Traffic Police:* Booths must be equipped with air purifiers. Duty rosters must rotate officers every 45 minutes during severe smog.
    *   *Construction Laborers:* Work involving dust generation must cease during AQI 500+ events. Water sprinkling must be increased to suppress particulate matter.
    *   *Street Vendors:* Food covering must be enforced to prevent particulate contamination. Vendors should be provided portable shelter screens.

## III. High-Risk Commuter Safeguards
**Target Demographic:** Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens.
**Trigger Condition:** Hazardous AQI 150 to 500+ Smog Events.

### 1. Exposure Mitigation & N95 Compliance
*   **Zero-Exposure Windows:** Non-essential outdoor exposure is prohibited for asthmatic children and geriatric citizens when AQI exceeds 200. Avoid commuting during peak smog hours (6:00 AM – 10:00 AM and 6:00 PM – 10:00 PM).
*   **Pregnant Women:** Must wear N95 respirators during any necessary transit. Avoid outdoor exposure entirely during AQI 300+. Prenatal care visits should include counseling on pollution avoidance and monitoring for fetal distress and maternal tachycardia.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Schools must cancel outdoor assembly and sports activities at AQI 150+. Children must carry rescue inhalers (SABA) and wear child-sized N95 masks during commutes. Parents must monitor for coughing fits as early warning signs.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Shift exercise to indoor environments with air purifiers. Monitor for exacerbation of COPD and cardiovascular strain. Community centers must act as "Clean Air Shelters" with oxygen support availability.

### 2. Commute Modifications
*   Use enclosed vehicles with recirculated air filters where possible. Open-two-wheeler commute is strongly discouraged for these groups during AQI 500+ events.

## IV. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds
*Psychoanalytic Interpretation:* Pulse oximetry provides an objective "mirror stage" reflection of internal health, countering denial or normalization of breathlessness.

When an individual presents with respiratory distress during a smog event, the following triage thresholds apply to determine hospital admission:

| SpO2 Level (Room Air) | Clinical Status | Action/Triage Threshold |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Stable (Green Zone) | Monitor twice daily; ensure N95 use; continue hydration. |
| **91% – 94%** | Mild Hypoxia (Yellow Zone) | **Urgent Care:** Immediate cessation of outdoor activity. Administer supplemental oxygen; initiate nebulization for asthmatics; evaluate for systemic inflammation. Consult physician if sustained >1 hour. |
| **86% – 90%** | Moderate Hypoxia (Red Zone) | **Immediate Hospitalization:** Immediate transport to emergency care (Call 112). High-flow oxygen therapy; chest X-ray to rule out smog-induced pneumonia or acute heart failure. |
| **Below 85%** | Severe Hypoxia (Critical) | **Critical Emergency:** ICU admission; potential non-invasive ventilation (BiPAP) or intubation; aggressive hemodynamic stabilization. |

*Symptomatic Override & Silent Hypoxia:* For geriatric citizens, mental confusion or excessive lethargy without obvious breathlessness must be treated as equivalent to SpO2 < 90%. Regardless of SpO2, severe dyspnea, chest pain, or cyanosis (blue lips/nails) mandates immediate emergency triage.

## V. Community Integration: From Anxiety to Agency
To combat the collective anxiety of the "grey sky," community leaders must shift the narrative from *helpless vigilance* to *proactive preservation*.

1.  **Ritualizing Safety:** Neighborhood associations (RWAs) and worker unions should institutionalize "Clean Air Breaks." This transforms the mandatory rest break into a social ritual, reducing the stigma of stopping work and reinforcing collective health over individual productivity.
2.  **Demystifying the Invisible:** Community health workers should distribute simple AQI cards and SpO2 monitors. Making the invisible visible reduces psychoanalytic "uncanny" anxiety by providing concrete data.
3.  **The Ethics of Care:** Wearing an N95 must be culturally reframed from "fear" to "responsibility." Protecting one's own breath is framed as an ethical duty to the community. A sick worker or commuter burdens the public health system; therefore, masking and hydrating are acts of civic responsibility.
4.  **Feedback Loops & Psychological First Aid:** Establish community hotlines where workers can report hazardous conditions without fear of job loss. Community leaders should facilitate dialogues where workers can express fatigue and grief regarding pollution, validating the somatic reality of the smog and bridging the gap between individual suffering and institutional response.

***
*Disclaimer: This protocol integrates standard occupational health guidelines with psychological frameworks for community adherence. It does not replace personalized medical advice. In case of severe respiratory distress, seek immediate professional medical attention.*

# Integrated Smog Emergency & Occupational Health Protocol (AQI 150–500+)
**Region:** India | **Applicability:** Outdoor Workers, High-Risk Commuters, and Pediatric Cardiac Patients

**Disclaimer:** *This protocol provides clinical and occupational guidance for hazardous smog events. It does not replace individualized medical advice. In severe distress, contact emergency services (108/112) immediately.*

---

## 1. General Mandatory Safety Protocols (All Groups)
During AQI events ranging from 150 (Poor) to 500+ (Severe/Hazardous), the following mandates apply to minimize hypoxic stress and particulate matter (PM2.5/PM10) inhalation.

*   **N95 Respirator Mandate:** Certified N95/FFP2 masks are mandatory for outdoor exposure. Cloth/surgical masks are ineffective. Fit checks must ensure no gaps. Replace every 8 hours or sooner if damp/soiled.
*   **Mandatory Hydration:** Minimum 3 liters of water daily for adults (250ml every hour during shifts). Electrolyte/ORS solutions are mandated for workers in AQI >300 to prevent heat stress and blood thickening. 
*   **Mandatory Rest Breaks:** 15-minute rest break every 2 hours in an indoor, air-purified environment. Limit continuous outdoor exposure to 30-minute intervals where possible.

---

## 2. Occupational Health Protocols: Indian Outdoor Workers
Employers and municipal bodies must enforce these protections for vulnerable labor sectors.

| Worker Category | Specific Risk | Protocol Mandate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Delivery Gig Riders** | Prolonged traffic exposure; high respiratory rate. | **N95 Mandatory.** App algorithms must mandate 10-minute indoor breaks every 2 hours. Hydration checkpoints enforced. |
| **Traffic Police** | Stationary high-exposure zones; exhaust inhalation. | **Rotation:** Shift rotation every 60 mins at AQI >400 to indoor booths. **N95 + Goggles.** SpO2 monitoring at shift start/end. |
| **Construction Laborers** | Dust + Smog synergy; physical exertion. | **Work Stoppage:** No heavy lifting outdoors if AQI > 300. Wet sprinkling mandatory. N95 provided by contractor. |
| **Street Vendors** | Fixed location exposure; lack of shelter. | Provision of portable air screens/purifiers. Hydration stations provided by municipal corporations. |

---

## 3. High-Risk Commuter Protocols
Specialized guidance for non-occupational high-risk groups commuting during severe smog.

*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid outdoor commuting during AQI >200 (risks of fetal growth restriction/preterm birth). Use vehicles with cabin filtration. **Triage:** Immediate OB-GYN consult if SpO2 < 93% or fetal movement decreases.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Carry rescue inhalers (Salbutamol). School outdoor activities cancelled if AQI > 200. **Triage:** ER admission if inhaler provides no relief within 20 minutes or SpO2 < 92%.
*   **Geriatric Citizens (65+):** Avoid morning walks entirely during AQI > 150. Monitor for silent hypoxia. **Triage:** ER admission if SpO2 < 90% or onset of confusion/chest pain.

---

## 4. Pediatric Emergency Protocol: Children with Heart Defects
**Context:** Children with Congenital Heart Diseases (CHD) are at extreme risk during smog. PM2.5 induces pulmonary vasoconstriction, increasing right heart strain and exacerbating hypoxemia.

### A. Risk of Cyanosis
*   **Mechanism:** Smog-induced hypoxia reduces arterial oxygen saturation. In cyanotic defects (e.g., Tetralogy of Fallot), this worsens right-to-left shunting.
*   **Visual Signs:** Deepening blue discoloration of lips (circumoral cyanosis), nail beds, and tongue.
*   **Action:** If cyanosis is visible despite oxygen therapy, treat as a "Tet Spell" equivalent emergency.

### B. N95 Mask Precautions for Pediatric Cardiac Patients
*   **Age Restriction:** N95s are not recommended for children under 2 years due to suffocation risk.
*   **Breathing Resistance:** Children with heart failure may struggle with the increased work of breathing caused by N95 filtration.
    *   **Protocol:** If the child shows signs of respiratory distress (retractions, nasal flaring) while wearing the mask, remove immediately and move to a sealed, HEPA-filtered indoor environment.
    *   **Alternative:** Use of portable personal air purifiers or closed vehicles with recirculation is preferred over masking for severe cardiac cases.

### C. Commuting Guidelines
*   **AQI 150-200:** Limit outdoor time to <30 mins. N95 mandatory if >2 years.
*   **AQI 200-300:** Non-essential commuting prohibited. Use closed vehicles with recirculation.
*   **AQI 300-500+:** Strict indoor confinement. School attendance suspended. Tele-medicine consults only.

---

## 5. SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds
Immediate hospital triage is required based on Oxygen Saturation (SpO2) measured via pulse oximetry.

| Patient Category | Baseline SpO2 (Expected) | **Emergency Triage Threshold** | **Action Required** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Healthy Adult/Worker** | 97% - 100% | **< 92%** | Administer O2; remove from exposure. |
| **Pregnant Women** | 97% - 100% | **< 93%** | Fetal monitoring; Oxygen therapy. |
| **Geriatric / Comorbid** | 97% - 100% | **< 90%** | Cardiac/Pulmonary workup; Admit if persistent. |
| **Acyanotic Heart Defect** | 95% - 100% | **< 92%** | Immediate Cardiology Consult. Risk of heart failure. |
| **Cyanotic Heart Defect** | 75% - 85% (Varies) | **< Baseline - 5%** | **Immediate ER.** Example: If baseline is 80%, trigger at 75%. |
| **All High-Risk Groups** | N/A | **< 85% Absolute** | **Critical Emergency.** Call Ambulance (108/112). |

### Clinical Emergency Response Flowchart (Pediatric Cardiac)
1.  **Measure SpO2:** Compare against known baseline.
2.  **Assess Work of Breathing:** Check for grunting, flaring, retractions.
3.  **Check Cyanosis:** Inspect tongue and mucous membranes.
4.  **Decision:**
    *   **SpO2 > Threshold & Stable:** Monitor indoors, humidified air, hydration.
    *   **SpO2 < Threshold OR Cyanosis Present:** Administer oxygen (if prescribed), keep child calm (knee-chest position for Tetralogy spells), and transport to nearest Pediatric Cardiac Care Unit.

# Holistic Maternal and Emergency Health Protocol for Hazardous Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Issued by: Department of Obstetrics & Gynecology / Occupational Health Division**
**Target Population:** Indian Outdoor Workers (Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors) & High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens)

As an OB-GYN, I recognize that extreme air pollution is a systemic stressor. Particulate matter (PM2.5) can cross the placental barrier, triggering oxidative stress, vascular constriction, and inflammation. This increases the risk of preterm labor, preeclampsia, and fetal growth restriction. This protocol integrates occupational health for outdoor workers with clinical emergency triage for high-risk commuters to prioritize fetal and maternal oxygenation in toxic environments.

## 1. AQI Risk Stratification & Action Levels
*   **AQI 150–200 (Poor):** Vulnerable groups reduce outdoor exposure. Workers implement mandatory rest breaks.
*   **AQI 201–300 (Very Poor):** Pregnant women and geriatric citizens remain indoors. Outdoor work requires strict PPE and reduced hours.
*   **AQI 301–500+ (Severe to Hazardous):** Non-essential outdoor activity ceased. Essential workers operate under emergency clinical monitoring.

## 2. Mandatory N95 Respirator Protocols
Standard cloth or surgical masks are insufficient against PM2.5. N95/FFP2 respirators are mandatory for all outdoor personnel and high-risk commuters when AQI exceeds 150.
*   **Fit & Seal:** Perform a user seal check before every shift. Trim facial hair to ensure a tight seal. Use child-sized N95s for asthmatic children.
*   **Replacement:** Replace every 48 hours during AQI 150–300. During AQI 301–500+, replace every 24 hours or immediately if breathing resistance increases.
*   **High-Risk Commuters:** Pregnant women must wear N95s during any transit. If breathlessness occurs, stop immediately and seek fresh air. Geriatric citizens must wear N95s for any essential outdoor movement.

## 3. Mandatory Hydration and Rest Breaks (Preterm Labor Prevention)
Dehydration and heat stress combined with hypoxia trigger uterine contractions and preterm labor.
*   **Hydration Mandate:** Outdoor workers must consume 3–4 liters of water/electrolytes per shift. Pregnant women should increase intake by 500ml/day to maintain amniotic fluid volume. Urine must remain pale yellow.
*   **Rest Break Schedule:**
    *   **AQI 150–200:** 10-minute break every 2 hours in a shaded or indoor "clean air zone."
    *   **AQI 201–300:** 15-minute break every hour.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** 15-minute break every 45 minutes. Rest areas must be shaded or air-conditioned to prevent hyperthermia, which exacerbates pollution toxicity.
*   **Contraction Monitoring:** Pregnant workers must monitor for uterine contractions. If >4 contractions occur in an hour, work must cease immediately.

## 4. Occupational Health Protocols for Indian Outdoor Workers
*   **Delivery Gig Riders:** Limit shift duration to 6 hours during AQI >300. High exertion increases breathing rates, pulling particulates deeper into the lungs.
*   **Traffic Police:** Implement rotation rosters. Officers at high-density intersections must rotate every 60 minutes during AQI >200. Install portable air purifiers in duty booths.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Wet down sites to suppress dust. Suspend all dust-generating activities during AQI 500+. Supervisors must carry pulse oximeters for random checks.
*   **Street Vendors:** Relocate stalls away from direct traffic exhaust during peak inversion hours (8–10 AM, 8–10 PM). Use transparent plastic barriers to create micro-environments and take frequent seated breaks.

## 5. High-Risk Commuter Protocols
*   **Pregnant Women:** Avoid commuting during peak traffic hours. Use private vehicles with recirculated air. Perform daily fetal kick counts; reduced movement warrants an immediate Non-Stress Test (NST) at the hospital.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Zero outdoor physical exertion when AQI > 300. Use preventive inhalers 15 minutes before unavoidable exposure and carry rescue inhalers at all times.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Monitor blood pressure alongside SpO2 twice daily. Smog increases the risk of myocardial infarction and stroke; shift exercise indoors with air purification.

## 6. SpO2 Hospital Triage & Emergency Thresholds
Pulse oximetry is the primary tool for determining hypoxia. Pregnant women have higher oxygen demands; thresholds are set conservatively to ensure fetal safety.

| Patient Group | Action Threshold (Consult Doctor) | Emergency Triage Threshold (Hospital Admission) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pregnant Women** | **< 95%** (Sustained 10 mins) | **< 92%** or decreased fetal movement |
| **Asthmatic Children** | **< 94%** | **< 92%** or rescue inhaler ineffective |
| **Geriatric Citizens** | **< 94%** | **< 92%** or signs of cyanosis/confusion |
| **General Workers** | **< 94%** (Stop work, rest) | **< 90%** or accompanied by chest tightness |

### Emergency Clinical Pathway:
1.  **Decontamination:** Stop activity, move to an indoor air-purified environment, and remove the mask only when in clean air.
2.  **Triage:** If SpO2 drops below the Emergency Triage Threshold, administer supplemental oxygen (4–6 L/min) and call emergency services (108/112). Inform dispatchers of pregnancy status.
3.  **Maternal Monitoring:** For pregnant patients, perform an immediate Fetal Heart Rate (FHR) monitor and ultrasound to check amniotic fluid and placental perfusion.
4.  **Hospital Intake:** Priority tagging for pregnant patients and workers presenting with hypoxia; immediate obstetric consultation required.

**Disclaimer:** *This protocol provides occupational and clinical guidance based on current medical consensus regarding air pollution and maternal health. It does not replace individualized medical advice.*

*   **विशिष्टता:** BIS-प्रमाणित (IS 9473) या NIOSH-प्रमाणित N95/FFP2 रेस्पिरेटर।

### 3. हाइड्रेशन और आराम के ब्रेक (हार्मोनल और प्रजनन स्वास्थ्य पर केंद्रित)

#### A. सामान्य बाहरी कार्यकर्ता (गिग राइडर्स, पुलिस, मजदूर, वेंडर्स)
*   **हाइड्रेशन:** दैनिक न्यूनतम 3–4 लीटर पानी। श्लेष्म झिल्ली की नमी बनाए रखने के लिए हर 1–2 घंटे में 250–300 मिलीलीटर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट घोल (ORS या नमक वाला नींबू पानी) पिएं। कैफीन युक्त पेय पदार्थों से बचें।

*   **कार्य संशोधन:** AQI >300 के दौरान गर्भवती कार्यकर्ताओं को बिना किसी दंड के इनडोर भूमिकाओं में स्थानांतरित किया जाना चाहिए या सशुत छुट्टी दी जानी चाहिए।
*   **मासिक धर्म स्वास्थ्य:** युवा वयस्क महिलाओं को हाइपोक्सिक तनाव के दौरान मासिक धर्म के समय बढ़ी हुई थकान का अनुभव हो सकता है; अतिरिक्त आराम के ब्रेक नैदानिक रूप से सलाह दिए जाते हैं।

### 4. नैदानिक आपातकालीन ट्रायज: SpO2 थ्रेशोल्ड
*उच्च जोखिम वाले व्यक्तियों और संकट की रिपोर्ट करने वाले कार्यकर्ताओं के लिए पल्स ऑक्सीमेट्री (SpO2) की निगरानी की जानी चाहिए।*

| SpO2 रीडिंग | नैदानिक स्थिति | कार्रवाई प्रोटोकॉल |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | सामान्य | निगरानी जारी रखें। हाइड्रेशन और N95 उपयोग बनाए रखें। |
| **93% – 94%** | **सावधानी** | **तुरंत आराम।** इनडोर क्लीन एयर जोन में जाएं। 30 मिनट में पुनः जांच करें। यदि बना रहता है, तो GP/CHC से परामर्श करें। |
| **90% – 92%** | **उच्च जोखिम** | **अस्पताल ट्रायज आवश्यक।** यदि उपलब्ध हो तो पूरक ऑक्सीजन (2L/min) दें। निकटतम PHC/अस्पताल ले जाएं। |
