# Emergency Health Protocol: Hazardous Air Quality Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Issued by:** Department of Occupational Health & Clinical Immunology  
**Target Population:** Indian Outdoor Workforce (Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors) and High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens)  

---

## 1. Immunological Mechanism & Risk Context
During severe smog events (AQI 150–500+), the air is saturated with PM2.5 and PM10. These particles act as both **antigens** and **chemical adjuvants**, binding to environmental allergens (pollen, fungal spores) and toxic chemicals. 

When inhaled, these complexes bypass the upper airway and penetrate deep into the alveoli, triggering a **Type I Hypersensitivity reaction** (IgE-mediated mast cell degranulation) in sensitized individuals. This releases pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-4, IL-5, IL-6), leading to bronchoconstriction, mucosal edema, and systemic oxidative stress. At AQI >300, the mucociliary escalator (the lung's self-cleaning mechanism) becomes paralyzed, escalating the risk from simple irritation to acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) or severe asthma/COPD exacerbations.

---

## 2. N95 Respirator Mandates (Antigen Exposure Blocking)
**Objective:** Physically block particulate antigens from contacting the respiratory mucosa. Standard cloth or surgical masks are **insufficient** for AQI >150 as they fail to filter sub-micron particulate matter.

### A. General Mandate & Replacement
*   **AQI 150–300:** BIS-certified or NIOSH-approved N95/FFP2 respirators are **mandatory** for all outdoor workers and high-risk commuters.
*   **AQI 300–500+:** N95/FFP2 is mandatory; N99 or P100 is strongly recommended for those with known hypersensitivity.
*   **Replacement:** Replace every 2 days (AQI 150–300) or every 24 hours (AQI 300–500+). Replace immediately if damp, soiled, or if breathing resistance increases.
*   **Fit Check:** Inhale sharply (mask should collapse slightly); exhale (check for leaks around the nose bridge).

### B. Population-Specific Guidelines
*   **Delivery Gig Riders:** Use head straps, not ear loops, to maintain a tight seal against wind pressure.
*   **Traffic Police:** Use respirators with exhalation valves to reduce heat stress during prolonged standing, provided filtration integrity is maintained.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Mandatory even during "low dust" activities. Double-masking is prohibited as it increases breathing resistance, causing the wearer to pull more pollutants through gaps.
*   **Street Vendors:** Mandatory during peak traffic hours (8–11 AM, 5–9 PM). Position stalls upwind where possible.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Use pediatric-sized N95s to prevent leakage gaps. If breathing resistance is too high, limit outdoor exposure entirely.
*   **Pregnant Women:** Mandatory N95. If dizziness occurs, move immediately to an indoor clean-air zone.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Use masks with low breathing resistance but high filtration (e.g., KF94 or N95 with valve if not immunocompromised).

---

## 3. Mandatory Hydration & Rest Breaks (Immune Modulation)
**Objective:** Maintain mucosal barrier integrity (mucociliary clearance) and reduce metabolic oxygen demand (minute ventilation) to lower the total antigen load inhaled per shift. Dehydration thickens mucus, trapping pollutants and accelerating infection risk.

### A. Hydration Protocol
*   **Mechanism:** Adequate hydration keeps respiratory mucus viscosity low, enabling cilia to sweep trapped antigens out of the lungs.
*   **Requirement:** 250–300 mL of water every hour. Avoid highly caffeinated drinks. Add oral rehydration salts (ORS) during high-heat conditions.
*   **Specifics:** Asthmatic children should prefer warm water to prevent cold-induced bronchospasm. Geriatric citizens should monitor urine color (pale yellow indicates adequate hydration).

### B. Rest Break Schedule
*   **AQI 150–200:** 10-minute break every 2 hours in a shaded area.
*   **AQI 201–300:** 15-minute break every 2 hours in an indoor/filtered environment.
*   **AQI 301–500+:** 20–30 minutes of "Clean Air Rest" every 90 minutes to 1 hour. Work shifts must be rotated to limit continuous exposure to <4 hours per day. During breaks, workers must remove masks, perform deep diaphragmatic breathing in a filtered zone, and hydrate.

---

## 4. SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds (Clinical Emergency)
**Objective:** Early identification of hypoxemia to prevent respiratory failure. Pulse oximetry must be available at occupational health centers and Mohalla Clinics. Measure SpO2 after 5 minutes of rest; ensure warm fingers and no nail polish.

| Population Group | Safe Zone | Warning Zone (Seek Clinic) | Critical Zone (Emergency Admission) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Healthy Outdoor Workers** | 95–100% | 93–94% | **≤ 92%** |
| **Asthmatic Children** | 95–100% | 94% (with wheeze) | **≤ 93% OR any distress** |
| **Pregnant Women** | 95–100% | 94% | **≤ 93%** (Fetal risk high) |
| **Geriatric Citizens** | 94–100% | 92–93% | **≤ 91%** |
| **Pre-existing Lung Disease** | 90–94%* | 88–89% | **≤ 87%** |

*\*Note: Patients with COPD may have lower baselines, but a drop of >4% from baseline during smog events warrants emergency care.*

**Emergency Red Flags (Seek Immediate Care regardless of SpO2):**
*   Cyanosis (bluish tint to lips or fingernails).
*   Use of accessory muscles for breathing (neck/chest straining).
*   Inability to speak in full sentences.
*   Confusion or extreme lethargy (signs of cerebral hypoxia).

---

## 5. Implementation & Enforcement
*   **Employer Liability:** Gig platforms, municipal bodies, and construction firms are liable for providing N95 masks, water stations, and filtered rest areas.
*   **Public Health Alert:** AQI readings must be broadcast via SMS and radio at 8:00 AM daily. Outdoor sports for children must be cancelled if AQI >200.
*   **Emergency Response:** Ambulance services must prioritize respiratory distress calls during AQI >400 events.

**Disclaimer:** *This protocol provides occupational health guidance based on immunological principles. It does not replace individual medical advice. In cases of severe respiratory distress, contact emergency services (112 in India) immediately.*

# Integrated Clinical & Occupational Health Protocol for Hazardous Smog Events (AQI 150–500+)

**Scope:** This guideline applies to Indian outdoor workers (delivery gig riders, traffic police, construction laborers, street vendors) and high-risk commuters (pregnant women, asthmatic children, geriatric citizens), with a primary focus on geriatric citizens with hypertension.

## 1. Pathophysiology: Synergy Between Pollution and Cardiovascular Stress
For geriatric citizens with hypertension, particulate matter (PM2.5/PM10) creates a dangerous synergy with existing cardiovascular conditions:
*   **Systemic Inflammation & Endothelial Dysfunction:** Inhaled ultrafine particles enter the bloodstream, triggering oxidative stress and arterial stiffness.
*   **Autonomic Dysfunction:** Pollution stress elevates catecholamines, triggering the sympathetic nervous system. This causes acute vasoconstriction and spikes in blood pressure (BP) and heart rate.
*   **Thrombotic Risk:** Increased blood viscosity and platelet activation raise the risk of myocardial infarction and ischemic stroke during commute stress.
*   **Hypoxia:** Carbon monoxide and reduced lung capacity lower oxygen delivery, forcing the heart to work harder to maintain perfusion. 

## 2. Universal Mandatory Protective Measures (AQI >150)
All individuals exposed to AQI >150 must adhere to the following mandates:

### A. N95 Respirator Mandate
*   **Requirement:** Cloth and surgical masks are clinically insufficient. Only BIS-certified or NIOSH-approved N95/FFP2 respirators are permitted.
*   **Fit Check:** Users must perform a seal check every time the mask is donned. Facial hair must be trimmed to ensure a tight seal.
*   **Replacement:** Discard after 8 hours of use, or immediately if damp, soiled, or if breathing resistance increases due to pollutant saturation.

### B. Mandatory Hydration Protocol
*   **Regimen:** Drink 250 mL of water every hour during outdoor exposure. Outdoor workers should use electrolyte-balanced water.
*   **Rationale:** Hydration maintains mucociliary clearance in the lungs and prevents hemoconcentration (blood thickening), which exacerbates hypertension and clot risk.
*   **Restriction:** Avoid caffeine, alcohol, and cold beverages, which promote dehydration or induce vasoconstriction.

### C. Mandatory Rest Breaks
*   **Frequency:** A minimum 15-minute rest break in a clean-air indoor or filtered environment is required for every 2 hours of outdoor exposure.
*   **Activity:** Remove the respirator only in a verified low-pollution zone. Perform slow deep-breathing exercises to reduce sympathetic stress.

## 3. Occupational Health Protocols (Indian Outdoor Workers)
Employers and gig platforms must enforce these protections for workers operating in AQI 150–500+ zones:

| Worker Category | Specific Protocol Mandate | Emergency Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Delivery Gig Riders** | **Shift Limits:** Limit shift to 6 hours at AQI >200; 4 hours at AQI >300. **Routing:** Avoid high-traffic tunnels/idling zones. Electric vehicles preferred. | Stop delivery immediately if experiencing chest tightness or dizziness. Report to hub medical officer. |
| **Traffic Police** | **Rotation:** Shifts limited to 2 hours continuous at high-intersection points. **Booths:** Use of air-purified booths during breaks is mandatory. | If BP exceeds 160/100 mmHg during duty, immediate relief from post and medical evaluation required. |
| **Construction Laborers** | **Dust Control:** Water sprinkling mandatory every 30 mins. **Work Stoppage:** Halt dust-generating activities (cutting/grinding) at AQI >300. Provide N95s with exhalation valves. | Workers showing cyanosis or severe coughing must be transported to the nearest occupational health center. |
| **Street Vendors** | **Positioning:** Relocate stalls 50 meters away from main traffic flow. **Shielding:** Use plastic sheeting or portable air curtains to reduce direct particulate flow. | Vendors with pre-existing conditions must cease operation at AQI 400+. |

## 4. High-Risk Commuter Protocols

### A. Geriatric Citizens with Hypertension (Priority Focus)
*   **Commute Restriction:** Avoid commute during peak traffic hours (7–11 AM, 5–9 PM). Non-essential travel is prohibited at AQI 300+. Essential travel requires private AC transport with recirculation mode ON.
*   **Medication Adherence:** Antihypertensive medication must be taken strictly on schedule. Carry sublingual nitrates or emergency BP medication if prescribed.
*   **Monitoring:** Check BP before and after commute. If Systolic BP >180 mmHg or Diastolic >110 mmHg, cancel commute and consult physician.
*   **Exertion Limit:** Walk slowly; avoid carrying heavy loads. Must be accompanied by a caregiver capable of administering first aid.

### B. Pregnant Women
*   **Risk:** PM2.5 crosses the placental barrier, risking low birth weight, preterm birth, and pre-eclampsia.
*   **Protocol:** Avoid all non-essential outdoor exposure when AQI >200. If travel is essential, use AC vehicles with recirculation mode ON. Maintain an increased fluid intake (3L/day).

### C. Asthmatic Children
*   **Risk:** High susceptibility to bronchospasm triggered by cold air and particulates.
*   **Protocol:** School attendance should be remote during AQI 400+. Rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) must be carried at all times. Zero outdoor play allowed during hazardous smog events.

## 5. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Hospital Triage Thresholds
Pulse oximetry (SpO2) is the primary tool for emergency triage. Establish a baseline SpO2 on healthy air days, measure after resting 5 minutes indoors, and immediately after commute/exposure.

### SpO2 Triage Thresholds
| SpO2 Reading | Clinical Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | Normal | Continue monitoring. Maintain hydration and N95 usage. |
| **93% – 94%** | Mild Hypoxia (Caution) | Cease outdoor activity immediately. Rest in clean air. Recheck in 30 mins. Consult GP if persistent. |
| **< 92%** | Urgent Care | Proceed to nearest clinic/hospital. Requires oxygen assessment and possible bronchodilators. |
| **$\le 90\%$** | Critical Emergency | **Urgent Hospital Admission.** Call Emergency Services (112). Immediate oxygen therapy and cardiovascular screening required. High risk of hypoxic injury. |
| **Drop > 4%** | Emergency | If SpO2 drops >4% from baseline after exposure (e.g., 98% to 93%), seek urgent care even if absolute value is >90%. |

### Red Flag Symptoms (Regardless of SpO2)
Immediate hospital transfer is required if the commuter exhibits:
1.  **Angina:** Crushing chest pain or radiation to the left arm/jaw.
2.  **Neurological Deficit:** Slurred speech, facial droop, limb weakness, confusion, or syncope.
3.  **Dyspnea:** Inability to speak in full sentences while at rest.
4.  **Hypertensive Crisis:** Systolic BP >180 mmHg with headache/visual changes.

## 6. Implementation & Compliance Matrix
| AQI Range | Risk Level | Mandate | Restriction |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Moderate/Poor | N95 Recommended | Limit prolonged outdoor exertion. |
| **201–300** | Very Poor | **N95 Mandatory** | High-risk groups (Geriatric/Pregnant) should limit travel. |
| **301–500+** | Severe/Hazardous | **N95 Mandatory + SpO2 Monitoring** | Total avoidance for high-risk groups; mandatory rest breaks for workers. AQI 500+ triggers "Health Emergency" status; all non-essential outdoor work ceases legally. |

*Disclaimer: This guideline serves as a clinical and occupational health protocol. It does not replace individual physician advice. In case of severe distress, contact local emergency services immediately.*

# Clinical Emergency & Occupational Health Protocol: Severe Smog Response (AQI 150–500+)

**Issuing Authority:** Preventive Medicine Division (Cardiovascular & Occupational Health Focus)  
**Region:** Indian Urban Environments  
**Target Populations:** Outdoor Workers (Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors) and High-Risk Commuters (Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens).  

---

## 1. AQI Stratification & Action Matrix
This protocol activates based on real-time Air Quality Index (AQI) readings to balance the physiological stress of heat and particulate matter against the benefits of continued labor.

| AQI Range | Category | Outdoor Workers Protocol | High-Risk Commuters Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150–200** | Moderate/Poor | **Yellow Alert:** N95 mandatory during peak hours. Hydration every 30 mins. | Limit prolonged exposure. N95 recommended for transit. |
| **201–300** | Poor/Very Poor | **Orange Alert:** N95 mandatory full shift. Reduced shifts (max 6 hrs). 15-min rest every 90 mins. | Avoid outdoor activity. Essential travel only with N95. |
| **301–400** | Very Poor/Severe | **Red Alert:** Extended rest breaks (15 min/hr). Heavy lifting prohibited. Work in filtered air zones. | **Stay Indoors.** Zero outdoor exposure for children/geriatric/pregnant. |
| **401–500+** | Severe/Emergency | **Maroon Alert:** **Work Suspension** unless essential emergency services. Continuous SpO2 monitoring. | **Complete Shelter-in-Place.** Emergency medical support on standby. |

---

## 2. Respiratory Protection: N95 Mandates
Particulate Matter ($\text{PM}_{2.5}$) penetrates deep into the alveoli, triggering systemic inflammation and increasing thrombosis risk. Standard surgical or cloth masks are ineffective.

*   **Standard & Fit:** Masks must meet **BIS IS 9473** or **NIOSH N95/FFP2** standards. Users must perform a seal check (inhale/exhale sharply) before donning. Facial hair must be trimmed to ensure seal integrity.
*   **Group Mandates:**
    *   **Traffic Police & Construction:** Mandatory N95 at AQI >150. Helmets must accommodate mask seal.
    *   **Delivery Gig Riders:** Mandatory N95 at AQI >200. Platform apps must disable "offline" penalties for mask-adjustment breaks.
    *   **Street Vendors:** Mandatory N95 at AQI >200. Municipal bodies to provide free stock.
    *   **High-Risk Commuters:** Mandatory N95 at AQI >150 for any unavoidable transit.
*   **Replacement Cycle:** Replace every 40 hours of use or when soiled/wet. In AQI >300, replace every 4–8 hours for high-exertion roles or if breathing resistance increases.
*   **Clinical Contraindications:** Geriatric patients with severe COPD or asthmatic children may experience hypercapnia or increased work of breathing. If resistance is too high, they must avoid exposure entirely rather than wear an N95.

---

## 3. Mandatory Hydration & Thermoregulation
Smog events often coincide with heat stress. Dehydration thickens blood, compounding $\text{PM}_{2.5}$-induced clotting risks and cardiovascular strain.

*   **Fluid Composition:** Water alone is insufficient. Electrolyte replenishment (ORS, coconut water, or salted buttermilk) is required every 2 hours to prevent hyponatremia. Avoid caffeine and high-sugar beverages.
*   **Schedule (During Shifts):**
    *   **AQI 150–300:** 250 ml fluid every 30 minutes.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** 250 ml fluid every 15–20 minutes.
*   **Targeted Hydration:**
    *   *Pregnant Women:* 2.5–3L/day to maintain placental perfusion.
    *   *Geriatric Citizens:* Small, frequent sips (100ml every 30 mins) to avoid sudden cardiac preload/fluid overload.
*   **Monitoring:** Urine color check every 4 hours (Target: Pale Yellow). Dark urine indicates immediate hydration deficit requiring break cessation.

---

## 4. Structured Rest Breaks & Work-Rest Cycles
Continuous exposure increases cumulative particulate load. Rest breaks must occur in **low-exposure zones** (indoor spaces with HEPA air purifiers or sealed vehicles). Workers must remove N95 *only* in these clean air zones.

*   **Break Frequency:**
    *   **AQI 150–200:** 10–15 minutes every 2 hours.
    *   **AQI 201–300:** 15 minutes every 90 minutes.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** 15–30 minutes every 1 hour.
*   **Role-Specific Modifications:**
    *   *Traffic Police:* Rotation to indoor booth duty every 60 minutes at AQI >300.
    *   *Construction Laborers:* Heavy lifting prohibited during peak inversion hours (08:00–11:00 and 19:00–22:00).
    *   *Gig Riders:* Platform algorithms must inject mandatory "cool-down" periods after 4 continuous hours of driving during Red/Maroon alerts.
*   **Cardiovascular Monitoring:** Check pulse rate during breaks. If resting HR remains >100 bpm after 15 minutes of rest, cease work and seek medical evaluation.

---

## 5. Clinical Triage: SpO2 & Cardiovascular Thresholds
Peripheral Capillary Oxygen Saturation ($\text{SpO}_2$) is the primary metric for field triage. Use pulse oximetry after 5 minutes of rest.

| $\text{SpO}_2$ Reading | Clinical Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | **Green:** Normal | Continue work with standard precautions. |
| **93% – 94%** | **Yellow:** Warning | Immediate rest in clean air. Recheck in 30 mins. Reduce workload. If persistent, cease outdoor duty. |
| **≤ 92%** | **Red:** Hospital Triage | **Cease work immediately.** Refer to Primary Health Centre/Hospital for evaluation. High risk of fetal hypoxia in pregnant women. |
| **≤ 90%** | **Emergency** | **Call Ambulance (108/112).** Administer oxygen if available. High risk of hypoxia-induced cardiac event. |

**Emergency "Red Flag" Symptoms (Immediate Evacuation):**  
Regardless of $\text{SpO}_2$, immediate hospital referral is required if any of the following occur:
*   Chest pain/pressure or palpitations (Suspected Acute Coronary Syndrome).
*   Stridor, severe wheezing, or sudden severe dyspnea disproportionate to exertion.
*   Syncope, altered mental status, confusion, or slurred speech (Stroke risk).
*   Cyanosis (bluish discoloration of lips/nail beds).

---

## 6. Targeted Protocols for High-Risk Populations

### A. Pregnant Women (Maternal-Fetal Protection)
*   **Risk:** Hypoxia affects fetal development; $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ crosses placental barrier.
*   **Protocol:** N95 mandatory at AQI >150. No outdoor standing or commuting at AQI >300. Employers must provide indoor alternate duty.
*   **Monitoring:** Watch for pre-eclampsia symptoms (headache, swelling, premature contractions) exacerbated by pollution stress.

### B. Asthmatic Children
*   **Risk:** Acute exacerbation leading to status asthmaticus.
*   **Protocol:** Total prohibition of outdoor physical exercise when AQI >200. Schools must cancel outdoor sports/assembly.
*   **Commute & Monitoring:** Carry rescue inhaler (Salbutamol) at all times. If inhaler usage exceeds 2 times/day, seek pediatric review. Use peak flow meters alongside $\text{SpO}_2$; any drop below 80% of personal best requires bronchodilator and medical review. $\text{SpO}_2$ threshold for children is stricter: ≤94% warrants hospital review.

### C. Geriatric Citizens (CV Risk Management)
*   **Risk:** Reduced physiological reserve; $\text{PM}_{2.5}$ triggers plaque instability, arrhythmias, and "Silent Ischemia."
*   **Protocol:** Strict indoor confinement at AQI >200. HEPA air purifiers mandatory in living spaces. Avoid morning walks during peak smog hours (6 AM–10 AM).
*   **Medication:** Ensure adherence to antihypertensives and statins; smog events correlate with hypertensive spikes requiring dosage adjustment by treating physician.

---

## 7. Implementation & Compliance
*   **Employer Responsibility:** Gig platforms, municipal corporations, and construction firms must provide N95 masks, ORS packets, and pulse oximeters free of cost. Insurance must cover pollution-related respiratory/cardiac events.
*   **Infrastructure:** Deploy mobile air quality monitoring vans. Set up "Clean Air Shelters" with oxygen support in high-density zones. Water sprinkling mandatory at construction sites to suppress dust.
*   **Emergency Contact:** All workers must carry a card with emergency contacts and nearest empaneled hospital details.

*Disclaimer: This protocol serves as occupational health guidance. It does not replace individual medical advice. In case of severe symptoms, seek immediate professional medical care.*

**পরিসর:** এই প্রোটোকলটি ভারতের বহিরঙ্গন কর্মীদের (ট্রাফিক পুলিশ, ডেলিভারি গিগ রাইডার, নির্মাণ শ্রমিক, রাস্তার পাশের বিক্রেতা) এবং উচ্চ ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীদের (গর্ভবতী নারী, হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু, বয়স্ক নাগরিক) বিষাক্ত বায়ুর ঘটনায় প্রযোজ্য, যার মূল ফোকাস হলো একিউআই ৩৫০+ অবস্থায় ট্রাফিক পুলিশ কর্তৃক একাধিক গাড়ির দুর্ঘটনা পরিচালনা।

## ১. ফার্স্ট রেসপন্ডার নিরাপত্তা ও পেশাগত স্বাস্থ্য বাধ্যবাধকতা
ট্রাফিক পুলিশ এবং অন্যান্য বহিরঙ্গন কর্মীদের উচ্চ-এক্সপোজারযুক্ত personnel হিসেবে শ্রেণীবদ্ধ করা হয়েছে। তীব্র শ্বাসকষ্ট এবং গৌণ দুর্ঘটনা রোধ করতে নিম্নলিখিত প্রোটোকলগুলো জোরালোভাবে মেনে চলতে হবে।

### ক. N95 রেসপিরেটর বাধ্যবাধকতা
*   **প্রয়োজনীয়তা:** একিউআই ১৫০+ অবস্থায় বহিরে কাজ করা সকল কর্মীকে অবশ্যই সার্টিফাইড N95 বা FFP2 রেসপিরেটর পরতে হবে। PM2.5 সুরক্ষার জন্য কাপড়ের বা সার্জিক্যাল মাস্ক যথেষ্ট নয়।
*   **ট্রাফিক পুলিশ (ফার্স্ট রেসপন্ডার):** দুর্ঘটনাস্থলে পৌঁছানোর সাথে সাথেই N95 মাস্ক পরতে হবে। স্মগ জোনে প্রবেশের আগে নাক বা গালের পাশে কোনো ফাঁক নেই তা নিশ্চিত করতে 'ইউজার সিল চেক' সম্পন্ন করুন।
*   **প্রতিস্থাপন:** ৮ ঘণ্টা ব্যবহারের পর বা মাস্কটি নোংরা/ক্ষতিগ্রস্ত হলে অবিলম্বে ফেলে দিন। ভারী শারীরিক পরিশ্রমের সময় প্রতি ৪ ঘণ্টা পর পর মাস্ক পরিবর্তন করুন।

### খ. বাধ্যতামূলক পানি পান ও বিশ্রাম বিরতি
দূষণ দেহের পানিশূন্যতা এবং হৃদযন্ত্রের ওপর চাপ বাড়িয়ে দেয়।
*   **হাইড্রেশন প্রোটোকল:** রেসপন্ডারদের অবশ্যই প্রতি ৪৫ মিনিট অন্তর ২৫০ মিলি পানি পান করতে হবে। ক্যাফেইন বা চিনিযুক্ত পানীয় এড়িয়ে চলুন, কারণ এগুলো দেহের পানিশূন্যতা দ্রুততর করে।
*   **বিশ্রাম বিরতি:** 
    *   **একিউআই ১৫০–৩০০:** ছায়াযুক্ত বা indoor এলাকায় প্রতি ২ ঘণ্টা অন্তর ১০ মিনিটের বিরতি।
    *   **একিউআই ৩০০–৫০০+:** প্রতি ঘণ্টায় ১৫ মিনিটের বিরতি। দুর্ঘটনা পরিচালনাকারী ট্রাফিক পুলিশ কর্মীদের অক্সিজেন স্যাচুরেশন লেভেল পুনরুদ্ধারের জন্য প্রতি ৬০ মিনিট অন্তর একটি পরিষ্কার বায়ু অঞ্চলে (যেমন: রিসার্কুলেটেড এয়ার সহ টহল গাড়ির ভেতরে বা নিকটবর্তী কোনো ভবনে) ঘুরিয়ে নিতে হবে।

## ২. ক্লিনিক্যাল জরুরি অবস্থা ও SpO2 ট্রায়াজ থ্রেশহোল্ড
কুয়াশার মধ্যে একাধিক গাড়ির দুর্ঘটনায়, শ্বাসযন্ত্রের আঘাত পরিবেশগত বিষাক্ততায় আরও জটিল হতে পারে। ট্রায়াজে অক্সিজেনেশন অবস্থাকে অগ্রাধিকার দিতে হবে।

### ক. SpO2 হাসপাতাল ট্রায়াজ নির্দেশিকা
| SpO2 রিডিং | ক্লিনিক্যাল অবস্থা | অ্যাকশন প্রোটোকল |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **≥ ৯৪%** | স্থিতিশীল | প্রতি ১৫ মিনিট অন্তর পর্যবেক্ষণ করুন। রোগীকে খোলা বাতাসে রাখুন। যদি দৃশ্যমান শ্বাসকষ্ট থাকে তবে অক্সিজেন দিন। |
| **৯০% – ৯৩%** | জরুরি / হাইপোক্সিয়ার ঝুঁকি | **অগ্রাধিকার পরিবহন।** সম্ভব হলে সাপ্লিমেন্টারি অক্সিজেন দিন। অ্যাম্বুলেন্সের (১০৮) মাধ্যমে নিকটতম সুবিধায় পাঠান। |
| **< ৯০%** | গুরুতর / চিকিৎসা জরুরি অবস্থা | **তাৎক্ষণিক লাইফ সাপোর্ট।** অবিলম্বে ১০৮ নম্বরে কল করুন। যান্ত্রিক ভেন্টিলেশনের প্রয়োজন হতে পারে এমন শ্বাসযন্ত্রের ব্যর্থতার উচ্চ ঝুঁকি। যদি শ্বাস বন্ধ হয়ে যায় তবে সিপিআর (CPR) শুরু করুন। |
| **< ৮৫%** | তীব্র হাইপোক্সিয়া | জীবননাশক হাইপোক্সিয়া। অঙ্গ বিকল হওয়ার উচ্চ ঝুঁকি। হাসপাতালে পৌঁছানোর পর আইসিইউ (ICU) ভর্তির প্রয়োজন। |

### খ. শ্বাসযন্ত্রের আঘাত ব্যবস্থাপনা
*   **এয়ারওয়ে ক্লিয়ারেন্স:** শ্বাসনালী থেকে রক্ত বা ধ্বংসাবশেষ পরিষ্কার করুন। কুয়াশার ঘটনায়, খোলা শ্বাসনালীকে দীর্ঘক্ষণ বাইরের বাতাসের সংস্পর্শে আসতে দেবেন না।
*   **তাৎক্ষণিক মাস্কিং:** যদি রোগী জ্ঞানবান থাকেন এবং শ্বাস নিচ্ছেন, তবে বিষাক্ত কুয়াশা আরও শ্বাস নেওয়া রোধ করতে অবিলম্বে একটি N95 মাস্ক দিন।
*   **অবস্থান:** শ্বাসযন্ত্রের রোগীদের ফুসফুসের প্রসারণ সর্বাধিক করার জন্য সেমি-ফাউলার্স অবস্থানে (মাথা ৩০–৪৫° কোণে উঁচু করে) রাখুন।

## ৩. উচ্চ ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীদের অগ্রাধিকার
কুয়াশার ঘটনায় হ্রাসপ্রাপ্ত শারীরবৃত্তীয় সংরক্ষণের কারণে নির্দিষ্ট জনগোষ্ঠীর জন্য হস্তক্ষেপের থ্রেশহোল্ড কমিয়ে আনতে হবে।
*   **গর্ভবতী নারী:** ভ্রূণের হাইপোক্সিয়া রোধ করতে, আঘাতের তীব্রতা নির্বিশেষে অবিলম্বে কুয়াশা এলাকা থেকে সরিয়ে নেওয়ার অগ্রাধিকার দিন। লক্ষ্যমাত্রা SpO2 > ৯৫%।
*   **হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু:** রেসকিউ ইনহেলার available কিনা তা দেখুন। যদি হুইজিং (শ্বাসে বাঁশির মতো শব্দ) থাকে, তবে অবিলম্বে ব্রঙ্কোডাইলেটর দিন। SpO2 < ৯৪% হলে গুরুতর যত্ন স্থানান্তর এবং নেбуলাইজেশনের প্রয়োজন।
*   **বয়স্ক নাগরিক:** বিভ্রান্তি বা চরম ক্লান্তির লক্ষণ পর্যবেক্ষণ করুন (এটি বার্ধক্যজনিত ক্লান্তি নয়, বরং হাইপোক্সিয়ার লক্ষণ হতে পারে)। দূষণ থেকে সৃষ্ট হৃদযন্ত্রের চাপ 'সাইলেন্ট হার্ট অ্যাটাকের' ঝুঁকি বাড়ায়। ৯২%-এর নিচে যেকোনো পতন হাসপাতাল ট্রায়াজের দাবি রাখে।

## ৪. একিউআই ১৫০–৫০০+ এর জন্য সমন্বিত কর্মী নিরাপত্তা কাঠামো

*   **Category B (High-Risk Commuters):** Pregnant Women (any trimester), Asthmatic Children (≤12 yrs), Geriatric Citizens (≥65 yrs).

---

## 1.0 AQI STRATIFICATION AND OPERATIONAL TRIGGERS
Protocols escalate based on real-time CPCB AQI data.

| AQI Range | Classification | Operational Status & Mandatory Actions |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | Moderate/Poor | **Level 1 Alert:** N95 Mandate Active for Category B. Hydration Protocol Active. |
| **201 – 300** | Poor | **Level 2 Alert:** N95 Mandate Active for All Outdoor Workers. Mandatory Rest Breaks begin. |
| **301 – 400** | Very Poor | **Level 3 Alert:** Outdoor Work Hours Reduced by 50%. Work Cessation for Category B. |
| **401 – 500+** | Severe | **Level 4 Alert:** Non-Essential Outdoor Work Halted. Critical Triage Active. High-Risk Commuters Restricted. |

---

## 2.0 RESPIRATORY PROTECTION STANDARDIZATION (N95 COMPLIANCE)
All Category A workers must wear BIS-certified N95 respirators (IS 9473:2002 / IS 17077:2019 equivalent) or NIOSH N95. Cloth/surgical masks are strictly prohibited for occupational duty. Frontline supervisors must verify and log the following Standardized Compliance Codes (SCC) during shift start and every 4-hour interval:

*   **`N95-SCC-00` (PASS):** Seal check successful, no structural damage, strap elasticity intact. Worker cleared for duty.
*   **`N95-SCC-01` (FAIL-SEAL):** Air leakage detected during negative/positive pressure user seal check. **IMMEDIATE REMOVAL.** Replace mask and re-test.
*   **`N95-SCC-02` (FAIL-DAMAGE):** Visible tears, moisture saturation, or strap degradation. **IMMEDIATE REMOVAL.** Discard and issue new unit.
*   **`N95-SCC-03` (FAIL-FIT):** Facial hair or anatomical structure prevents seal. **WORK REASSIGNMENT** to indoor/low-exposure duty.

**Enforcement:** Gig Riders/Traffic Police must display `N95-SCC-00` status on digital health logs to activate duty. Construction/Vendors face physical spot checks. Failure to log `N95-SCC-00` results in immediate work stoppage.

---

## 3.0 MANDATORY HYDRATION AND REST BREAK PROTOCOLS
To mitigate compounded heat-stress and hypoxia risks, the following non-discretionary triggers apply.

### 3.1 Mandatory Hydration Triggers (`HYD-PROTO`)
*   **Volume (`HYD-01`):** Minimum **250 mL** of potable water or Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) per intake. Electrolyte-enriched fluids are mandatory for shifts >4 hours.
*   **Frequency (`HYD-02`):** 
    *   **AQI 150–300:** Every **60 minutes**.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** Every **45 minutes**.
*   **Verification (`HYD-03`):** Supervisors shall log intake. A missed interval > 90 minutes triggers mandatory 15-minute rest.

### 3.2 Mandatory Rest Break Triggers (`RBT-PROTO`)
*   **Location:** Must relocate to a "Clean Air Zone" (indoor space with air filtration/AC). Roadside breaks are prohibited.
*   **Duration & Frequency:**
    *   **AQI 201–300:** 15 minutes rest for every 2 hours of continuous exposure.
    *   **AQI 301–400:** 15 minutes rest for every 90 minutes of exposure.
    *   **AQI 401–500+:** 30 minutes rest for every 60 minutes of exposure. Work halted if breaks cannot be accommodated.

---

## 4.0 CLINICAL TRIAGE AND SpO2 THRESHOLDS
Frontline health workers must utilize calibrated pulse oximeters (ISO 80601-2-61 compliant) on all symptomatic individuals (dyspnea, cough, chest tightness). Measurements require seated, 5-minute rest prior to reading.

### 4.1 SpO2 Triage Thresholds
Decisions are binary based on the following exact cutoff values:

| Population Group | SpO2 Range | Triage Category | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **General Outdoor Workers** | **≥ 95%** | **TRIAGE-GREEN** | Continue duty with monitoring. |
| **General Outdoor Workers** | **91% – 94%** | **TRIAGE-AMBER** | **IMMEDIATE WORK CESSATION.** Administer oxygen (2L/min) if available. Refer to Primary Health Centre / Occupational Health Center within 2 hours. |
| **General Outdoor Workers** | **≤ 90%** | **TRIAGE-RED** | **MEDICAL EMERGENCY.** Call Ambulance (Dial 108). Immediate hospitalization for high-flow oxygen. |
| **High-Risk Commuters** | **≥ 95%** | **TRIAGE-GREEN** | Monitor every 4 hours. |
| **High-Risk Commuters** | **≤ 94%** | **TRIAGE-RED** | **MEDICAL EMERGENCY.** Immediate hospitalization. Do not wait for 90% cutoff. |

### 4.2 Symptom-Based Override
Regardless of SpO2 readings, the presence of the following triggers immediate **TRIAGE-RED**:
*   Cyanosis (blue discoloration of lips/nail beds).
*   Inability to speak in full sentences.
*   Confusion or altered mental status.
*   Peak Expiratory Flow Rate (PEFR) < 50% of personal best (for asthmatics).
*   Rescue inhaler use > 3 times in 24 hours.

---

## 5.0 HIGH-RISK COMMUTER SPECIFIC PROTOCOLS
*   **Pregnant Women (`HR-PREG`):** AQI >200 mandates avoidance of outdoor transit. Any dyspnea requires immediate SpO2 check and clinical evaluation for fetal distress/maternal hypoxia.
*   **Asthmatic Children (`HR-PED`):** AQI >150 prohibits all outdoor physical activity. Must carry rescue inhaler (Salbutamol).
*   **Geriatric Citizens (`HR-GERI`):** AQI >200 restricts outdoor movement. Patients with COPD or CHF must be monitored via pulse oximetry every 4 hours. Public transport mandated over walking/cycling.

---

## 6.0 EMERGENCY ESCALATION MATRIX & DATA RECORDING

| Scenario | Responsible Entity | Response Time | Protocol Code |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Worker Collapse (AQI >300)** | Site Supervisor | **< 5 Minutes** | **EMG-01:** Call 108. Initiate CPR if pulseless. Move to fresh air zone. |
| **Asthmatic Attack** | Guardian/Peer | **< 10 Minutes** | **EMG-02:** Administer rescue inhaler. If no relief in 10 mins, transport to ER. |
| **Mass Hypoxia Event (Multiple SpO2 ≤90%)** | District Health Officer | **< 30 Minutes** | **EMG-03:** Activate Emergency Oxygen Supply Chain. Halt zone operations. |

**Data Recording:** All `N95-SCC`, `HYD-01`, and `SpO2` readings must be recorded in the Occupational Health Digital Registry (OHDR). Health data shall be anonymized per ABDM compliance standards.

**AUTHORIZATION:** This protocol is binding for all municipal corporations, occupational safety officers, and emergency medical services during AQI alerts.

# Community Care & Respiratory Safety Protocol: Navigating the Smog
**A Trauma-Informed Guide for India’s Most Vulnerable Workers and Commuters**

*As a perinatal nurse, I see the invisible burdens you carry—not just the physical weight of your work or the anxiety of a high-risk pregnancy, but the quiet fear that the very air you breathe is betraying you. Please know that your health is not a luxury; it is a necessity. You are the heartbeat of our cities, and you deserve to breathe safely.*

---

## 1. AQI Risk Zones & Mandatory Actions
*Understanding the air you breathe is the first step to safety.*

| AQI Range | Category | Mandatory Action for Outdoor Workers | Mandatory Action for High-Risk Commuters |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | Unhealthy | **N95 Respirator Mandatory.** Limit strenuous exertion. | Pregnant women, children, elderly: Stay indoors if possible. |
| **201 – 300** | Very Unhealthy | **N95 Strict Mandate.** Reduce heavy exertion. 15-min "Clean Air" break every 2 hours. | Avoid outdoor movement. Use air purifiers indoors. |
| **301 – 400** | Severe | **N95 Mandatory.** 15-min rest break every 1 hour. Immediate cessation of heavy labor. | **Do not travel.** Telework/School from home only. |
| **401 – 500+** | Hazardous | **Emergency Status.** Avoid all non-essential outdoor exposure. | **Emergency Shelter.** Stay indoors with sealed windows. Oxygen backup ready. |

---

## 2. Respiratory Protection: The N95 Mandate
*Cloth masks, surgical masks, and scarves do NOT protect against hazardous smog (PM2.5).*

*   **Certification:** All delivery riders, traffic police, and construction workers must wear a certified BIS (IS 9473), NIOSH N95, or FFP2 respirator.
*   **Fit Check:** Pinch the nose clip firmly. Inhale sharply; the mask should collapse slightly. If air leaks from the sides or around the eyes, it is not working.
*   **Replacement:** Discard after 40 hours of cumulative use, or immediately if breathing becomes difficult, the mask is wet, or visibly soiled.
*   **For Children:** Use pediatric-sized N95s to ensure an airtight seal. If the child resists the mask due to anxiety, prioritize staying indoors over masking outdoors.

---

## 3. Occupational Health: Hydration & Rest Breaks
*Dehydration thickens blood and worsens hypoxia. Pollution stresses the heart and lungs.*

### 🛑 Mandatory Break Schedule (AQI 300+)
*   **Delivery Riders & Traffic Police:** Stop vehicle/duty for **15 minutes every 1-2 hours**. Move to an indoor or shaded area with better air quality.
*   **Construction Laborers:** **15 minutes every hour**. Sit down. Allow respiratory rate to normalize.
*   **Street Vendors:** Rotate duties with a partner if possible. Use a portable air shield (clear plastic barrier) around the stall if stationary.

### 💧 Hydration Protocol
*   **Volume:** Minimum 1 glass (250ml) of water every 60 minutes while on duty.
*   **Type:** Warm water or ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution) is preferred to prevent bronchospasm. Avoid caffeine, sugary sodas, and ice-cold drinks.
*   **Decontamination:** Wash face, hands, and exposed skin immediately upon returning home. Use a saline nasal spray to clear particulate matter.

---

## 4. Clinical Emergency: SpO2 Triage Thresholds
*Use a pulse oximeter. Measure after sitting quietly for 5 minutes.*

| SpO2 Reading | Status | Action Protocol |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | ✅ Normal | Continue monitoring. Maintain hydration and mask use. |
| **93% – 94%** | ⚠️ Warning | **Stop work immediately.** Rest in clean air. Recheck in 30 mins. If pregnant, contact OB-GYN. |
| **90% – 92%** | 🚑 Urgent | **Hospital Triage Required.** Administer oxygen if available. Do not wait. |
| **< 90%** | ☠️ Critical | **Call Emergency Services (112).** This indicates hypoxemia requiring oxygen support. |
| **Any Level + Cyanosis** | ☠️ Critical | Blue lips/fingernails = **Immediate Emergency** regardless of SpO2 reading. |

---

## 5. Tailored Guidance for High-Risk Groups

### 🤰 Pregnant Women (Perinatal Focus)
*   **Risk:** Air pollution is linked to pre-eclampsia, low birth weight, and preterm labor. Pregnancy increases oxygen demand.
*   **Protocol:** Avoid peak traffic hours. Count fetal kicks daily; reduced movement + maternal breathlessness = **Immediate Hospital Visit.**
*   **Reassurance:** Maternal SpO2 below 94% compromises fetal oxygenation. Protecting your breath protects your baby. Prioritize rest without guilt.

### 🛵 Delivery Gig Riders & Traffic Police
*   **Risk:** Prolonged exposure at street level where pollution is highest.
*   **Protocol:** Plan routes through less congested lanes. If you feel a "tightness" in your chest, pull over immediately and utilize your 15-minute clean air break. 
*   **Reassurance:** Your service is vital, but you are irreplaceable to your family. Take the break. Drink the water.

### 👵 Geriatric Citizens & Asthmatic Children
*   **Risk:** Reduced lung capacity and developing airways. Children breathe faster, inhaling more pollutants.
*   **Protocol:** Keep rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) visible and accessible. Preventive steroids must not be skipped. Create a "clean room" with sealed windows and AC on recirculate. Keep Nitroglycerin accessible for cardiac patients.
*   **Reassurance:** Avoid early morning or late evening walks when smog settles near the ground.

---

## 6. Emergency Protocol: When to Go to the Hospital
*Do not wait. In smog events, conditions can deteriorate rapidly.*

**Go to the Emergency Department immediately if:**
1.  SpO2 is **< 90%** despite rest.
2.  **Pregnant Women:** Experience vaginal bleeding, severe headache, vision changes, or decreased fetal movement.
3.  **Asthmatics:** Rescue inhaler provides no relief after 3 uses, or if used more than every 4 hours.
4.  **Any Worker:** Experiences chest pain, fainting, or coughing up blood.
5.  **Children:** Exhibit blue tint around lips (cyanosis) or severe wheezing.

**Emergency Contacts:**
*   **National Emergency Number:** 📞 112
*   **Ambulance:** 📞 102 (Free Government Ambulance)
*   **Disaster Management (NDMA):** 📞 104 (Health Helpline)

---

**A Note from Your Nurse:**
We know the economic pressure to work through the smog is immense. We know the city does not always stop for us. But please remember: **Your life has value beyond your productivity.** Wear the mask. Drink the water. Check your oxygen. If you feel unwell, you have the right to seek help. We are here to support you.

*Stay safe. Breathe easy. We are watching over you.*

**লক্ষ্য জনগোষ্ঠী:**
১. **বাইরের শ্রমিকরা:** ডেলিভারি গিগ রাইডার, ট্রাফিক পুলিশ, কনস্ট্রাকশন লেবার, স্ট্রিট ভেন্ডর।

*   **বাধ্যতামূলক ব্যবহার:** AQI > ১৫০ হলে লক্ষ্য জনগোষ্ঠীর সকল ব্যক্তিকে বাইরে থাকার সময় অবশ্যই সার্টিফাইড N95 (অথবা FFP2/FFP3) রেসপিরেটর পরতে হবে। কাপড়ের মাস্ক এবং সার্জিক্যাল মাস্ক পার্টিকুলেট ম্যাটার (PM2.5) থেকে সুরক্ষা দিতে অপর্যাপ্ত।
*   **ফিট টেস্টিং:** বাইরের শ্রমিকদের নিয়োগকর্তাদের অবশ্যই বার্ষিক ভিত্তিতে Proper Fit-Testing নিশ্চিত করতে হবে। শ্রমিকদের প্রতিটি শিফ্ট শুরু করার আগে User Seal Check করতে হবে।

*   **AQI ১৫০–২৫০ (অস্বাস্থ্যকর থেকে খুব অস্বাস্থ্যকর):**
    *   প্রতি ২ ঘণ্টা অন্তর পরিষ্কার বাতাসের পরিবেশে (HEPA ফিল্টারযুক্ত ইনডোর বা সিল করা ঘর) বাধ্যতামূলক ১০ মিনিটের বিশ্রাম।
*   **AQI ২৫১–৫০০+ (বিপজ্জনক):**
    *   প্রতি ঘণ্টায় বাধ্যতামূলক ১৫ মিনিটের বিশ্রাম।
    *   **কাজ স্থগিতকরণ:** AQI > ৪৫০ হলে লেবার এবং ভেন্ডরদের জন্য অপ্রয়োজনীয় বাইরের কাজ স্থগিত করতে হবে। ট্রাফিক পুলিশ এবং জরুরি ডেলিভারি কর্মীদের প্রতি ৪৫ মিনিট অন্তর শিফ্ট পরিবর্তন করতে হবে এবং বাধ্যতামূলকভাবে ইনডোর রিকভারি পিরিয়ড নিতে হবে।
*   **উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীরা:** গর্ভবতী মহিলা, বয়োজ্যেষ্ঠ এবং হাঁপানি রোগী শিশুদের AQI > ২৫০ হলে সকল ধরনের বাইরের চলাফেরা এড়িয়ে চলা উচিত। যদি ভ্রমণ অপরিহার্য হয়, তবে টানা এক্সপোজার ২০ মিনিটের মধ্যে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখতে হবে এবং এরপর পরিষ্কার বাতাসের জোনে ৩০ মিনিট বিশ্রাম নিতে হবে।

### ৪. হাসপাতালে ট্রায়াজের জন্য SpO2 থ্রেশহোল্ড
পালস অক্সিমিটারের মাধ্যমে পরিমাপকৃত অক্সিজেন স্যাচুরেশন (SpO2) এর নিম্নলিখিত থ্রেশহোল্ড অনুযায়ী তাৎক্ষণিক চিকিৎসা মূল্যায়ন এবং সম্ভাব্য হাসপাতালে ভর্তির প্রয়োজন:

*   **সাধারণ জনগোষ্ঠী (শ্রমিক/যাত্রী):**
    *   রুম এয়ারে SpO2 < ৯৪%: জরুরি ক্লিনিকাল মূল্যায়ন প্রয়োজন।
    *   SpO2 < ৯০%: তাৎক্ষণিক জরুরি বিভাগে ভর্তি এবং অক্সিজেন থেরাপি প্রয়োজন।
*   **উচ্চঝুঁকিপূর্ণ গ্রুপ (হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু, বয়োজ্যেষ্ঠ, গর্ভবতী):**
    *   SpO2 < ৯৫%: জরুরি ক্লিনিকাল মূল্যায়ন প্রয়োজন।
    *   SpO2 < ৯২%: তাৎক্ষণিক জরুরি বিভাগে ভর্তি প্রয়োজন।
    *   **হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু:** বেসলাইন থেকে >৩% হ্রাস অথবা SpO2 < ৯৪% এর সাথে যদি হুইজিং বা শ্বাসকষ্টজনিত বুকের ভাঁজ দেখা যায়, তবে তাৎক্ষণিক নেбуলাইজেশন এবং ইআর ট্রায়াজ প্রয়োজন।
*   **অ্যাকশন প্ল্যান:** ফিল্ড সুপারভাইজার এবং পরিবারের তত্ত্বাবধায়কদের সাথে পালস অক্সিমিটার রাখা উচিত। যদি থ্রেশহোল্ড পূরণ হয়, তবে সম্ভব হলে অক্সিজেন সাপোর্ট শুরু করুন এবং পালমোনারি কেয়ার সুবিধাসম্পন্ন নিকটতম সুবিধাকেন্দ্রে নিয়ে যান।

---
**দ্রষ্টব্য:** এই প্রোটোকলগুলো বিশ্ব স্বাস্থ্য সংস্থার (WHO) বায়ুর মানের নির্দেশিকা এবং চরম দূষণের ঘটনায় ভারতীয় চিকিৎসা গবেষণা পরিষদের (ICMR) পরামর্শের সাথে সামঞ্জস্যপূর্ণ। COPD-এর তীব্র জটিলতা, হাঁপানির আক্রমণ এবং গর্ভাবস্থায় প্রতিকূল ফলাফল প্রতিরোধের জন্য অনুবর্তন করা অত্যন্ত গুরুত্বপূর্ণ।

# MANDATORY OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH AND PUBLIC SAFETY PROTOCOL: HAZARDOUS AIR QUALITY (AQI 150–500+)

**Jurisdiction:** Indian Metropolitan Zones  
**Lens:** Forensic Behavioral Assessment & Compliance Accountability  
**Effective Condition:** Activation upon Air Quality Index (AQI) reading ≥ 150.

---

## 1. SCOPE AND TARGET POPULATIONS
This protocol mandates strict adherence to behavioral and physiological safeguards for all entities operating within hazardous smog events. Non-compliance constitutes a violation of occupational safety and public health statutes.

**Covered Outdoor Workforce:**
*   **Delivery Gig Riders:** E-commerce and food delivery partners.
*   **Traffic Police:** Personnel managing intersections and highway patrols.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Workers engaged in excavation, masonry, and demolition.
*   **Street Vendors:** Fixed and mobile vendors exposed to roadside emissions.

**High-Risk Commuters (Protected Class):**
*   **Pregnant Women:** All trimesters.
*   **Asthmatic Children:** Children with documented respiratory conditions.
*   **Geriatric Citizens:** Age 60+.

---

## 2. AQI ACTION MATRIX (150–500+)
Operations must adjust based on real-time Central Pollution Control Board (CPCB) data.

| AQI Range | Category | Operational Mandate |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | Poor | N95 mandatory for outdoor workers; advisory for vulnerable groups. Hydration logs initiated. |
| **201 – 300** | Very Poor | Mandatory N95s and rest breaks enforced. Vulnerable commuters advised against non-essential travel. |
| **301 – 400** | Severe | Outdoor work restricted; vulnerable commuters must stay indoors. Mandatory SpO2 monitoring for essential staff. |
| **401 – 500+** | Severe+ | Critical: Non-essential outdoor work suspended. Emergency services only. |

---

## 3. RESPIRATORY PROTECTION: N95 RESPIRATOR ENFORCEMENT
To mitigate behavioral non-compliance (e.g., mask fatigue, improper fit), the following forensic controls apply:

*   **Standard:** Masks must meet **BIS IS 9473:2002** standards or NIOSH N95 equivalent. Cloth and surgical masks are prohibited for occupational use during AQI >150.
*   **Employer/Platform Liability:** Gig platforms, construction firms, and government departments must procure and distribute N95 respirators at no cost to the worker. Failure to provide PPE constitutes criminal negligence.
*   **Fit Testing & Replacement:** Mandatory seal-check training prior to shift start. Respirators must be replaced every 40 hours of active use or immediately if soiled/damaged. During AQI 400+, replacement is required every 24 hours.
*   **Enforcement Mechanisms:**
    *   **Gig Economy:** Delivery apps must implement a "Safety Check-in" feature requiring photo verification of N95 usage before a rider can accept deliveries.
    *   **Public Safety:** Traffic police supervisors must conduct hourly compliance checks. Non-compliance results in immediate reassignment to indoor duty.
    *   **Supply Chain:** Employers must maintain digital logs of mask distribution linked to worker IDs.

---

## 4. PHYSIOLOGICAL PRESERVATION: HYDRATION AND REST
To prevent systemic incapacitation caused by oxidative stress and heat-smog synergy, mandatory break intervals are established based on AQI tiers.

### 4.1 Mandatory Break Intervals
| AQI Range | Work/Exposure Duration | Mandatory Rest Break | Location Requirement |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **150 – 200** | 2 Hours | 15 Minutes | Shaded Area |
| **201 – 300** | 2 Hours | 15 Minutes | Indoor/Ventilated |
| **301 – 400** | 45 Minutes | 20 Minutes | Indoor/Air-Purified |
| **401 – 500+** | 30 Minutes | 30 Minutes | Indoor/Air-Purified |

### 4.2 Hydration Protocol
*   **Volume:** Minimum 250ml of water or Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) per break interval to maintain osmotic balance.
*   **Monitoring:** Supervisors must verify hydration via spot checks or digital app confirmation. Gig apps must prompt riders to hydrate during active shifts.
*   **Prohibitions:** Caffeine and diuretics are prohibited during shifts at AQI 300+ to prevent dehydration-induced blood viscosity increases.

### 4.3 Worker-Specific Enforcement
*   **Traffic Police:** Rotation off high-emission intersections every 90 minutes during AQI >300. Booths must be equipped with air purifiers.
*   **Delivery Riders:** App algorithms must enforce "Air Quality Downtime" without penalty to their rating or earnings. Penalizing riders for delays caused by mandatory safety breaks is prohibited.
*   **Construction Laborers:** Heavy machinery operation must halt at AQI 400+. Supervised break logs are required for ground labor.
*   **Street Vendors:** Municipal corporations must provide access to "Clean Air Shelters" (community halls with purifiers) during peak smog hours.

---

## 5. CLINICAL EMERGENCY TRIAGE: SpO2 THRESHOLDS
Objective pulse oximetry measurements will determine immediate hospital admission to prevent respiratory failure. Pulse oximeters must be available at police stations, construction site offices, and gig hub centers.

### 5.1 SpO2 Triage Criteria
| Risk Group | SpO2 Threshold | Clinical Action |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **General Workers (95-100%)** | Normal | Continue work with standard breaks. |
| **General Workers (< 92%)** | Emergency | Immediate oxygen therapy; pulmonary evaluation. Transport to nearest facility. |
| **Geriatric Citizens (< 94%)** | Critical | Admission for monitoring; risk of acute heart failure. |
| **Pregnant Women (< 95%)** | Critical | Immediate fetal distress screening; high-flow oxygen. |
| **Asthmatic Children (< 94%)** | Critical | Nebulization and immediate pediatric admission. |

*If SpO2 drops to 90% or below, dispatch emergency services (108) immediately for ICU evaluation of hypoxic injury.*

---

## 6. FORENSIC BEHAVIORAL ACCOUNTABILITY
To ensure adherence, a forensic lens is applied to track behavior, identify negligence, and enforce accountability, preventing "compliance fatigue."

*   **Digital Audit Trails:** Gig platforms must log "Mask On" self-certifications and break times. Traffic departments must maintain shift rotation logs verifying clean-air rest periods.
*   **Behavioral Indicators:** Supervisors must be trained to identify signs of hypoxia masquerading as fatigue (e.g., confusion, cyanosis of lips, excessive drowsiness). Failure to intervene constitutes supervisory negligence.
*   **Incentivized Safety:** Delivery riders who document N95 usage and adherence to rest breaks receive "Health Bonuses" to counteract the behavioral drive to ignore safety for higher earnings.
*   **Liability & Penalties:** Companies failing to provide N95s or enforce breaks are liable for medical costs. Platforms disabling break timers during smog events face regulatory penalties and license suspension. 
*   **Whistleblower Protection:** Workers reporting safety violations are protected under occupational safety laws.

**Authorized By:** Ministry of Health & Family Welfare / Ministry of Labour & Employment  
**Status:** MANDATORY FOR COMPLIANCE

## 1. நோக்கம் மற்றும் பொருந்தக்கூடிய தன்மை

- **கட்டாயப் பயன்பாடு:** அடையாளம் காணப்பட்ட அனைத்து குழுக்களும் வெளியில் இருக்கும்போது சான்றளிக்கப்பட்ட N95 (அல்லது FFP2/FFP3) ரெஸ்பிரேட்டர்களை அணிய வேண்டும். AQI > 150 எனில் துணி முகக்கவசங்கள் மற்றும் அறுவை சிகிச்சை முகக்கவசங்கள் போதுமானவை அல்ல.
- **பொருத்த சோதனை:** தொழிலாளர்கள் ஒவ்வொரு ஷிஃப்ட்டிற்கும் முன் பயனர் முத்திரைச் சோதனையை (user seal check) செய்ய வேண்டும். முகக்கவசத்தின் பொருத்தத்தைத் தடைசெய்யும் முக ரோமங்கள் தொழில்முறை ஊழியர்களுக்கு அனுமதிக்கப்படாது.
- **மாற்றீடு அட்டவணை:** ரெஸ்பிரேட்டர்கள் தொடர்ச்சியான 8 மணிநேர பயன்பாட்டிற்குப் பிறகு அல்லது அழுக்கடைந்தால், சேதாரமடைந்தால் அல்லது சுவாசிப்பது கடினமாக இருந்தால் உடனடியாக மாற்றப்பட வேண்டும்.

*   **ట్రామా-ఇన్‌ఫార్మ్డ్ కంప్లయన్స్:** మాస్క్‌లు క్లాస్ట్రోఫోబియా, "గాలి కొరత" మరియు ట్రామా స్పందనలను ప్రేరేపించగలవు కాబట్టి, కంప్లయన్స్ శిక్షణలో క్రైసిస్ ఇంటర్వెన్షన్‌లను ఏకీకృతం చేయాలి:
    *   **క్రమంగా అలవాటు చేసుకోవడం:** మాస్క్‌ను నిషేధంగా కాకుండా "కవచం"గా భావించేలా, కార్మికులు పొగమంచులోకి వెళ్లడానికి ముందు శుభ్రమైన గాలి ప్రాంతాల్లో 5–10 నిమిషాలు మాస్క్ ధరించడానికి అభ్యాసం చేయాలి.
    *   **గ్రౌండింగ్ టెక్నిక్‌లు:** మాస్క్ ధరించి ఉన్నప్పుడు పానిక్ వస్తే, కార్మికులు "5-4-3-2-1" గ్రౌండింగ్ పద్ధతిని లేదా "యాంకర్" టెక్నిక్‌ను (కాళ్లను నేలకు ఆనించి, మూడు కనిపించే వస్తువులను పేర్కొనడం) ఉపయోగించాలి.
    *   **పానిక్ ప్రోటోకాల్‌లు:** హైపర్వెంటిలేషన్ కోసం పర్యవేక్షించడానికి (ముఖ్యంగా నిర్మాణ కార్మికుల కోసం) "బడి సిస్టమ్"ను ఏర్పాటు చేయాలి. తీవ్రమైన పానిక్ అనుభవమైతే, ఎటువంటి జరిమానా లేకుండా 2 నిమిషాల పాటు తక్కువ-AQI మైక్రో-జోన్‌లోకి వెళ్లడానికి కార్మికులకు సిగ్నల్ ఇవ్వాలి.

### B. తప్పనిసరి హైడ్రేషన్ & విశ్రాంతి విరామాలు
*   **హైడ్రేషన్:** శ్లేష్మం గట్టిపడకుండా నివారించడానికి ప్రతి 1–2 గంటలకు 250–500ml నీరు లేదా ORS తీసుకోవడం తప్పనిసరి. కెఫిన్ మరియు చక్కెర సోడాలు నిషిద్ధం. విరామాల సమయంలో మూత్రం రంగు (లేత పసుపు) పర్యవేక్షించాలి.
*   **విశ్రాంతి విరామాలు:** 
    *   **AQI 150–300:** ప్రతి 2 గంటలకు 10–15 నిమిషాల విరామం.
    *   **AQI 301–500+:** ప్రతి 45–90 నిమిషాలకు 15–20 నిమిషాల విరామం. 
    *   **ప్రోటోకాల్:** విరామాలు ఇండోర్, ఎయిర్-ప్యూరిఫైడ్ లేదా తక్కువ ట్రాఫిక్ ఉన్న ప్రాంతాల్లో జరగాలి. కార్టిసాల్ స్థాయిలను తగ్గించడానికి కార్మికులు "యాక్టివ్ రికవరీ" (నిటారుగా కూర్చోవడం, డయాఫ్రాగ్మాటిక్ బ్రీతింగ్) చేయాలి.
*   **పని పరిమితులు:** గిగ్ రైడర్లు ఆశ్రయం పొందేలా AQI 500+ సమయంలో డెలివరీ ప్లాట్‌ఫార్మ్‌లు అల్గారిథమ్‌లను నిలిపివేయాలి. AQI >450 ఉన్నప్పుడు అనవసరమైన బహిరంగ పనులను నిలిపివేయాలి.

## II. అధిక ప్రమాదకర ప్రయాణికుల రక్షణ & మానసిక ఆందోళన నిర్వహణ

*   **ప్రయాణ సలహాలు:** AQI 300+ సమయంలో గర్భిణీ మహిళలు మరియు వృద్ధులు అనవసరమైన ప్రయాణాలను నివారించాలి. "ఇన్నర్ సర్క్యులేషన్"కు సెట్ చేసిన AC కలిగిన మూసివేసిన వాహనాలను ఉపయోగించి పీక్ ట్రాఫిక్ సమయాలను నివారించాలి.
*   **ఊపిరితిత్తుల ఇబ్బంది యొక్క మానసిక ఆందోళన:** పొగమంచు వల్ల కలిగే డిస్ప్నియా తరచుగా "పానిక్-హైపోక్సియా సైకిల్"ను ప్రేరేపిస్తుంది. 
    *   **ఆస్తమా పిల్లలు:** ఛాతీ బిగుసుకోకుండా నివారించడానికి "బబుల్ బ్రీతింగ్" (నిదానంగా పీల్చడానికి పెద్ద బుడగ ఊదుతున్నట్లు ఊహించుకోవడం) ఉపయోగించాలి. AQI >200 ఉన్నప్పుడు బహిరంగ ఆటలు నిషిద్ధం.
    *   **గర్భిణీ మహిళలు:** పారాసింపథెటిక్ స్థితికి మారడానికి వేగల్ నరాల ఉద్దీపన (మృదువైన హమ్మింగ్, మెడపై చల్లని ఒత్తిడి) ఉపయోగించాలి. గర్భాశయ రక్త ప్రవాహాన్ని ఆప్టిమైజ్ చేయడానికి ఎడమ వైపుకు తిరిగి పడుకోవడానికి ప్రాధాన్యత ఇవ్వాలి.
    *   **వృద్ధులు:** సంబంధిత ఊపిరితిత్తుల ఇబ్బంది నివేదికలపై ఆధారపడకుండా, గందరగోళం లేదా నిద్రాళుత్వం (ప్రారంభ హైపోక్సియా సంకేతాలు) కోసం సంరక్షకులు పర్యవేక్షించాలి. రోజువారీ నడకలు ఇండోర్‌కు మార్చాలి.

## III. క్లినికల్ ట్రైయేజీ: SpO2 పరిమితులు & ట్రామా వేరుచేయడం

ఆందోళన వల్ల కలిగే **ట్రామా-ఇండ్యూస్డ్ టాకిప్నియా** (వేగంగా ఊపిరి పీల్చడం), హైపోక్సియాను అనుకరించవచ్చు లేదా అంతర్గత శ్వసన వైఫల్యాన్ని దాచిపెట్టవచ్చు కాబట్టి ట్రైయేజీ దీనిని పరిగణనలోకి తీసుకోవాలి.

### A. SpO2 ఆసుపత్రి ట్రైయేజీ మ్యాట్రిక్స్

| SpO2 స్థాయి | రిస్క్ వర్గం | చర్య/ట్రైయేజీ ప్రోటోకాల్ | ట్రామా/మానసిక పరిగణన |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | స్థిరంగా | పర్యవేక్షించండి; N95 మరియు హైడ్రేషన్ కొనసాగించండి. | ఆందోళన-ప్రేరిత హైపర్వెంటిలేషన్ కోసం అంచనా వేయండి (వేళ్లలో చీమలు కుట్టినట్లు, అధిక అవగాహన). |
| **92% – 94%** | తేలికపాటి హైపోక్సియా | **అత్యవసర సంరక్షణ:** శుభ్రమైన గాలికి తరలించండి; విశ్రాంతి విరామాలు ప్రారంభించండి. 15-30 నిమిషాల్లో మళ్లీ తనిఖీ చేయండి. | "గాలి కొరత" (పానిక్) మరియు శారీరక హైపోక్సియాను వేరు చేయండి. చెడు రక్త ప్రసరణ (వృద్ధులలో సాధారణం)ను నిర్ధారించడానికి రెండవ పరికరంతో ధృవీకరించండి. |
| **86% – 91%** | మధ్యస్థ హైపోక్సియా | **ఎమర్జెన్సీ ట్రైయేజీ:** వెంటనే EDకి తరలించండి; హై-ఫ్లో ఆక్సిజన్; ఆస్తమా రోగులకు నెబులైజేషన్. | పానిక్ అటాక్ ప్రమాదం ఎక్కువ; మరింత O2 పడిపోకుండా నివారించడానికి ప్రశాంతపరిచే ఓదార్పు ("మేము ఊపిరిని నెమ్మదిస్తున్నాము") అవసరం. |
| **< 85%** | తీవ్రమైన హైపోక్సియా | **క్రిటికల్ కేర్:** ఎమర్జెన్సీ సర్వీసులకు (112) కాల్ చేయండి; వెంటనే ఆసుపత్రిలో చేర్చండి; BiPAP/ఇంటుబేషన్ అవసరం కావచ్చు. | ట్రామా స్పందన లేకపోవచ్చు (నిద్రాళుత్వం/గందరగోళం); శారీరక స్థిరీకరణకు ప్రాధాన్యత ఇవ్వండి. |

### B. గర్భిణీ మహిళల కోసం ప్రత్యేక పరిగణనలు
భ్రూణ ఆక్సిజన్ ఆధారపడటం వల్ల, ట్రైయేజీ పరిమితి ఎక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. **SpO2 <95%** వెంటనే క్లినికల్ అంచనా అవసరం. పొగమంచు సంఘటనల సమయంలో భ్రూణ కదలికలు తగ్గినట్లు ఏదైనా నివేదిక వస్తే, తల్లి SpO2తో సంబంధం లేకుండా వెంటనే ప్రసూతి అంచనా అవసరం.

### C. క్లినికల్ వేరుచేయడం: పానిక్ vs. క్లినికల్ హైపోక్సియా
*   **పానిక్/ట్రామా స్పందన:** ఆందోళన ఉన్నప్పటికీ SpO2 తరచుగా >94% ఉంటుంది. ఊపిరి వేగంగా, తేలికపాటిగా మరియు ఛాతీ-కేంద్రీకృతంగా ఉంటుంది. చర్మం పాలిపోయినట్లు లేదా ఎర్రగా ఉంటుంది. రోగి అధిక అవగాహన మరియు భయంతో ఉంటాడు. గ్రౌండింగ్/ప్రశాంతపరిచే పద్ధతులతో మెరుగుపడుతుంది.
*   **క్లినికల్ హైపోక్సియా:** SpO2 స్థిరంగా 92% కంటే తక్కువగా ఉంటుంది. ఊపిరి నెమ్మదిగా, కష్టంగా ఉంటుంది, అనుబంధ కండరాల వినియోగం మరియు ఛాతీ రిట్రాక్షన్‌లు ఉంటాయి. చర్మం సయానోసిస్ చూపిస్తుంది (పెదవులు/గోళ్లపై నీలం రంగు). మానసిక స్థితి గందరగోళంగా లేదా నిద్రాళువుగా ఉంటుంది. ప్రశాంతపరిచే జోక్యాలతో మెరుగుపడదు.

## IV. అమలు & అమలు చేయడం చెక్‌లిస్ట్

# তীব্র স্মগের জন্য (AQI ১৫০–৫০০+) সমন্বিত বায়োমেকানিক্যাল এবং রক্তসংবহন স্বাস্থ্য জরুরি প্রোটোকল

## ১. উদ্দেশ্য এবং AQI স্তরবিন্যাস
এই প্রোটোকলটি ভারতের বহিরঙ্গন কর্মীদের (ডেলিভারি গিগ রাইডার, ট্রাফিক পুলিশ, নির্মাণ শ্রমিক, রাস্তার পাশের বিক্রেতা) এবং উচ্চ ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রীদের (গর্ভবতী নারী, হাঁপানি রোগী শিশু, বয়স্ক নাগরিক) মধ্যে রক্তসংবহন ব্যর্থতা, হাইপোক্সিয়া এবং হৃদযন্ত্রের চাপ প্রশমিত করে। কার্যক্রম অবশ্যই কেন্দ্রীয় দূষণ নিয়ন্ত্রণ বোর্ডের (CPCB) রিয়েল-টাইম ডেটার ওপর ভিত্তি করে সামঞ্জস্য করতে হবে।

| AQI পরিসর | ঝুঁকির মাত্রা | বাধ্যতামূলক সুরক্ষা এবং কাজের পরিবর্তন |

| **২০১–৩০০** | খুব অস্বাস্থ্যকর | **N95 বাধ্যতামূলক।** পরিশ্রম কমান; প্রতি ৯০ মিনিটে ১৫ মিনিটের বিরতি। |

## ২. শ্বাসযন্ত্রের সুরক্ষা ম্যান্ডেট (N95/FFP2)
কণা-জনিত ভ্যাসোকনস্ট্রিকশন এবং হাইপোক্সিয়া রোধ করতে, উল্লিখিত সমস্ত বহিরঙ্গন কর্মীর জন্য শ্বাসযন্ত্রের সুরক্ষা বাধ্যতামূলক।
*   **মান:** BIS-সার্টিফাইড (IS 9473:2002) অথবা NIOSH-অনুমোদিত N95/FFP2 রেসপিরেটর ব্যবহার করুন। AQI >১৫০-এর জন্য কাপড়ের মাস্ক অপর্যাপ্ত।
*   **ফিট টেস্টিং:** কর্মীদের অবশ্যই প্রতিটি শিফট শুরু করার আগে ইউজার সিল চেক করতে হবে। সিল নিশ্চিত করতে মুখের লোম ছাঁটা থাকতে হবে।
*   **প্রতিস্থাপনের সময়সূচি:** AQI ১৫০–৩০০-এর জন্য প্রতি ৪০–৪৮ ঘণ্টা ব্যবহারের পর এবং AQI ৩০০–৫০০+-এর জন্য প্রতি ৮–২৪ ঘণ্টায় (অথবা সাথে সাথে যদি শ্বাস নিতে বাধা বাড়ে, কারণ কণা সম্পৃক্ততা হৃদযন্ত্রের ওপর চাপ সৃষ্টি করে) প্রতিস্থাপন করুন।
*   **উচ্চ ঝুঁকিপূর্ণ যাত্রী:** গর্ভবতী নারীদের তাপজনিত চাপ কমাতে ভেন্টেড N95 ব্যবহার করা উচিত। হাঁপানি রোগী শিশুদের বাড়ির মধ্যে থাকা উচিত; যদি যাতায়াত অপরিহার্য হয়, তবে প্রাপ্তবয়স্কদের তত্ত্বাবধানে শিশুদের উপযোগী N95 ব্যবহার করুন (৭ বছরের কম বয়সী শিশুদের কড়া সিলযুক্ত N95 পরা উচিত নয়)।

## ৩. বায়োমেকানিক্যাল এবং রক্তসংবহন সহায়তা
হাইপোক্সিক অবস্থায় শারীরিক পরিশ্রম হৃদস্পন্দনের চাহিদা বাড়িয়ে দেয়, যখন স্মগ-জনিত ভ্যাসোকনস্ট্রিকশন অক্সিজেন সরবরাহ কমিয়ে দেয়।

### ক. বাধ্যতামূলক হাইড্রেশন
ডিহাইড্রেশন রক্ত ঘন করে (সান্দ্রতা বাড়ায়), যা স্মগ ঘটনার সময় থ্রম্বোসিস এবং হৃদরোগের ঝুঁকি বাড়ায়।
*   **গ্রহণের হার:** সক্রিয় পরিশ্রমের সময় প্রতি ২০–৩০ মিনিটে অন্তত ২৫০ মিলি পানি অথবা ওরাল রিহাইড্রেশন সলিউশন (ORS) পান করুন।
*   **ইলেক্ট্রোলাইট:** নির্মাণ শ্রমিক, গিগ রাইডার এবং ট্রাফিক পুলিশকে হাইপোনেট্রেমিয়া রোধ করতে ইলেক্ট্রোলাইট সমৃদ্ধ তরল পান করতে হবে।
*   **মনিটরিং:** প্রতি ২ ঘণ্টায় প্রস্রাবের রঙ পরীক্ষা করুন। গাঢ় প্রস্রাব তাৎক্ষণিক হাইড্রেশন ঘাটতি নির্দেশ করে যার জন্য ৩০ মিনিটের বিশ্রাম প্রয়োজন।

### খ. শিরায় রক্ত প্রবাহের জন্য বাধ্যতামূলক বিশ্রাম বিরতি
দীর্ঘক্ষণ দাঁড়িয়ে থাকা বা গাড়ি চালানো নিম্নাঙ্গে রক্ত জমাট বাঁধায়, যা হৃদযন্ত্রের প্রি-লোড কমিয়ে দেয় এবং ক্লটের ঝুঁকি বাড়ায়।
*   **ফ্রিকোয়েন্সি:** প্রতি ১ ঘণ্টা টানা পরিশ্রমের জন্য ১৫ মিনিটের বসা বিশ্রাম। AQI >৩০০-এর জন্য, কাজের চক্র ৪০–৪৫ মিনিট কাজ এবং এরপর ১৫–২০ মিনিট বিশ্রামে কমানো উচিত।
*   **অবস্থান:** বিশ্রামের সময়, কর্মীদের অবশ্যই পা কিছুটা উঁচু করে রাখতে হবে অথবা হাঁটু না ক্রস করে বসতে হবে যাতে নিম্নাঙ্গ থেকে শিরায় রক্ত প্রবাহ সহজ হয়।
*   **পরিবেশ:** বিশ্রাম অবশ্যই ছায়াযুক্ত, কম ধুলোযুক্ত, অথবা ইনডোর ফিল্টার্ড-এয়ার জোনে (যদি সম্ভব হয় AQI <১৫০) নিতে হবে যাতে কণার সম্মিলিত লোড কমে।

## ৪. জনসংখ্যা-ভিত্তিক সমন্বয়
*   **ডেলিভারি গিগ রাইডার এবং ট্রাফিক পুলিশ:** শ্বাস-প্রশ্বাসের হার কমাতে গড় গতি সীমিত করুন। স্থিরভাবে দাঁড়িয়ে থাকার ঝুঁকি এড়াতে প্রতি ২ ঘণ্টায় অবস্থান পরিবর্তন করুন। বাছুরের ব্যথা বা ফোলা (DVT লক্ষণ) এর জন্য মনিটর করুন।
*   **নির্মাণ শ্রমিক:** AQI >৩০০-এর সময় ম্যানুয়াল লিফটিং ১৫–২০ কেজির কম ভারে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখুন। ভারী উত্তোলনের কাজ সকাল বেলায় (সকাল ৬টা–৯টা) নির্ধারণ করুন যখন ইনভার্সন লেয়ার কম থাকতে পারে। তত্ত্বাবধায়কদের অবশ্যই কঠোরভাবে পানির বিরতি নিশ্চিত করতে হবে।
*   **রাস্তার পাশের বিক্রেতা:** তাপজনিত চাপ কমাতে যা রক্তসংবহন চাপ বাড়ায়, তা এড়াতে ছাতা/ছায়া ব্যবহার করুন।
*   **গর্ভবতী নারী:** AQI >৩০০-এর সময় সম্পূর্ণ বহিরঙ্গন কাজ থেকে অব্যাহতি। যাতায়াত শুধুমাত্র আবদ্ধ, এয়ার-কন্ডিশনারযুক্ত যানে সীমাবদ্ধ রাখুন যেখানে রিসার্কুলেশন মোড চালু আছে। ভ্রূণের সংবেদনশীলতার কারণে SpO2 <৯৫% হলে তাৎক্ষণিক প্রসূতি বিশেষজ্ঞের পরামর্শ প্রয়োজন।

### Clinical Emergency & Occupational Health Protocol: Smog Mitigation (AQI 150–500+)

**Compassionate Preface: The Surgery of Prevention**
In medicine, surgery is often viewed as a corrective act—a precise intervention to heal a wound. However, the most compassionate form of surgery is prophylaxis: preventing the wound from ever occurring. When the Air Quality Index (AQI) reaches hazardous levels (150 to 500+), the environment itself acts as a blunt instrument against the delicate tissue of the lungs. For those working outdoors or those with fragile health, this isn't just "bad air"—it is a systemic assault on the respiratory and cardiovascular systems. 

Think of this protocol as a **surgical intervention on the community environment**. Just as a surgeon meticulously removes a blockage to allow a heart to beat again, we must "sterilize" the breathing zone of our workers and vulnerable citizens. By treating the N95 respirator as a sterile barrier, hydration as internal perfusion, and rest breaks as recovery time, we spare the human body from the trauma of critical care and invasive life support later.

---

#### I. Occupational Health Mandates: The Workforce Shield
*Target Groups: Delivery Gig Riders, Traffic Police, Construction Laborers, Street Vendors.*

During AQI events ranging from 150 (Unhealthy) to 500+ (Hazardous), outdoor work becomes a clinical risk factor. The following protocols are mandatory:

**1. The N95 Respirator Mandate (The Airway Shield)**
*   **The Concept:** Think of an N95 mask as a surgical barrier. While a cloth mask is like a screen door, an N95 is a high-efficiency filter that stops microscopic toxins (PM2.5) from entering the bloodstream.
*   **Requirement:** Mandatory wear of BIS-certified or NIOSH-approved N95/FFP2 respirators. 
*   **Fit Check:** Workers must perform a user seal check every shift. Inhale sharply; the mask should collapse slightly. Exhale; no air should leak from the edges.
*   **Replacement:** Masks must be replaced every 8 hours or immediately if soiled, wet, or clogged.
*   **Compassionate Enforcement:** Employers and gig platforms must provide these free of cost. No worker should be penalized for stopping work to adjust or replace a compromised mask.

**2. Mandatory Hydration (Internal Perfusion)**
*   **The Concept:** Dehydration thickens blood viscosity and the mucus in the lungs, making it harder for the body to "sweep" out pollutants. Hydration acts as a continuous internal rinse.
*   **Protocol:** Minimum 250ml of water or Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) every hour. Employers must provide clean drinking water stations at designated "hydration hubs" every 2km for riders and vendors. 
*   **Avoid:** Caffeine and sugary sodas, which accelerate dehydration.

**3. Strategic Rest Breaks (The Systemic Reset)**
*   **The Concept:** Physical exertion increases the breathing rate, meaning the worker inhales more toxins per minute. Rest breaks act as a "pause button" for pollutant intake.
*   **Protocol:** A mandatory 15-minute rest break every 2 hours. Breaks must be taken in a clean-air zone (indoor space with air purifier or sealed windows). Standing in traffic smoke negates the recovery.
*   **Group-Specific Rules:** Traffic police must rotate every 4 hours away from high-density intersections during AQI >300. Construction heavy exertion tasks (mixing cement, cutting stone) must be paused during peak pollution hours.

---

#### II. High-Risk Commuter Protocols: Preventing Invasive Life Support
*Target Groups: Pregnant Women, Asthmatic Children, Geriatric Citizens.*

For these groups, the lungs are the "vital organs" of the community body. To prevent the need for intubation (invasive life support), exposure must be strictly managed.

**1. Exposure Avoidance & Home Environment**
*   **AQI 150–300:** Limit outdoor exposure to <30 minutes. Avoid morning walks. Use enclosed vehicles with recirculated AC.
*   **AQI 301–500+:** Strict shelter-in-place. Seal windows and doors (use wet towels for gaps). Run HEPA air purifiers continuously. Avoid indoor burning (incense, cooking smoke).
*   **Medication Readiness:** Asthmatics must carry rescue inhalers (Salbutamol) at all times. Geriatric patients with COPD or heart failure must have pulse oximeters at home. Pregnant women should monitor for signs of pre-eclampsia exacerbated by hypoxia (headaches, swelling).

**2. Clinical Emergency & SpO2 Triage Thresholds**
Pulse Oximetry (SpO2) is the vital sign monitor for smog exposure. Healthcare providers, ASHA workers, and family members must use it to identify hypoxia early. The following thresholds dictate the level of care required:

| Risk Group | Normal Baseline | **Action Threshold (Consult Doctor)** | **Hospital Triage Threshold (Immediate ER)** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Pregnant Women** | 95% - 100% | < 95% sustained 10 mins | **$\le$ 94%** (Risk of fetal hypoxia; requires obstetric consult) |
| **Asthmatic Children** | 95% - 100% | < 94% or peak flow drop | **$\le$ 92%** or visible chest retractions (skin pulling between ribs) |
| **Geriatric Citizens** | 92% - 98% | Drop of >3% from personal baseline | **$\le$ 90%** (Urgent evaluation for COPD/cardiac stress) |

---

#### III. Clinical Emergency Response Flowchart

1.  **Symptom Recognition:** If a worker or commuter experiences sudden shortness of breath, chest pain, or blue-tinted lips (cyanosis).
2.  **Immediate Field Action:** 
    *   Move the individual to a clean-air environment (HEPA-filtered room).
    *   Administer supplemental oxygen if available at home or in the field.
    *   Check SpO2 levels immediately.
3.  **Triage Decision:**
    *   **SpO2 > Threshold:** Continue monitoring, administer prescribed inhalers/medication, and enforce total rest.
    *   **SpO2 $\le$ Threshold:** **Emergency Transfer.** Transport to the nearest facility with Emergency Critical Care. Inform triage staff of "Acute Smog Exposure." Preparation for non-invasive ventilation (BiPAP) may be necessary to avoid intubation.

**Compassionate Closing:**
Just as a surgical team watches over a patient under anesthesia, the community must watch over its vulnerable members during smog events. Customers should not penalize delivery riders for delays caused by mask adjustments or rest breaks. By treating the air we breathe as a critical surgical field, we perform a collective act of care—cutting out the risk before it becomes a tragedy, and ensuring a walk to work or a delivery trip does not end in a critical care unit.

    *   **धूल नियंत्रण:** साइट पर हर 30 मिनट में पानी का छिड़काव/मिस्ट कैनन अनिवार्य।
    *   **सीमा:** मूर्छा के जोखिम के कारण AQI >300 के दौरान ऊंचाई पर कोई काम नहीं।
    *   **जलयोजन:** धुंध से जटिल हीट-स्ट्रेस को रोकने के लिए साइट पर इलेक्ट्रोलाइट-समृद्ध पानी प्रदान करें।
*   **डिलीवरी गिग राइडर्स:**
    *   **एल्गोरिदम समायोजन:** डिलीवरी प्लेटफॉर्म को समय सीमा बढ़ानी चाहिए और AQI 400+ के दौरान स्पष्ट सुरक्षा स्वीकृति के बिना राइडर्स को ऑर्डर स्वीकार करने से ऐप-लॉक करना चाहिए।
    *   **आइडल मोड:** राइडर्स को सिग्नल पर प्रतीक्षा करते समय इंजन बंद करना चाहिए ताकि स्थानीय कणों के संपर्क को कम किया जा सके।
    *   **किट:** अतिरिक्त N95 मास्क और ओरल रिहाइड्रेशन सॉल्ट्स (ORS) ले जाना अनिवार्य।

## 3. उच्च जोखिम वाले यात्रियों के प्रोटोकॉल
बाहरी वातावरण में नेविगेट कर रहे कमजोर आबादी के लिए विशेष मार्गदर्शन।

*   **गर्भवती महिलाएं:**
    *   **AQI >150:** पीक ट्रैफिक घंटों (सुबह 8–10 बजे, शाम 6–8 बजे) से बचें। पुनः संचालित हवा वाली enclosed AC वाहनों का उपयोग करें; दोपहिया या खुले ऑटो-रिक्शा से बचें।
    *   **ट्रायज:** SpO2 स्तर की परवाह किए बिना किसी भी मूर्छा के_episode के लिए तत्काल प्रसूति मूल्यांकन की आवश्यकता है, क्योंकि भ्रूण हाइपोक्सिया मातृ हाइपोक्सिया से तेजी से होता है।
*   **दमा से पीड़ित बच्चे:**
    *   **स्कूल प्रोटोकॉल:** AQI >200 पर बाहरी खेल रद्द। स्कूल आने-जाने के लिए बच्चों के आकार के N95 मास्क अनिवार्य।
    *   **दवा:** AQI >150 के दौरान रेस्क्यू इनहेलर हमेशा साथ रखें।
    *   **ट्रायज:** स्टेटस एस्थमैटिकस के जोखिम के कारण मूर्छा होने पर तत्काल अस्पताल ले जाना आवश्यक है।
*   **वरिष्ठ नागरिक (65+):**
    *   **रोकथाम:** AQI >150 के दौरान सुबह की सैर वर्जित। घर पर दैनिक SpO2 लॉगिंग।
    *   **ट्रायज:** हाइपोक्सिया के लिए कम सहनशीलता; यदि भ्रम या हृदय संबंधी distress के साथ हो तो परिवहन सीमा SpO2 <94% तक बढ़ाई गई है।

## 4. धुंध से प्रेरित मूर्छा के लिए नैदानिक ट्रायज
यह एल्गोरिदम बेहोशी, सांस की तकलीफ, या छाती में दर्द से जूझ रहे स्ट्रीट वेंडर्स और श्रमिकों के लिए आपातकालीन प्रतिक्रिया को परिभाषित करता है।

### A. तत्काल आकलन (फील्ड ट्रायज)
1.  **सुरक्षा:** रोगी को तुरंत ट्रैफिक एग्जॉस्ट से दूर "क्लीन एयर जोन" में ले जाएं।
2.  **ABCs:** वायुमार्ग, श्वसन, परिसंचरण की जांच करें। यदि बेहोश हैं, तो CPR शुरू करें और 112 पर कॉल करें।
3.  **स्थिति:** लेटाएं, पैर ऊपर उठाएं, कड़े कपड़े ढीले करें।
4.  **SpO2 माप:** तुरंत पोर्टेबल पल्स ऑक्सीमेट्री का उपयोग करें।

### B. अस्पताल स्थानांतरण के लिए SpO2 सीमाएं
कठोर सीमाएं धुंध की घटनाओं के दौरान देखभाल के स्तर को निर्धारित करती हैं।

| SpO2 स्तर (आराम पर) | नैदानिक स्थिति | कार्य प्रोटोकॉल |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **95% – 100%** | सामान्य | 30 मिनट तक निगरानी करें। मौखिक जलयोजन दें। छायादार विश्राम क्षेत्र में वापस भेजें। जब तक लक्षण बने रहें तब तक कोई परिवहन नहीं। |
| **91% – 94%** | हल्का हाइपोक्सिया | **तत्काल देखभाल:** नासल कैनुला के माध्यम से कम प्रवाह वाली ऑक्सीजन दें (2-4 L/min)। यदि 15 मिनट बाद भी लक्षण (चक्कर, छाती में दर्द) बने रहें, तो निकटतम मोहल्ला क्लिनिक/सिविल अस्पताल ले जाएं। |
| **≤ 90%** | गंभीर हाइपोक्सिया | **आपातकालीन परिवहन:** तुरंत एम्बुलेंस भेजें (112 या 108 डायल करें)। रास्ते में उच्च प्रवाह वाली ऑक्सीजन। ICU भर्ती के लिए प्राथमिकता दें। |
| **किसी भी स्तर + मूर्छा** | न्यूरोलॉजिकल समझौता | **अस्पताल परिवहन आवश्यक:** SpO2 की परवाह किए बिना, मूर्छा मस्तिष्कीय हाइपोक्सिया या हृदय तनाव का संकेत है। तत्काल ER मूल्यांकन अनिवार्य है। |

### C. लक्षण-विशिष्ट परिवहन मानदंड
अस्पताल ले जाना आवश्यक है यदि मूर्छा के साथ निम्नलिखित हैं:
*   छाती में जकड़न या दर्द (संभावित PM2.5-प्रेरित एनजाइना के रूप में इलाज करें; ECG अनिवार्य)।
*   बेहोशी के बाद भ्रम या बदली हुई मानसिक स्थिति।
*   इनहेलर के प्रति अनुक्रिया नहीं करने वाली गंभीर घुलन (wheezing)।
*   SpO2 रीडिंग की परवाह किए बिना सायनोसिस (नीले होंठ/नाखून)।

## 5. अनिवार्य रोकथाम उपाय
मूर्छा की घटनाओं और दीर्घकालिक रुग्णता को कम करने के लिए, नियोक्ताओं और नगर निगमों के लिए निम्नलिखित गैर-मोलभावी आदेश हैं।

1.  **N95 रेस्पिरेटर अनिवार्य:**
    *   AQI >150 के लिए कपड़े के मास्क अपर्याप्त हैं। नियोक्ताओं को निःशुल्क BIS-प्रमाणित N95/FFP2 मास्क प्रदान करने चाहिए।
    *   ट्रैफिक पुलिस और निर्माण पर्यवेक्षकों के लिए साप्ताहिक फिट-चेक (धातु की नाक-क्लिप को दबाना) किया जाना चाहिए।
    *   मास्क को हर 40-50 घंटे के उपयोग के बाद या तुरंत यदि गंदा/गीला हो जाए तो बदलना चाहिए।
2.  **अनिवार्य जलयोजन:**
    *   बाहरी श्रमिकों के लिए प्रति पारी कम से कम 3-4 लीटर पानी। जलयोजन विराम को भुगतान किए गए कार्य समय के रूप में गिना जाएगा।
    *   हाइपोटेंशन-प्रेरित मूर्छा को रोकने के लिए हर 4 घंटे में ORS पूरक की सिफारिश की जाती है। उच्च धुंध की घटनाओं के दौरान कैफीन/चाय से बचें।
3.  **अनिवार्य विश्राम विराम:**
    *   **AQI 150-200:** कम एक्सपोजर वाले क्षेत्र में हर 2 घंटे में 10 मिनट।
    *   **AQI 201-300:** छायादार/फ़िल्टर्ड क्षेत्र में हर 2 घंटे में 15 मिनट।
    *   **AQI 300+:** हर घंटे 15-30 मिनट; यदि इनडोर आश्रय उपलब्ध नहीं है तो कार्य निलंबन।
4.  **आपातकालीन संपर्क और रिपोर्टिंग:**
    *   **राष्ट्रीय आपातकालीन:** 112 | **एम्बुलेंस:** 108 | **प्रदूषण नियंत्रण हेल्पलाइन:** 1950 (CPCB)।
    *   बाहरी श्रमिकों के बीच सभी मूर्छा के मामलों को महामारी विज्ञान ट्रैकिंग के लिए नगर निगम पर्यवेक्षकों और गिग प्लेटफॉर्म द्वारा व्यवसायिक स्वास्थ्य रजिस्टर में लॉग किया जाना चाहिए।

## २. व्यावसायिक आरोग्य प्रोटोकॉल्स: भारतीय बाह्य कामगार
**लक्ष्य गट:** डिलिव्हरी गिग रायडर्स, वाहतूक पोलीस, बांधकाम मजूर, रस्ते विक्रेते.

### २.१ श्वसन संरक्षण (N95 अनिवार्य)
*   **उपकरणे:** BIS-प्रमाणित (IS ९४७३) किंवा NIOSH-मान्यता प्राप्त N95/FFP2 रेस्पिरेटर्स अनिवार्य आहेत. कापडी आणि सर्जिकल मास्क PM2.5 साठी अपुरे आहेत.
*   **बदल:** मास्क प्रत्येक ८-१२ तासांनी किंवा ते घाणेरडे/ओले झाल्यास तात्काळ बदलणे आवश्यक आहे.
*   **प्रौढ फिट चेक:** प्रत्येक शिफ्टच्या सुरुवातीला युझर सील चेक करा. मास्कला हाताने धरा, स्ट्रॅप्स डोक्यावर ओढा (वरचा स्ट्रॅप डोक्याच्या वरच्या भागात, खालचा स्ट्रॅप कानांच्या खाली). जोरात श्वास घ्या (मास्क आत ओढला पाहिजे); जोरात श्वास सोडा (डोळे/नाकाभोवती गळती तपासा).

### २.२ अनिवार्य हायड्रेशन आणि विश्रांतीचे ब्रेक
निर्जलीकरणामुळे पार्टिक्युलेट मॅटरमुळे होणारे म्युकोसिलियरी क्लिअरन्स फेलियर वाढते.
*   **हायड्रेशन:** प्रत्येक ६०-९० मिनिटांनी किमान २५० मिली पाणी किंवा ORS.
*   **विश्रांती ब्रेक:** प्रत्येक तासाला फिल्टर केलेल्या किंवा इनडोअर वातावरणात १५ मिनिटांचा अनिवार्य "क्लीन एअर ब्रेक". ब्रेक थेट एक्झॉस्ट एक्सपोजरपासून दूर घ्यावेत (उदा. थांबलेल्या ट्रकच्या बाजूला नाही).

### २.३ विशिष्ट कामगार मार्गदर्शक तत्त्वे
*   **डिलिव्हरी गिग रायडर्स:** ओळखल्या जाणाऱ्या वाहतूक कोंडीच्या ठिकाणांपासून दूर राहतील असे रूट नियोजन करा. डोळे/नाकावर थेट पार्टिक्युलेट एक्सपोजर कमी करण्यासाठी हेलमेट व्हिझर बंद ठेवा. शिफ्टनंतर नाकाची सालाइन इरिगेशन (धुणे) शिफारस केलेली आहे.
*   **वाहतूक पोलीस:** AQI ३००+ दरम्यान प्रत्येक ६० मिनिटांनी पोस्ट बदला. शक्य असल्यास पोर्टेबल एअर-प्युरिफाइड बुथचा वापर करा. स्मॉग सिझनमध्ये साप्ताहिक स्पायरोमेट्री तपासणी.
*   **बांधकाम मजूर:** धूळ स्रोतांवर वारंवार पाणी शिंपडा (प्रत्येक २ तासांनी). AQI ४००+ दरम्यान माती हलविण्याचे काम थांबवा. सकाळी ६ ते ९ च्या दरम्यान (इन्व्हर्जन लेयर पीक) कोणतेही बाह्य काम करू नका.
*   **रस्ते विक्रेते:** स्टॉल्स शक्य तितके वाहतुकीच्या वरच्या दिशेने (upwind) ठेवा. वारा अडवण्यासाठी पारदर्शक प्लास्टिक शीटिंगचा वापर करा. पैसे/अन्न हाताळल्यानंतर तात्काळ हात आणि चेहरा धुवा.

---

## ३. उच्च जोखीम प्रवासी प्रोटोकॉल्स
**लक्ष्य गट:** गर्भवती महिला, दम्याची मुले, वृद्ध नागरिक, रोगप्रतिकारक शक्ती कमकुवत युवक.

### ३.१ दम्याची आणि रोगप्रतिकारक शक्ती कमकुवत मुले (बाल कर्करोग केंद्रित)
केमोथेरपी घेत असलेल्या किंवा गंभीर दमा असलेल्या मुलांची श्वसन क्षमता कमी असते.
*   **एक्सपोजरपूर्वी प्रतिबंधात्मक उपाय:** रेस्क्यू इन्हेलर्स (सल्ब्युटामॉल) नेहमी सोबत ठेवावेत. लिखित 'अस्थमा ॲक्शन प्लॅन'चे पालन करा.
*   **शाळा प्रोटोकॉल:** AQI >१५० असताना सर्व बाह्य शारीरिक शिक्षण रद्द. इनडोअर एअर फिल्टरेशन अनिवार्य.
*   **प्रवास पद्धत:** उघड्या रिक्शा/बाइक्स टाळा; रिसर्क्युलेटेड एअरसह बंद खिडकीच्या वाहनांना प्राधान्य द्या.

### ३.२ गर्भवती महिला आणि वृद्ध नागरिक
*   **एक्सपोजर:** पीक ट्रॅफिकच्या वेळा टाळा (सकाळी ८–१०, सायंकाळी ५–८). सिस्टेमिक सूज आणि भ्रूणाच्या वाढीवर होणारा परिणाम टाळण्यासाठी गर्भवती महिलांनी AQI २००+ झोन टाळावेत.
*   **मॉनिटरिंग:** वृद्ध नागरिकांनी "स्मॉग-इंड्यूसड टॅकीकार्डिया" आणि हायपोक्सिया (चक्कर येणे, श्वास घेण्यास त्रास होणे) वर लक्ष ठेवावे. SpO2 सोबतच रक्तदाबाचे निरीक्षण करा.

---

## ४. लहान चेहऱ्यांसाठी कठोर N95 फिटिंग प्रोटोकॉल्स
योग्य फिटिंग अत्यंत महत्त्वाचे आहे; गळती होणारा मास्क खोटी सुरक्षा देतो. स्टँडर्ड प्रौढ N95 मास्क लहान मुलांच्या चेहऱ्यावर अनेकदा सील होत नाहीत.

*टीप: ३-४ वर्षांखालील मुलांसाठी N95 मास्क शिफारस केलेले नाहीत कारण त्यामुळे गुदमरण्याचा धोका आहे. या वयोगटासाठी इनडोअर एअर प्युरिफिकेशनवर अवलंबून राहा.*
१. **आकार निवड:** लहान मुलांच्या आकाराचे N95 रेस्पिरेटर्स वापरा ("Small" किंवा "Youth" लेबल असलेले). पर्याय नसल्यास आणि सील व्हेरिफाई केल्यासच १२ वर्षांखालील मुलांवर प्रौढ मास्क वापरा.
२. **मोल्डेबल नोज क्लिप:** नाकाच्या पुलावर मेटल क्लिप घट्ट दाबा जेणेकरून तो नाकाच्या आकाराला जुळेल आणि वरच्या बाजूने गळती होणार नाही.
३. **स्ट्रॅप प्लेसमेंट:** वरचा स्ट्रॅप डोक्याच्या वरच्या भागात, खालचा स्ट्रॅप कानांच्या खाली मानेच्या पायाशी.
४. **नेगेटिव्ह प्रेशर चेक:** मुलाने फिल्टरच्या पृष्ठभागावर हलके हात ठेवून श्वास घ्यावा. मास्क थोडा आत ओढला पाहिजे.
५. **पॉझिटिव्ह प्रेशर चेक:** मुलाने हलके श्वास सोडावेत. डोळे किंवा गालांच्या बाजूने हवा गळू नये.
६. **व्हिज्युअल इन्स्पेक्शन:** गाल किंवा हनुवटीच्या बाजूने कोणतीही अंतर नाहीत याची खात्री करा. (ज्येष्ठ किशोरवयीन मुलांमध्ये) चेहऱ्यावरील केर्स सीलच्या अखंडतेसाठी शेव्ह केले पाहिजेत.
७. **देखरेख:** मुलाने घराबाहेर पडण्यापूर्वी प्रौढांनी सील व्हेरिफाई करणे आवश्यक आहे. जर मुलाने त्रासामुळे मास्क काढला, तर तात्काळ स्वच्छ हवेच्या वातावरणात न्या.

---

## ५. वयोगटानुसार योग्य हायड्रेशन आणि विश्रांतीचे वेळापत्रक
प्रदूषणामुळे चयापचयाची मागणी वाढते; हायड्रेशन म्युकोसिलियरी क्लिअरन्समध्ये मदत करते. थंड पेयांमुळे होणारा ब्रॉन्कोस्पाझम टाळण्यासाठी कोमट पाणी किंवा रूम टेम्परेचर द्रव पदार्थ प्राधान्य द्यावेत.

| वयोगट | हायड्रेशन आवश्यकता | विश्रांती ब्रेक वारंवारता (AQI >२००) |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **मुले (३-१२ वर्षे)** | प्रत्येक ४५ मिनिटांनी १५० मिली | बाह्य एक्सपोजरच्या प्रत्येक १ तासानंतर १० मिनिटांची इनडोअर विश्रांती |
| **किशोरवयीन (१३-१८ वर्षे)** | प्रत्येक ४५ मिनिटांनी २०० मिली | प्रत्येक १.५ तासांनी |
| **प्रौढ कामगार** | प्रत्येक ६०-९० मिनिटांनी २५० मिली | स्वच्छ हवेत प्रति तास १५ मिनिटे (कलम २.२ पहा) |
| **वृद्ध (>६५ वर्षे) आणि गर्भवती** | प्रत्येक ६० मिनिटांनी २०० मिली | प्रत्येक १ तासाने (बसून विश्रांती). सलग एक्सपोजर ३० मिनिटांपर्यंत मर्यादित करा. |

---

## ६. वैद्यकीय आपत्कालीन आणि ट्रायज: SpO2 थ्रेशोल्ड्स
रोगप्रतिकारक शक्ती कमकुवत आणि श्वसन समस्या असलेल्या तरुणांसाठी प्रौढांचे स्टँडर्ड थ्रेशोल्ड्स (९०%) खूप कमी आहेत. ARDS किंवा गंभीर अस्थमाच्या झटक्यांपासून बचाव करण्यासाठी लवकर कारवाई करणे आवश्यक आहे.

### ६.१ घरगुती मॉनिटरिंग प्रोटोकॉल
*   **डिव्हाइस:** डिजिटल पल्स ऑक्सिमीटर (तपासलेली अचूकता). अचूक वाचनासाठी हात कोमट असल्याची खात्री करा.
*   **बेसलाइन:** आरोग्यदायी काळात वैयक्तिक बेसलाइन SpO2 निश्चित करा.
*   **वारंवारता:** AQI १५०–३०० साठी दिवसातून दोनदा; AQI ३००+ साठी लक्षणांच्या सुरुवातीस किंवा प्रत्येक ४ तासांनी.

### ६.२ कंझर्व्हेटिव्ह SpO2 ट्रायज थ्रेशोल्ड्स

| रुग्ण वर्ग | सामान्य बेसलाइन | **ट्रायज थ्रेशोल्ड (तात्काळ काळजी घ्या)** | **आपत्कालीन थ्रेशोल्ड (तात्काळ रुग्णालय)** |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **निरोगी प्रौढ/मुल** | ९५–१००% | < ९४% | < ९०% |
| **दम्याचे मुल** | ९५–९८% | **≤ ९४%** | **< ९२%** |
| **रोगप्रतिकारक शक्ती कमकुवत / ऑन्कोलॉजी** | ९४–९८% | **< ९३% (किंवा बेसलाइनपेक्षा कोणतीही घट)** | **< ९१%** |
| **वृद्ध / COPD** | ९०–९५% | < ८८% | < ८५% |
| **गर्भवती महिला** | ९६–१००% | **< ९५%** | **< ९३%** |

### ६.३ एस्केलेशन प्रोटोकॉल आणि वैद्यकीय रेड फ्लॅग्स
१. **जर SpO2 ≤ ट्रायज थ्रेशोल्ड असेल:** रुग्णाला तात्काळ इनडोअर स्वच्छ हवेच्या झोनमध्ये न्या. prescribed असल्यास रेस्क्यू इन्हेलर द्या. १५ मिनिटे विश्रांती घेतल्यानंतर पुन्हा SpO2 तपासा.
२. **जर SpO2 कमीच राहिले किंवा आपत्कालीन थ्रेशोल्डपर्यंत खाली आले:** इमर्जन्सी डिपार्टमेंटमध्ये जा. वाट पाहू नका. ट्रायज नर्सला "प्रदूषण-प्रेरित श्वसन अस्वस्थता" आणि अंतर्गत स्थितीबद्दल माहिती द्या. प्रवासादरम्यान रुग्णाने N95 मास्क घातला पाहिजे.

**SpO2 पातळीकडे दुर्लक्ष करून खालील लक्षणे दिसल्यास तात्काळ रुग्णालयात दाखल करणे आवश्यक आहे:**
*   ॲक्सेसरी मसल्सचा वापर / रिट्रॅक्शन्स (कफड्यांमध्ये किंवा मानेवर त्वचा आत ओढली जाणे).
*   टॅकीप्निया (मुलांमध्ये श्वसन दर > ३० श्वास/मिनिट, प्रौढांमध्ये > २४).
*   नाकाचे पंख फुगणे किंवा पूर्ण वाक्यांमध्ये बोलू न शकणे.
*   सायनोसिस (ओठ किंवा नखांना निळसर रंग येणे).
*   मानसिक स्थितीत बदल, गोंधळ किंवा अत्यंत सुस्ती.
